verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते नरसिंहाय प्रह्लादाह्लाददायिने । हिरण्यकशिपोर्वक्षः शिलाटङ्कनखालये ॥
verses.transliteration: namaste narasiṃhāya prahlādāhlādadāyine | hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣaḥ śilāṭaṅkanakhālaye ||
verses.translation: Salutations to Narasimha — the giver of joy to Prahlada — whose nails are the chisels that carved the chest-stone of Hiranyakashipu.
verses.hindi: नरसिंह को नमस्कार — जो प्रह्लाद को आनन्द देने वाले हैं — जिनके नख हिरण्यकशिपु की वक्ष-शिला को काटने वाले छेनी हैं।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana's mangalacharana in three images: Narasimha as joy-giver to Prahlada, and Narasimha as destroyer of Hiranyakashipu — the same act is simultaneously an act of love (toward the devotee) and an act of justice (against the tyrant). The nails described as "chisels carving stone" — the chest of Hiranyakashipu as stone — captures the terrifying precision of the divine response: not a broad sweep of power but a surgical act at exactly the right point, at exactly the right moment. This is the Narasimha theology: the divine's protection of the devotee and the divine's destruction of evil are the same event seen from two different vantage points.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्लादं पुरतः कृत्वा क्रोधाविष्टः सुतं ततः । उवाच रुषितो राजा हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prahlādaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā krodhāviṣṭaḥ sutaṃ tataḥ | uvāca ruṣito rājā hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam ||
verses.translation: Placing Prahlada before him, filled with anger, the enraged king Hiranyakashipu himself spoke to his son.
verses.hindi: प्रह्लाद को अपने सामने खड़ा करके, क्रोध से भरे हुए, क्रुद्ध राजा हिरण्यकशिपु स्वयं अपने पुत्र से बोला।
verses.commentary: The confrontation scene: Hiranyakashipu, the powerful demon king who had conquered the three worlds, stands before his own son who defies him. The irony is profound — the father who demanded worship as a god faces a son who worships the true God. This moment captures the eternal conflict between worldly power and spiritual conviction.
verses.wordMeaning: The confrontation scene: Hiranyakashipu, the powerful demon king who had conquered the three worlds, stands before his own son who defies him. The irony is profound — the father who demanded worship as a god faces a son who worships the true God. This moment captures the eternal conflict between worldly power and spiritual conviction.
verses.science: प्रह्लाद को अपने सामने खड़ा करके, क्रोध से भरे हुए, क्रुद्ध राजा हिरण्यकशिपु स्वयं अपने पुत्र से बोला। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नैतदद्भुतमेव त्वं हिरण्यकशिपोः सुत । प्रह्लादात्तव किं क्षुद्रं पापं वा साधु वा कृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration: naitadadbhutameva tvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ suta | prahlādātta kiṃ kṣudraṃ pāpaṃ vā sādhu vā kṛtam ||
verses.translation: This is not at all surprising in you, O son of Hiranyakashipu. For what small sin or good deed is not done by Prahlada?
verses.hindi: हे हिरण्यकशिपु के पुत्र! तुममें यह कुछ भी आश्चर्यजनक नहीं है। क्योंकि प्रह्लाद द्वारा कौन-सा छोटा पाप या साधु कार्य नहीं किया जाता?
verses.commentary: The demons recognize Prahlada's nature — he is not an ordinary child who can be bribed or threatened. His devotion is inherent, not learned. The verse acknowledges that Prahlada operates on a different moral plane where conventional categories of sin and virtue do not apply in the same way. His actions are expressions of his nature, not calculations of benefit.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं मां योजय दुर्जयेन दुष्टभावेन मानद । दम्भेन च महाराज दानवानां कुलक्षये ॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ māṃ yojaya durjayena duṣṭabhāvena mānada | dambhena ca mahārāja dānavānāṃ kulakṣaye ||
verses.translation: O pride-giver, unite me with that which is difficult to conquer — with evil-mindedness and with pride, O great king, which lead to the destruction of the demon race.
verses.hindi: हे मान-दाता! मुझे उस दुर्जय (दुष्टभावना) और दम्भ से मिला दो, हे महाराज! जो दानवों के कुल के क्षय का कारण है।
verses.commentary: Prahlada's prayer is the opposite of what his father wants — he asks to be united with the very qualities that destroy demons: pride and evil-mindedness. The deeper meaning: he wants to understand these forces completely so he can transcend them. Or alternatively, he is praying for the destruction of demonic qualities themselves, which ultimately leads to the liberation of even demons.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रं वीरं महाविष्णुं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् । नृसिंहं भीषणं भद्रं मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham | nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham ||
verses.translation: Fierce, heroic, the great Vishnu — blazing, facing all directions — Narasimha, terrifying, auspicious, the death of death — I bow to Him.
verses.hindi: उग्र, वीर, महाविष्णु — ज्वलन्त, सर्वतोमुख — नृसिंह, भीषण, भद्र, मृत्यु के मृत्यु — मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: The most celebrated dhyana-shloka (meditation verse) of the Narasimha tradition — structured as a series of apparent paradoxes that resolve into a single vision. "Ugram" (fierce) and "bhadram" (auspicious): the same form is both terrifying and gracious — terrifying to the unrighteous, gracious to the devoted. "Bhīṣaṇam" (horrifying) and "bhadram" (auspicious) in the same breath. "Mṛtyu-mṛtyum" — the death of death itself: Narasimha does not merely defeat death; he is the power that terminates the very principle of destruction. This verse is used as a kavacham (protective armour): by meditating on Narasimha as facing all directions (sarvatomukham), the devotee is surrounded on all sides by the same omnidirectional protection.

verses.sanskrit: यं दृष्ट्वा न भयं तस्य यं श्रुत्वा च न संशयः । यं ज्ञात्वा सर्वदुःखानि नश्यन्ते स नृकेसरी ॥
verses.transliteration: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhayaṃ tasya yaṃ śrutvā ca na saṃśayaḥ | yaṃ jñātvā sarvadhuḥkhāni naśyante sa nṛkesarī ||
verses.translation: One who sees Him has no fear; one who hears Him has no doubt; one who knows Him — all sorrows perish. He is Narasimha.
verses.hindi: जिसे देखकर भय नहीं रहता; जिसे सुनकर सन्देह नहीं रहता; जिसे जानकर सभी दुख नष्ट होते हैं — वही नृकेसरी हैं।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana's three-fold description of the liberation that Narasimha gives — structured through three modes of knowing: darshana (seeing/vision), shravana (hearing), and jnana (knowing). Each mode of engagement with Narasimha dissolves a specific form of suffering: seeing removes fear, hearing removes doubt, knowing removes all sorrow. This is the complete map of the inner obstacles to liberation: fear (the emotional level), doubt (the intellectual level), and sorrow (the existential level). Narasimha is the form of the divine that specifically addresses all three — because his story is simultaneously a vision (the terrifying, beautiful appearance from the pillar), a hearing (the roar that silences all other sounds), and a knowing (Prahlada's complete recognition of the divine).

verses.sanskrit: विप्रो वा श्वपचो वाऽपि यः कृष्णः सततं स्मरेत् । तं विद्याद्भागवतं श्रेष्ठं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vipro vā śvapaco vā'pi yaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satataṃ smaret | taṃ vidyādbhāgavataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam ||
verses.translation: Whether a brahmin or a candala — whoever constantly remembers Krishna — know that one to be the greatest of devotees, honoured in all worlds.
verses.hindi: चाहे ब्राह्मण हो या चाण्डाल — जो कृष्ण का सतत स्मरण करता है — उसे सर्वलोकों में पूजित श्रेष्ठ भागवत जानो।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana's most radical social teaching — placed in the mouth of Prahlada, who himself was born a demon. Vipra (brahmin — the highest varna) and shvapaca (candala — traditionally considered lowest of the low, an outcaste) are the two extreme poles of the social hierarchy. The verse demolishes both: the single criterion for being "the greatest devotee" is satatam smaranam — constant remembrance. Not birth, not learning, not ritual purity, not family lineage. This is the democratisation of bhakti taken to its logical conclusion: the criterion is entirely interior and entirely universal.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र सूर्यो भाति न चन्द्रतारकं नेमा विद्युतो भान्ति कुतोऽयमग्निः । तमेव भान्तमनुभाति सर्वं तस्य भासा सर्वमिदं विभाति ॥
verses.transliteration: na tatra sūryo bhāti na candratārakaṃ nemā vidyuto bhānti kuto'yamAgniḥ | tameva bhāntamanubhāti sarvaṃ tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti ||
verses.translation: The sun does not shine there, nor the moon and stars, nor lightning — what then of this fire? Everything shines after That shines — by That light, all this shines.
verses.hindi: वहाँ सूर्य नहीं चमकता, न चन्द्रमा-तारे, न विद्युत — तो यह अग्नि क्या चमकेगी? वह शिनता है तो सब चमकते हैं — उसी के प्रकाश से यह सब चमकता है।
verses.commentary: Prahlada quotes the Mundaka and Katha Upanishads (Katha 2.2.15, Mundaka 2.2.10, Shvetashvatara 6.14) directly in the Narasimha Purana — demonstrating that he is not merely an emotionally devoted child but a complete jnani who understands the metaphysical basis of his fearlessness. The sun, moon, stars, lightning, fire — all borrowed light. There is one self-luminous source from which all luminosity is borrowed. Prahlada's fearlessness is not stubbornness; it is the recognition that the source of all light — including the light in his father's eyes — is the same Vishnu. How can Prahlada fear what Vishnu illuminates?

verses.science: प्रह्लाद को अपने सामने खड़ा करके, क्रोध से भरे हुए, क्रुद्ध राजा हिरण्यकशिपु स्वयं अपने पुत्र से बोला। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उग्रं वीरं महाविष्णुं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् । नृसिंहं भीषणं भद्रं मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham | nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham ||
verses.translation: Fierce, heroic, the great Vishnu — blazing, facing all directions — Narasimha, terrifying, auspicious, the death of death — I bow to Him.
verses.hindi: उग्र, वीर, महाविष्णु — ज्वलन्त, सर्वतोमुख — नृसिंह, भीषण, भद्र, मृत्यु के मृत्यु — मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: The most celebrated dhyana-shloka (meditation verse) of the Narasimha tradition — structured as a series of apparent paradoxes that resolve into a single vision. "Ugram" (fierce) and "bhadram" (auspicious): the same form is both terrifying and gracious — terrifying to the unrighteous, gracious to the devoted. "Bhīṣaṇam" (horrifying) and "bhadram" (auspicious) in the same breath. "Mṛtyu-mṛtyum" — the death of death itself: Narasimha does not merely defeat death; he is the power that terminates the very principle of destruction. This verse is used as a kavacham (protective armour): by meditating on Narasimha as facing all directions (sarvatomukham), the devotee is surrounded on all sides by the same omnidirectional protection.

verses.sanskrit: नैतदद्भुतमेव त्वं हिरण्यकशिपोः सुत । प्रह्लादात्तव किं क्षुद्रं पापं वा साधु वा कृतम् ॥
verses.transliteration: naitadadbhutameva tvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ suta | prahlādātta kiṃ kṣudraṃ pāpaṃ vā sādhu vā kṛtam ||
verses.translation: This is not at all surprising in you, O son of Hiranyakashipu. For what small sin or good deed is not done by Prahlada?
verses.hindi: हे हिरण्यकशिपु के पुत्र! तुममें यह कुछ भी आश्चर्यजनक नहीं है। क्योंकि प्रह्लाद द्वारा कौन-सा छोटा पाप या साधु कार्य नहीं किया जाता?
verses.commentary: The demons recognize Prahlada's nature — he is not an ordinary child who can be bribed or threatened. His devotion is inherent, not learned. The verse acknowledges that Prahlada operates on a different moral plane where conventional categories of sin and virtue do not apply in the same way. His actions are expressions of his nature, not calculations of benefit.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं मां योजय दुर्जयेन दुष्टभावेन मानद । दम्भेन च महाराज दानवानां कुलक्षये ॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ māṃ yojaya durjayena duṣṭabhāvena mānada | dambhena ca mahārāja dānavānāṃ kulakṣaye ||
verses.translation: O pride-giver, unite me with that which is difficult to conquer — with evil-mindedness and with pride, O great king, which lead to the destruction of the demon race.
verses.hindi: हे मान-दाता! मुझे उस दुर्जय (दुष्टभावना) और दम्भ से मिला दो, हे महाराज! जो दानवों के कुल के क्षय का कारण है।
verses.commentary: Prahlada's prayer is the opposite of what his father wants — he asks to be united with the very qualities that destroy demons: pride and evil-mindedness. The deeper meaning: he wants to understand these forces completely so he can transcend them. Or alternatively, he is praying for the destruction of demonic qualities themselves, which ultimately leads to the liberation of even demons.

verses.sanskrit: यं दृष्ट्वा न भयं तस्य यं श्रुत्वा च न संशयः । यं ज्ञात्वा सर्वदुःखानि नश्यन्ते स नृकेसरी ॥
verses.transliteration: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhayaṃ tasya yaṃ śrutvā ca na saṃśayaḥ | yaṃ jñātvā sarvadhuḥkhāni naśyante sa nṛkesarī ||
verses.translation: One who sees Him has no fear; one who hears Him has no doubt; one who knows Him — all sorrows perish. He is Narasimha.
verses.hindi: जिसे देखकर भय नहीं रहता; जिसे सुनकर सन्देह नहीं रहता; जिसे जानकर सभी दुख नष्ट होते हैं — वही नृकेसरी हैं।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana's three-fold description of the liberation that Narasimha gives — structured through three modes of knowing: darshana (seeing/vision), shravana (hearing), and jnana (knowing). Each mode of engagement with Narasimha dissolves a specific form of suffering: seeing removes fear, hearing removes doubt, knowing removes all sorrow. This is the complete map of the inner obstacles to liberation: fear (the emotional level), doubt (the intellectual level), and sorrow (the existential level). Narasimha is the form of the divine that specifically addresses all three — because his story is simultaneously a vision (the terrifying, beautiful appearance from the pillar), a hearing (the roar that silences all other sounds), and a knowing (Prahlada's complete recognition of the divine).

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहः पूर्वतो मां पायात् वायव्यां नरकेसरी । प्रतीच्यां पातु वाराहो याम्यां पातु जनार्दनः ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃhaḥ pūrvato māṃ pāyāt vāyavyāṃ narakesarī | pratīcyāṃ pātu vārāho yāmyāṃ pātu janārdanaḥ ||
verses.translation: May Narasimha protect me from the East; in the Northwest, the man-lion; in the West, Varaha; in the South, Janardana.
verses.hindi: पूर्व दिशा में नृसिंह मेरी रक्षा करें; वायव्य में नरकेसरी; पश्चिम में वाराह; दक्षिण में जनार्दन।
verses.commentary: The kavacham operates through a principle fundamental to all protective prayer traditions: the systematic consecration of space. By naming a specific divine form in each cardinal and inter-cardinal direction, the devotee creates a sacred enclosure — a templum (from which our word "temple" derives) — in which every direction is held by a specific face of the divine. Narasimha is described as "sarvatomukham" (facing all directions) — the kavacham makes this abstract attribute spatially concrete. The practitioner is literally placing themselves at the centre of a divine mandala and asking each face to look toward them.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् । सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukham | sarvataḥ śrutiMalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||
verses.translation: With hands and feet everywhere, eyes, heads and faces everywhere, with ears everywhere in the world — it stands pervading everything.
verses.hindi: सब ओर हाथ-पैर वाला, सब ओर आँख-सिर-मुख वाला, सब ओर कान वाला — वह सब कुछ आवृत्त करके स्थित है।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana quotes the Bhagavad Gita's Vishvarupa description (13.13) as the metaphysical ground of the kavacham. The divine being has "hands and feet everywhere" — omnipresence is not a vague quality but a specific ontological claim: every point in space is a location of the divine's hands, feet, eyes, and ears. This is not pantheism (the claim that the world IS God) but panentheism (the claim that the world exists WITHIN God, who is also beyond it). The kavacham is the practical application: if the divine is literally omnipresent, then every direction in which you could look is a direction in which the divine is already looking back at you.

verses.translation: Placing Prahlada before him, filled with anger, the enraged king Hiranyakashipu himself spoke to his son.

verses.science: जिसे देखकर भय नहीं रहता; जिसे सुनकर सन्देह नहीं रहता; जिसे जानकर सभी दुख नष्ट होते हैं — वही नृकेसरी हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यः स्मरते हरिम् । स मुक्तो भवति क्षिप्रं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
verses.transliteration: abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaḥ smarate harim | sa mukto bhavati kṣipraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
verses.translation: One who grants fearlessness to all beings and remembers Hari — that one is quickly liberated. No deliberation need be made about this.
verses.hindi: जो सभी प्राणियों को अभय देकर हरि का स्मरण करता है — वह शीघ्र मुक्त हो जाता है। इसमें कोई विचार करने की आवश्यकता नहीं।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana's most surprising teaching: the means of liberation is not merely receiving fearlessness (abhaya) from Narasimha but giving fearlessness (abhaya-danam) to all beings. The devotee who has been protected by Narasimha becomes a giver of protection to others. The divine fearlessness flows through the devotee into the world. "Abhaya-danam" — the gift of fearlessness — is considered the highest of all gifts in the Narasimha tradition: greater than gold, land, or food, because it addresses the root of all suffering (fear) rather than its symptoms. And the mechanism of liberation: it is quick (kṣipraṃ) and certain (no deliberation needed) — the same formula Narasimha uses for his own protective action.

verses.sanskrit: यं दृष्ट्वा न भयं तस्य यं श्रुत्वा च न संशयः । यं ज्ञात्वा सर्वदुःखानि नश्यन्ते स नृकेसरी ॥
verses.transliteration: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhayaṃ tasya yaṃ śrutvā ca na saṃśayaḥ | yaṃ jñātvā sarvadhuḥkhāni naśyante sa nṛkesarī ||
verses.translation: One who sees Him has no fear; one who hears Him has no doubt; one who knows Him — all sorrows perish. He is Narasimha.
verses.hindi: जिसे देखकर भय नहीं रहता; जिसे सुनकर सन्देह नहीं रहता; जिसे जानकर सभी दुख नष्ट होते हैं — वही नृकेसरी हैं।
verses.commentary: The Narasimha Purana's three-fold description of the liberation that Narasimha gives — structured through three modes of knowing: darshana (seeing/vision), shravana (hearing), and jnana (knowing). Each mode of engagement with Narasimha dissolves a specific form of suffering: seeing removes fear, hearing removes doubt, knowing removes all sorrow. verses.sanskrit: प्रह्लादं पुरतः कृत्वा क्रोधाविष्टः सुतं ततः । उवाच रुषितो राजा हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prahlādaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā krodhāviṣṭaḥ sutaṃ tataḥ | uvāca ruṣito rājā hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam ||
verses.translation: Placing Prahlada before him, filled with anger, the enraged king Hiranyakashipu himself spoke to his son.
verses.hindi: प्रह्लाद को अपने सामने खड़ा करके, क्रोध से भरे हुए, क्रुद्ध राजा हिरण्यकशिपु स्वयं अपने पुत्र से बोला।
verses.commentary: The confrontation scene: Hiranyakashipu, the powerful demon king who had conquered the three worlds, stands before his own son who defies him. The irony is profound — the father who demanded worship as a god faces a son who worships the true God. This moment captures the eternal conflict between worldly power and spiritual conviction.
verses.wordMeaning: The confrontation scene: Hiranyakashipu, the powerful demon king who had conquered the three worlds, stands before his own son who defies him. verses.sanskrit: उग्रं वीरं महाविष्णुं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् । नृसिंहं भीषणं भद्रं मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham | nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham ||
verses.translation: Fierce, heroic, the great Vishnu — blazing, facing all directions — Narasimha, terrifying, auspicious, the death of death — I bow to Him.
verses.hindi: उग्र, वीर, महाविष्णु — ज्वलन्त, सर्वतोमुख — नृसिंह, भीषण, भद्र, मृत्यु के मृत्यु — मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: The most celebrated dhyana-shloka (meditation verse) of the Narasimha tradition — structured as a series of apparent paradoxes that resolve into a single vision. "Ugram" (fierce) and "bhadram" (auspicious): the same form is both terrifying and gracious — terrifying to the unrighteous, gracious to the devoted. "Bhīṣaṇam" (horrifying) and "bhadram" (auspicious) in the same breath. "Mṛtyu-mṛtyum" — the death of death itself: Narasimha does not merely defeat death; he is the power that terminates the very principle of destruction. This verse is used as a kavacham (protective armour): by meditating on Narasimha as facing all directions (sarvatomukham), the devotee is surrounded on all sides by the same omnidirectional protection.

verses.science: श्रीभरद्वाजजी बोले-महामते! अब मुझसे 'रुद्रसर्ग' का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन कीजिये तथा यह भी बताइये कि मरीचि आदि ऋषियोंने पहले किस प्रकार सृष्टि को? महाबुद्धिमान्…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रसृष्टिं प्रवक्ष्यामि तत्सर्गाश् चैव सत्तम प्रतिसर्गं मुनीनां तु विस्तराद् वदतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: rudrasṛṣṭiṃ pravakṣyāmi tatsargāś caiva sattama pratisargaṃ munīnāṃ tu vistarād vadataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: By Sarga is meant the generation of the five Mahabhuta, wisdom and the senses as aforesaid as created by the great soul Lord Narayana just at the beginning of the creation. Subsequently, he himself appears in the form of Brahma with four heads and hermits like Marlci etc. during the phase of Anusarga and thus, created the universe.
verses.hindi: हे सत्तम, मैं रुद्र-सृष्टि और उनके वंश-विस्तार तथा मुनियों द्वारा किए गए प्रतिसर्ग का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन करता हूँ; आप ध्यानपूर्वक सुनिए।
verses.wordMeaning: By Sarga is meant the generation of the five Mahabhuta, wisdom and the senses as aforesaid as created by the great soul Lord Narayana just at the beginning of the creation. Subsequently, he himself appears in the form of Brahma with four heads and hermits like Marlci etc.…

verses.sanskrit: कल्पादाव् आत्मनस् तुल्यं सुतं प्रध्यायतस् ततः प्रादुरासीत् प्रभोर् अङ्के कुमारो नीललोहितः

verses.translation: Thus, the fourth chapter on creator of Anusarga in Sri Nrsimha Purar.a approaches the end.

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the fourth chapter on creator of Anusarga in Sri Nrsimha Purar.a approaches the end.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनारीनरवपुः प्रचण्डो ऽतिशरीरवान् तेजसा भासयन् सर्वा दिशश् च प्रदिशश् च सः
verses.transliteration: ardhanārīnaravapuḥ pracaṇḍo 'tiśarīravān tejasā bhāsayan sarvā diśaś ca pradiśaś ca saḥ
verses.translation: Brahma how is it that he became the son of Mitravaruna.
verses.hindi: वे अर्धनारीश्वर स्वरूप वाले, प्रचंड और विशाल शरीर वाले थे तथा अपने तेज से संपूर्ण दिशाओं और उपदिशाओं को प्रकाशित कर रहे थे।
verses.commentary: Sense: by virtue of thinking of lord Brahma how is it that he became the son of Mitravaruna.
verses.science: और रैवत-ये “ग्यारह रुद्र' कहे गये हैं, जो तीनों स्त्रीत्वं चैव तथा रुद्रो बिभेद दशधेकधा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा तेजसा दीप्तं प्रत्युवाच प्रजापतिः विभजात्मानम् अद्य त्वं मम वाक्यान् महामते

verses.science: देवादिस्थावरान्ताश्च प्रजाः सृष्टाः स्वयम्भुवा नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अजैकपाद् अहिर्बुध्न्यः कपाली रुद्र एव च हरश् च बहुरूपश् च त्र्यम्बकश् चापराजितः
verses.transliteration: ajaikapād ahirbudhnyaḥ kapālī rudra eva ca haraś ca bahurūpaś ca tryambakaś cāparājitaḥ
verses.translation: Description of Rudra and other Sargas, the expansion of the children of the daughters of Dak$a Prajapati.
verses.hindi: अजैकपात्, अहिर्बुध्न्य, कपाली, रुद्र, हर, बहुरूप, त्र्यंबक और अपराजित—
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of Rudra and other Sargas, the expansion of the children of the daughters of Dak$a Prajapati.
verses.science: सृष्टिकाले महाभागौ ब्रह्मन् स्वायम्भुवोदतौ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृषाकपिश् च शंभुश् च कपर्दी रैवतस् तथा एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास् त्रिभुवनेश्वराः

verses.science: बुद्धिर्लजा वपुः शान्ति: सिद्धि कीर्तिस्वयोदशी। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृत्वा जले घोरम् उत्तीर्णः स यदा पुरा तदा स सृष्टवान् देवो रुद्रस् तत्र प्रतापवान्

verses.commentary: Sense: Bharadvaja said- O the wisest, please describe now in detail the Rudra-sarga and also tell how the hermits Marlci etc., had participated in the mission of creation. Learned Suta, when Vasistha was created
verses.science: रुद्र आदि सर्गो और अनुसर्गोका वर्णन; दक्ष प्रजापतिकी कन्याओंकी संततिका विस्तार भुवनोंके स्वामी हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपोबलेन विप्रेन्द्र भूतानि विविधानि च पिशाचान् राक्षसांश् चैव सिंहोष्ट्रमकराननान्
verses.transliteration: tapobalena viprendra bhūtāni vividhāni ca piśācān rākṣasāṃś caiva siṃhoṣṭramakarānanān
verses.translation: Suta said- O the crown of saints, I will now provide with description on the creation made by Rudra and the sargas embedded with the same according to the question raised by you. I will concomitantly, tell in detail the Pratisarga (Anusarga) as laid down by the hermits. Please, listen to the same attentively. Just at the beginning of the creation, lord Brahma was plunged into deep thought of obtaining a son as mighty as he himself. Very soon a baby appeared in his lap whose form was reddish-blue. Half of his body was of a woman and the rest was of a man. He was stubborn and gigantic and all directions and angular directions were illuminating by the light coming out from his body. Having seen him so glowing with light, Prajapati said- "O wise child, go on my words and divide your body into two parts."
verses.hindi: हे विप्रेन्द्र, अपने तपोबल से उन्होंने अनेक प्रकार के भूत, पिशाच, राक्षस तथा सिंह, ऊँट और मकर के समान मुख वाले गणों को उत्पन्न किया।

verses.sanskrit: यदास्य च प्रजाः सर्वा न व्यवर्धन्त धीमतः तदा मानसपुत्रान् स सदृशान् आत्मनो ऽसृजत्

verses.translation: O Brahmana, complying with the suggestions of Brahma, the gallant Rudra separated his masculine and feminine parts of the body so combined at that time. He then divided the masculine part into eleven forms which were known as - Ajaikapada, Ahirbudhnya, Kapall, Hara, Bahurupa, Tryambaka, Aparajita, Vrsakapi, Sambhu, and Raivata,. These eleven are Rudra and govern the three worlds (lokas). The feminine part of the body was also divided into eleven parts, the same way as that of the masculine part. Goddess Uma is the only wife in her varied forms to all these Rudras.
verses.hindi: जब उन बुद्धिमान ब्रह्माजी की वे समस्त प्रजाएँ आगे नहीं बढ़ीं, तब उन्होंने अपने ही समान तेजस्वी मानस पुत्रों की सृष्टि की।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmana, complying with the suggestions of Brahma, the gallant Rudra separated his masculine and feminine parts of the body so combined at that time. He then divided the masculine part into eleven forms which were known as - Ajaikapada, Ahirbudhnya, Kapall, Hara, Bahurupa,…

verses.translation: O the crown of Brahmins, during the long-long past the gallant lord Rudra came out from the water of completion of his steadfast penance. He then created a number of creatures by virtue of his power so obtained from the penance. He generated the lion, camel, the devils whose mouth was akin to that of a crocodile, the monsters and vetala etc., including many other thousands of creatures. He thus generated thirty crore

verses.science: देवानृषींश्च ॒गन्धर्वानसुरान् पन्नगांस्तथा यदास्य मनसा जाता नाभ्यवर्धन्त ते द्विज तदा संचिन्त्य स मुनिः सृष्टिहेतोः प्रजापतिः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.translation: I am now going to describe the Anusarga pertaining to the etc., hermits, please listen to it attentively. Svayambhu Brahma had created the subject encompassing from the gods to the immovable. However, the subject so generated could not avail of expansion and it made lord Brahma to think of creating a son analogous to him and by virtue of his mental power, he generated Atri, Aiigira, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Praceta, Vasistha and the wisest Bhrgu. These people have been ascertained as nine Brahmas in the Purana. Brahmin the fire and the Pitrns (ancestors) too are the sons created by the mind of lord Brahma. Both of them had been created by Svayambhu Brahma in the beginning phase of creation. He then generated a daughter Satarupa and entrusted her to Manu.

verses.translation: The goddess Satarupa had given birth to two sons namely, Priyavrata and Uttanapada as a result of coition with the Svayambhuva Manu. She then gave birth to a daughter whose name was Prasuti. Svayambhuva Manu married his daughter to Daksa. Daksa gave birth to the twenty four daughters as a result of his coition with Prasuti. The names of those daughters were- Sraddha, Laksmi, Dhrti, Tusti, Pusti, Medha, Kriya, Buddhi, Lajja, Vapu, Santi, Siddhi and the name of thirteenth daughter was Kirti. Lord Dharma made all these his wives for reproduction of children. The sons Kama etc. were born from Sraddha etc., wives of Dharma. The race of Dharma attained enough growth with the sons and the grand sons.

Respected Brahmin, the hermit Daksa had at first created by virtue of his mental power, the creatures like gods, hermits, gandharva, monster and the snake. However, when he saw that the god etc. sarga, created by application of mind are not availing of the growth, he then determined doing creation through the coition process and solemnised marriage with Asikni, the daughter of Vlrana Prajapati. We have heard that Daksa Prajapati had given birth to sixty daughters from the womb of ten daughters with Dharma and thirteen with the hermit Kasyapa. He then entrusted twenty seven daughters to the Moon, four to Aristanemi

verses.translation: The daughter named Visva gave birth to Visvedevas and Sadhya to the Sadhyas. Marutvatl gave birth to Marutvan (the wind) Vasu to Vasus, Bhanu to Bhanu devata and Muhurta to the gods pertaining to the Muhurta. Larnba gave birth to the son Ghosa, Jami got a daughter namely, Nagavlthi and Arundhatl generated all the creatures of this earth. O the great learned, Sarnkalpa got birth from the daughter Samkalpa. Listen to the names of the eight Vasus whose breathing are the light and the wealth. These are Apa, Dhruva, Soma, Dharma, Anila, Anala, Pratyusa and Prabhasa. The number of their sons and grandsons have increased to many hundreds of thousands. A AT# A

verses.translation: Similarly, the number of the Sadhyas is ever-increasing and they too have thousands of sons. verses.translation: Vinata gave birth to two famous sons known as Garuda and Aruna. Garuda affectionately accepted to became a vehicle for lord Visnu and Aruna became the charioteer of lord sun god. Tamra gave birth to six sons from Kasyapa. They were - horse, camel, donkey, elephant, Gavaya and deer. All organism wicked by nature have been generated from the disgust. Ira gave birth to the tree, creeper, valll and the straw species sana. Khasa gave birth to demigods and monsters while Muni gave birth to the Apsaras (the divine damsels). Kadru gave birth to the poisonous snakes known as Dandasuka. Brahmin, the twenty seven spouses of beautiful moon had given birth to the Budha etc., sons who were full of vigour and valour. The wives of Aristanemi had given birth to sixteen children. fgsig: i 3MT

verses.translation: The four colour lightning are called the four children of the learned Bahuputra. Their names were - Kapila, Atilohita, Pita and Sita. The sons of Pratyangira were the great hermits who attained honour from all the saints and hermits. The sons of Devarsi Krsaswa became Devarsi. These run with the cycle of birth automatically on expiry of the eras, one each (i.e. on expiry of a kalpa). Thus, the movable and immovable creatures born in the race of Kasyapa have been described. The traditional ascending of the race of the Daksas daughters has also been explained in detail. The outstanding figures, always engaged in performing the great deed of lord Nrsimha, have been described before you all here. The person who takes into account this description with due diligence and honour, attains to the handsome children. I have now told you all regarding the sarga and anusarga generated by lord Brahma and other Prajapatis for extending the scope of creation. The people (Dvijati) going over these contexts always with due respect for lord Visnu, shall definitely become sacred in their hearts.

verses.translation: (Vidyas), had solemnised the marriage of his thirteen beautiful daughters, all lotus¬ eyed and endowed with the best characteristics, with Muni Kasyapa. I tell their names now. Please, listen to these. They were - Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kala, Muhurta, Simhika, Muni, Ira, Krodha, Surabhi, Vinata, Surasa, Khasa, Kadru and Sarama (called bitch of the gods). Daksa, was the greatest and oldest among them.

verses.translation: Aditi had given birth to twelve sons. These were of so fair complexion and full of splendour as that of fire (Agni) itself. I am going to tell their names, please listen them from me. These were - Bhaga, Aiiisu, Aryama, Mitra, Varuna, Savita, Dhata, Vivasvana, Tvasta, Pusa, Indra and the twelfth was lord Visnu. The cycle of the day and night incessantly and unbarred runs under the monitoring and control of them. These twelve Adityas provide us with heat and rain as well.
verses.hindi: हे महामति, सविता, धाता, विवस्वान्, त्वष्टा, पूषा, इंद्र और बारहवें भगवान विष्णु कहे गए हैं।

verses.translation: The middle son of Aditi was Varuna. He is called Lokapala. His location has been said to be at the (the west). These are adorned at the sea-shore in the west direction. There exists a beautiful golden mountain. All its peaks are full of the treasure of gems. Several kinds of metals and fountains are found therein. The mountain consisting these and a number of gems looks enchanting. There are large passages and caves as well where tigers and lions can be seen roaring all the time. The Siddhas and Gandharvas are accommodated therein at all and many solitary places. The whole world falls in the lap of dark when the sun enters there.
verses.hindi: विविध रत्नों से सुशोभित वह पावन गिरिराज विशाल कंदराओं और गुफाओं में सिंहों तथा शार्दूलों की गर्जना से गूँजता रहता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The middle son of Aditi was Varuna. He is called Lokapala. His location has been said to be at the Varuna-Disi (the west). These are adorned at the sea-shore in the west direction. There exists a beautiful golden mountain. All its peaks are full of the treasure of gems.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The middle son of Aditi was Varuna. He is called Lokapala. His location has been said to be at the Varuna-Disi (the west). These are adorned at the sea-shore in the west direction. There exists a beautiful golden mountain. All its peaks are full of the treasure of gems.…

verses.translation: There at the peak of the same mountain, a city namely, Vis'vavatl is situated there which was built by Visvakarma. It is a giant city rendering divine pleasure and gold has been used for its construction gem minarets have been installed in the buildings constructed there. That city is fascinating and enriched with all kinds of luxuries. The Aditya, namely, Varuna, under the influence of lord Brahma, rests there and provides all the worlds (three in number) with light. The Gandharva and divine damsels always serve him.
verses.hindi: उसका नाम विश्वावती पुरी है जो समस्त भोग-साधनों से समृद्ध है। उसी पुरी में अपने तेज से दैदीप्यमान आदित्य वरुण निवास करते हैं।

On arriving at Kuruksetra, the pilgrim place, made abode by the Brahmarsis, enriched with several kinds of flowers and fruits, covered with a number of sacred places, hermitages of Urdhvareta Munis and abundant source of water; both of the deities had worn Clra and the hide of the black deer and seated themselves for penance.

verses.translation: A beautiful pond, full of pure water is situated there in one portion of the forest. It is covered with a number of shrubs and creepers. Numerous birds sip the water of that pond. A cluster of trees and lotus flowers has enhanced the beauty of that pond. It is popular as Paundarlka and numerous fishes and tortoises live within its water. After the initiation of penance, both the brothers i.e. Mitra and Varuna once started moving in the forest in order to identify the whole area. In course of their walking, they found that pond.

verses.translation: II Both of them saw that a most beautiful Apsara was taking a dip with her mates in the same pond. That beautiful Apsara used to laugh and sing without hesitation assuming that it was altogether a deserted place. She was of fair complexion. Her gait was tender as that of the inner petals of a lotus flower. Her brows were raven coloured and smooth, eyes like lotus, lips dark red, her tone was full of melody, her teeth were as white as conch-shell, kund flower and the moon. The brows, nose, mouth and forehead of that enchanting damsel were most beautiful. Her waist zone was as thin as that of a lion, hips, pubic and legs were thick and formidable. She was humble in speech. Her middle portion of body was fascinating and her smile was dazzling. Both hands were as delicate and pretty as a red lotus. Her body was thinly built and feet were beautiful. Her mouth (face) was as pleasing as the full moon and her motion was as slow as that of an intoxicated elephant.

verses.translation: Both the deities fell in surprise merely at a glance of her divine complexion. Their mind was more enchanted by seeing her dance, humour, gait, smiling and by listening to her melodious song as also the touch of breeze blowing from the Malaya mountain and the murmuring sound of the bees and sweet chirping of cuckoo. The cross winking of threw fuel to their sensual fire which had discharged them (i.e. their semen was discharged). O the great Muni, the living soul (Jlvatma) of Vasistha then (inserted in the semen of Mitravaruna) owing to the curse of Nimi. Then Vasudeva had pronounced (by entering into the semen of Nimi) "Vasistha, you shall be the son of Mitravaruna". The same statement was also given by lord Brahma. Hence, out of the three places where the semen was discharged from Mitravaruna, the semen dropped on the lotus had gave birth to Vasistha.

verses.translation: Brahmin, I have thus told all about the context pertaining to the event of the birth of sacred Vasistha and the wisest Agastya from Mitravaruna. This account of the reproduction of Varuna deity is capable of absolving all sins. The people desirous of children who do the sacred resolution and listen to this episode, definitely obtain several sons. The Brahmin reciting it while performing havya (offering for the deity) and havya (offering for the pitaras), satisfies both i.e. the gods and the ancestors. The man reciting it early in the morning or listening to it; lives on the earth with all pleasures at hand and attains the abode of lord Visnu on death. This episode as explained by me and propounded by the scholars of the Vedas, will make able the persons either reciting or listening to it to attain the abode of lord Visnu without much effort as it automatically purifies their hearts to the extent that they perform philanthropic deeds.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य प्रतिदिन प्रातःकाल उठकर इस आख्यान को सुनता है, वह पृथ्वी पर सुखपूर्वक आनंद मनाता है और अंत में विष्णुलोक को जाता है।

Krsnadvaipayana was seated on the Vyasapltha at that time in Kuruksetra after the due performance of the bathe and japa. He was then surrounded by a number of his pupils. Sukadeva bowed before him duly with clasped hands and

verses.translation: An astrologer, well-versed in prediction had pronounced on the birth of Markandeya that he would die on completion of the twelfth year since birth. The parents were badly shocked at hearing that prediction. Their heart started shivering with the apprehension of his premature death, yet they performed all ceremonies including Namakarana etc. Subsequently, he was taken to the teacher. And Upanayana Samskara was performed therein. He began to live in the service of the teacher stalwartly and involved himself deep in the study of the Vedas.

The wise Markandeya fell in surprise and asked the reason for all this from his mother. When Markandeya stress on his enquiry for the reason, the mother told everything once predicted by an astrologer. Hearing this, Markandeya said to his parents - "Mother, father and you yourself needn't worry about the matter. Have faith in me and I declare that I will conquer the death by virtue of the toughest penance. I will perform a penance so acute as to bless me with longevity.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रसादान् महाभाग नारदो ब्रह्मणः सुतः जरां मृत्युं विजित्याशु दीर्घायुर् वर्धते सुखम्

verses.translation: Solacing his parent with these words, he went into the forest of which was surrounded by a number of hermits. The hermit Markandeya saw his grand-father Bhrgu there in the group of Munis. Religion abiding Markandeya bowed at the feet of his grand father and saluted all other Munis present there. He then stood with clasped hands before him. The scholar Bhrgu saw his grandson whose age was at the verge of cessation and said- "Dear son, tell me how have you come here? How are your parents and all other kinsmen and tell me the reason for your arrival?" Markandeya told everything as was predicted by an astrologer in his reply. Having heard his grandson, Bhrgu enquired again - "O wise son, what do you want to do in the present circumstance?"
verses.hindi: 'हे महाभाग, उन्हीं की कृपा से ब्रह्माजी के पुत्र नारद वृद्धावस्था और मृत्यु को जीतकर शीघ्र ही दीर्घायु हो सुखपूर्वक विचरण करते हैं।'

verses.translation: Bhrgu replied- Dear son, who can conquer the death without the grace and pleasure of Lord Narayana obtained as a result of severe penance? Hence, you are advised to sit in penance for lord Narayana. Go to the shelter of that everlasting, the greatest god, beloved to the devotees, unborn, solitary and Purusottama lord Visnu. Son, Narada Muni in the ancient ages, had also resorted to that lord Narayana by virtue of his severe penance and it was by the grace of the lord that he since then enjoys longevity and has conquered both old age and death. No man here can efface the entity of the death without the grace of the lotus-eyed, Nrsirhha form, lord Janardana. Go in the everlasting shelter of that immortal, unborn conqueror, of dark complexion, Govinda, Gopati lord Visnu. Dear son, you will undoubtedly conquer the death for ever, if you could maintain undisturbed concentration of mind on that lord.

verses.translation: Vyasa said- Dear son, hearing these words, Markandeya saluted his grand father and went to the land for penance (tapovana) situated at the bank of river Turigabhadra, surrounded by different kinds of trees and creepers, flowers, gulma and Venus as also filled with numerous hermits. He established lord Visnu there and started worship by offering fragrance and flowers in an orderly manner. He kicked off laxity, the desire for food and sat in penance not
verses.hindi: वे ब्रह्मस्वरूप भगवान हरि का ध्यान करते हुए 'ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय' इस महामंत्र का उच्चारण करने लगे।

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं ध्यायतस् तस्य मार्कण्डेयस्य धीमतः मनस् तत्रैव संलग्नं देवदेवे जगत्पतौ
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ dhyāyatas tasya mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ manas tatraiva saṃlagnaṃ devadeve jagatpatau
verses.translation: The material time as told by the mother then came and he worshipped lord Visnu in the said manner tied up body on Svastika posture, controlled the senses in the mind and did Pranayama with the pure heart. He started extending the lotus heart with the recital of the syllable Orn, imagined the sun, moon and focused his nerves exclusively in imagination of lord Krsna with his Pitambara, conch-shell, discus and gada. Thus, he started offering spiritual flowers to the lord. At that self-forgetting penance, he started reciting the hymn - "Om Namo
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार ध्यानमग्न बुद्धिमान मार्कण्डेय का मन पूर्णतः देवाधिदेव जगत्पति भगवान विष्णु में ही संलग्न था।
verses.wordMeaning: lesser than the period of a year. The material time as told by the mother then came and he worshipped lord Visnu in the said manner tied up body on Svastika posture, controlled the senses in the mind and did Pranayama with the pure heart.…
verses.commentary: Sense: lesser than the period of a year. The material time as told by the mother then came and he worshipped lord Visnu in the said manner tied up body on Svastika posture, controlled the senses in the mind and did Pranayama with the pure heart.…
verses.science: त्वां प्रपन्नोऽस्मि शरणं देवदेव जनार्दन। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो यमाज्ञया तत्र आगता यमकिंकराः पाशहस्तास् तु तं नेतुं विष्णुदूतैस् तु ते हताः

verses.sanskrit: शूलैः प्रहन्यमानास् तु द्विजं मुक्त्वा ययुस् तदा वयं निवर्त्य गच्छामो मृत्युर् एवागमिष्यति

verses.translation: Vyasa said- Dear Sukadeva, the mind of Markandeya was fully engrossed with the sovereign god Jagadls'vara in the state of so severe meditation. The representatives of Yama then came there with pasa (cord) in their hands but the representatives of lord Visnu had driven them away. Frightened of the pain inflicted on them by spears, they had to flee from there but they warned Markandeya that the god of death himself will come henceforth and he will predate his breathing.
verses.hindi: शूलों से प्रताड़ित होकर वे उस द्विज को छोड़कर यह कहते हुए लौट गए—'हम वापस जाते हैं, अब स्वयं मृत्यु ही आएँगे।'
verses.wordMeaning: Vyasa said- Dear Sukadeva, the mind of Markandeya was fully engrossed with the sovereign god Jagadls'vara in the state of so severe meditation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa said- Dear Sukadeva, the mind of Markandeya was fully engrossed with the sovereign god Jagadls'vara in the state of so severe meditation.…
verses.science: भक्तप्रियाय देवाय रक्षाय हरये नमः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्र नः स्वामिनो नाम लोकनाथस्य शार्ङ्गिणः को यमस् तत्र मृत्युर् वा कालः कलयतां वरः

verses.translation: I Visnudutas replied- The Yama can do no

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य स्वयम् एवाह मृत्युः पार्श्वं महात्मनः मार्कण्डेयस्य बभ्राम विष्णुकिंकरशङ्कया

verses.translation: Vis nu, the master of this universe, holder of the Sarhga-bow is recited. The predator Kala, death or Yamaraja has no power to act voluntarily.

verses.commentary: Sense: harm where the pious name of our lord Vis nu, the master of this universe, holder of the Sarhga-bow is recited. The predator Kala, death or Yamaraja has no power to act voluntarily.

verses.translation: Vyasa said- Yama himself came there on return of the Dutas and ordered him to accompany him to the abode of Yama. However, owing to fear of Visnudutas he only roamed round Markandeya but could not dare to touch him. The Dutas of lord Visnu too stood with the iron musalas with the intention that they would slaughter Yama in compliance with the order of lord Visnu. The learned Markandeya in the meantime started praying to the lord without deviating his attention from Visnu. The psalm which he was reciting, was given by lord Visnu to him in the ear. Thus, with the very psalm he worshipped

verses.translation: Markandeya said- I salute Sri Narayana, who has one thousand eyes, master of the senses the Puratana Purusa, and Padmanabha (who had generated the world (Brahmanda) lotus from his navel). What will the death do me? What harm the will death do to me when I have sheltered under the everlasting, unborn, indeclinable, Govinda, lotus-eyed lord Kesava? What harm will the death do to me when 1 have come to the shelter of lord Damodara, the place of origin of the world, full of light like the sun, and omnipresent Vasudeva? What harm may the death do to me when I am in shelter to lord Adhoksaja, with conch-shell and discus, who is free from the distortions and who is in inexpressive form? What may the death do to me when I am in shelter to Varaha, Vamana, Visnu, Nrsimha, Janardana and Madhava?

verses.translation: The lord himself had preached this all sacrosanct Mrtyunjaya strata, effacing the death to Markandeya in order to save him from the clutches of death. verses.translation: The death and Yamadutas said- O king, listen to what we are going to report to you. We went near Markandeya, the grand- son of Bhrgu, leaving behind the death according to your orders given. However, he has in meditation on any god that time, O Satpurusa. We had yet to reach him when suddenly the giant Purusas appeared and started blowing musalas on us. Frightened of the sudden blows, we turned back immediately and the god of death then visited there. The Purusas did not take the least care of him also and same treatment was made. Thus, we including the god of death could not bring that Brahmana here. O master, please, tell us the penance on which he was doing meditation, the name of god in his imagination and further, the reference of the people who badly hurt us.
verses.hindi: हे महामति, समस्त दूतों और मृत्यु के ऐसा पूछने पर महाबुद्धिमान वैवस्वत यमराज ने क्षण भर ध्यान किया और बोले—

verses.science: नमामि लोकत्रयकर्मसाक्षिणम् पुरा हि शेते भगवाननादिकृत्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नारायणपरं विप्रं कस् तं वीक्षितुम् उत्सहेत् युष्माभिश् च महापापैर् मार्कण्डेयं हरिप्रियम् समानेतुं कृतो यत्नः समीचीनं न तत् कृतम्

verses.translation: Yama said- Listen to the matter I am going to refer, O the death and my all other servants. Whatever had come to my cognisance by virtue of meditation (yogamarga), is that the wisest Markandeya was known to his death today earlier and he had visited the tapovana with the sole desire to conquer the death. He has under guidance Bhrgu, worshipped lord Visnu and made severe penance with recital of the twelve letter hymn. Dear representatives, that Muni is concentrating on lord Kes'ava with keen attention and imagination of lord in his heart. Servants, he has thus, attained the force of Mahadaksa for the concentration on lord Visnu. Otherwise no other force than that can protect the man whose time of death has come. Who can even gaze at the man who had enshrined lord Visnu undeviatingly in his heart?
verses.hindi: 'भगवान नारायण के अनन्य भक्त ब्राह्मण की ओर देखने का भी कौन साहस कर सकता है? आप महापापियों ने हरिप्रिय मार्कण्डेय को लाने का जो यत्न किया, वह सर्वथा अनुचित था।'
verses.wordMeaning: Yama said- Listen to the matter I am going to refer, O the death and my all other servants. Whatever had come to my cognisance by virtue of meditation (yogamarga),…

verses.translation: Vyasa said- Sukadeva, having ordered the god of death and the messengers present there, Yama started at the troubled people of the hell. Whatever he had said to them in vagary of mercy under influence of devotion to lord Visnu, listen that very carefully. Yama said to those suffering organism - O consumer of fruit for vices committed, why had you not worshipped lord Visnu, in you life-time? Why had you not worshipped such a god who pleases with the worship made by only water even in the absence of other ritual materials and endow the devotee even his abode also? Why had you not worshipped Nrsimha form and lotus-eyed lord who provides with emancipation merely thinking of him?
verses.hindi: 'हे दूतगण, शिक्षा के लिए मैं वह अनुपम हरिवचन प्रेमपूर्वक कहता हूँ; आप सब भगवान हरि को प्रणाम करके इसे सुनिए—'
verses.wordMeaning: Vyasa said- Sukadeva, having ordered the god of death and the messengers present there, Yama started at the troubled people of the hell. Whatever he had said to them in vagary of mercy under influence of devotion to lord Visnu, listen that very carefully.…

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकाक्ष देवेश नरसिंह त्रिविक्रम त्वाम् अहं शरणं प्राप्त इति यस् तं समुद्धरे

Listen all you people with keen devotion for lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: 'जो मनुष्य "हे पुण्डरीकाक्ष, देवेश, नरसिंह, त्रिविक्रम, मैं आपकी शरण में आया हूँ" ऐसा कहता है, उसका मैं समुद्धार करता हूँ।'
verses.wordMeaning: Yama, the son of sun and devotee to Vis nu then turned to his servants and suggested -O servants, the words of god (Bhagavadvakya) as said by lord himself to Narada ad oftenly heard from other devotees to Visnu and siddhas; is being said by me to educate you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama, the son of sun and devotee to Vis nu then turned to his servants and suggested -O servants, the words of god (Bhagavadvakya) as said by lord himself to Narada ad oftenly heard from other devotees to Visnu and siddhas; is being said by me to educate you.…

verses.science: आकाशवाणीने कहा--देवदेव! माधव! केशव! आपकी जय हो, जय हो। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्तप्रियाय देवाय रक्षाय हरये नमः लोकनाथाय शान्ताय यज्ञेशायादिमूर्तये

verses.translation: Vyasa said- O son, The organism suffering from the hell fire started reciting loudly the names of god as 'Krsna, Krsna, Nrsimha etc., when they heard the declaration of god himself from the mouth of Yama. It was a phenomenon that in proportion to the recital of the lord's names, the hellish organism tended to be filled with the devotion for lord Visnu. So filled with the devotion, they started saying
verses.hindi: 'भक्तप्रिय देव, रक्षक हरि, लोकनाथ, शांतस्वरूप, यज्ञेश्वर और आदिमूर्ति प्रभु को नमस्कार है।'
verses.wordMeaning: Vyasa said- O son, The organism suffering from the hell fire started reciting loudly the names of god as 'Krsna, Krsna, Nrsimha etc., when they heard the declaration of god himself from the mouth of Yama.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa said- O son, The organism suffering from the hell fire started reciting loudly the names of god as 'Krsna, Krsna, Nrsimha etc., when they heard the declaration of god himself from the mouth of Yama.…

verses.translation: The hellish organism said- We salute the great soul lord Kesava, by the recital of whose name the hellish fire is immediately extinguished. Salute lord Visnu, the Isvara by offering Adimurti, always in peace and master of the world. Salutation to Sri Narayana who is everlasting, incomparable in the form of Nrsimha, who holds a conch- shell, discus, gada and teachers the lokas. The god, favourite to the Vedas, great and dynamic in particular. Salutation is conveyed to lord Varaha who is beyond the scope of logic, in the form of the Vedas, holder of earth. Salutation to lord Brahma, born in Brahmin clan, learned in the Vedas and their segments (angas) and well-versed
verses.hindi: 'नित्य तेजस्वी, ब्राह्मणस्वरूप, बहुज्ञ और वेद-वेदांगों के धारक वामन भगवान को बारंबार नमस्कार है।'
verses.wordMeaning: The hellish organism said- We salute the great soul lord Kesava, by the recital of whose name the hellish fire is immediately extinguished. Salute lord Visnu, the Isvara by offering Adimurti, always in peace and master of the world.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The hellish organism said- We salute the great soul lord Kesava, by the recital of whose name the hellish fire is immediately extinguished. Salute lord Visnu, the Isvara by offering Adimurti, always in peace and master of the world.…

verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले--महामना! महाकाय! महामते! महादेव! महायशस्वी! देवाधिदेव! आपको नमस्कार है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नारकेषु च सर्वेषु नीतेषु हरिपूरुषैः विष्णुलोकं यमो भूयो नमश् चक्रे तदा हरिम्
verses.transliteration: nārakeṣu ca sarveṣu nīteṣu haripūruṣaiḥ viṣṇulokaṃ yamo bhūyo namaś cakre tadā harim
verses.hindi: विष्णुपार्षदों द्वारा समस्त नारकीय जीवों को विष्णुलोक ले जाए जाने पर यमराज ने पुनः भगवान हरि को सादर प्रणाम किया—

verses.science: सनन्दन और सनत्कुमार आदि योगीजन अपने नेत्रोंकी दृष्टिको नासिकाके अग्रभागपर सुस्थिर करके नित्य- निरन्तर जिस मोक्षतत्त्वका चिन्तन करते हैं, वह आप ही हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यन्नामकीर्तनाद् याता नारकाः केशवालयम् तं नमामि सदा देवं नरसिंहम् अहं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: yannāmakīrtanād yātā nārakāḥ keśavālayam taṃ namāmi sadā devaṃ narasiṃham ahaṃ gurum
verses.translation: Vyasa said- Sukadeva, the organisms suffering from the hell-fire got immediate relaxation when they recited the pious
verses.hindi: 'जिनके नाम-कीर्तन मात्र से नारकीय जीव भी भगवान केशव के परम धाम चले गए, उन जगतगुरु भगवान नरसिंह को मैं सदा प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa said- Sukadeva, the organisms suffering from the hell-fire got immediate relaxation when they recited the pious
verses.science: योगधर! महामायाधर! विद्याधर! यशोधर! कीर्तिधर! सत्त्वादि तीनों गुणोंके आश्रय! त्रितत्त्वधारी तथा गार्हपत्यादि तीनों अग्नियोंको धारण करनेवाले देव! आपको प्रणाम है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वै नरसिंहस्य विष्णोर् अमिततेजसः प्रणामं ये ऽपि कुर्वन्ति तेभ्यो ऽपीह नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: tasya vai narasiṃhasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ praṇāmaṃ ye 'pi kurvanti tebhyo 'pīha namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu with keen devotion. They turned in the form of Sri Krsna with divine fragrance smeared on their parts of bodies, divine clothes and adorned with the ornaments. Then the servants of lord Vishnu appeared there and took them to the abode of lord Visnu by aircraft (vimana). They condemned the servants of Yama. Lord Yama again bowed his head before lord Visnu for picking up the sufferer of hell-fire to the abode of Visnu. I always salute lord Visnu in the form of Nrsimha, the recital of whose name is so mighty as it took the hellish organisms to Visnu-dhama. I also salute the people frequently who salute lord Visnu in the form of Nrsimha. Having seen the hell-fire fully extinguished and all devices in the contrary position, Yamaraja himself had determined to educate his messengers again to outright
verses.hindi: 'जो लोग भी उन अमित तेजस्वी भगवान नरसिंह विष्णु को प्रणाम करते हैं, उन भक्तों को भी मेरा बारंबार नमस्कार है।'
verses.wordMeaning: names of lord Visnu with keen devotion. They turned in the form of Sri Krsna with divine fragrance smeared on their parts of bodies, divine clothes and adorned with the ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: names of lord Visnu with keen devotion. They turned in the form of Sri Krsna with divine fragrance smeared on their parts of bodies, divine clothes and adorned with the ornaments.…
verses.science: स्निग्ध मेघकी आभाके सदृश सुन्दर श्यामकान्तिसे सुशोभित, पीताम्बरधारी, किरीट, वलय, केयूर और हारोंमें जटित मणिरत्नोंकी किरणोंसे समस्त दिशाओंको प्रकाशित करनेवाले…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा प्रशान्तं नरकाग्निम् उग्रं यन्त्रादि सर्वं विपरीतम् अत्र पुनः स शिक्षार्थम् अथात्मदूतान् यमो हि वक्तुं कृतवान् मनः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā praśāntaṃ narakāgnim ugraṃ yantrādi sarvaṃ viparītam atra punaḥ sa śikṣārtham athātmadūtān yamo hi vaktuṃ kṛtavān manaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Thus, the eight chapter on 'Yama's preaching to his messengers' in Sri Nrsimha Purana approaches the end.
verses.hindi: भयंकर नरकाग्नि को पूर्णतः शांत और समस्त यातना-यंत्रों को निष्प्रभावी देखकर यमराज ने शिक्षा के लिए स्वयं अपने दूतों से पुनः उपदेश कहने का निश्चय किया।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the eight chapter on 'Yama's preaching to his messengers' in Sri Nrsimha Purana approaches the end.
verses.science: श्रीव्यासजी बोले--इस प्रकार स्तवन सुनकर देवदेव भगवान् जनार्दने प्रसन्नचित्त होकर मार्कण्डेयजीसे कहा श्रीभगवान् बोले-वत्स! मैं तुम्हारे महान् तप और फिर स्तोत्…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीनरसिंहपुराणे यमगीता नामाष्टमो ऽध्यायः ॥ नर्प् ८ ॥ स्वपुरुषम् अभिवीक्ष्य पाशहस्तं वदति यमः किल तस्य कर्णमूले परिहर मधुसूदनप्रपन्नान् प्रभुर् अहम् अन्यनृणां न वैष्णवानाम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe yamagītā nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ || narp 8 || svapuruṣam abhivīkṣya pāśahastaṃ vadati yamaḥ kila tasya karṇamūle parihara madhusūdanaprapannān prabhur aham anyanṛṇāṃ na vaiṣṇavānām
verses.hindi: हाथ में पाश लिए अपने दूत को देखकर यमराज ने उसके कान में कहा—'भगवान मधुसूदन की शरण में गए भक्तों को दूर से ही छोड़ देना; मैं अन्य मनुष्यों का शासक हूँ, वैष्णवों का नहीं।'

verses.science: ब्रह्मन्! जिसने तप नहीं किया है, ऐसा कोई भी मनुष्य अनायास ही मेरा दर्शन नहीं पा सकता मार्कण्डेय उवाच कृतकृत्योऽस्मि देवेश साम्प्रतं तव दर्शनात्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहम् अमरगणार्चितेन धात्रा यम इति लोकहिताहिते नियुक्तः हरिगुरुविमुखान् प्रशास्मि मर्त्यान् हरिचरणप्रणतान् नमस् करोमि
verses.transliteration: aham amaragaṇārcitena dhātrā yama iti lokahitāhite niyuktaḥ hariguruvimukhān praśāsmi martyān haricaraṇapraṇatān namas karomi
verses.translation: Vyasa said- Yama having seen his servant ready to move somewhere with the pasa (cord) in his hand, said into his ears - "Dear messenger, my sovereignty covers the creatures other than Vaisnavana. Hence, leave the people sheltered under lord Madhusudana.
verses.hindi: 'देवगणों द्वारा पूजित विधाता ने मुझे लोक के शुभाशुभ न्याय के लिए यम पद पर नियुक्त किया है। मैं हरि और गुरु से विमुख मरणशील जीवों पर शासन करता हूँ और श्रीहरि के चरणों में प्रणत भक्तों को प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.wordMeaning: Vyasa said- Yama having seen his servant ready to move somewhere with the pasa (cord) in his hand, said into his ears - "Dear messenger, my sovereignty covers the creatures other than Vaisnavana. Hence, leave the people sheltered under lord Madhusudana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa said- Yama having seen his servant ready to move somewhere with the pasa (cord) in his hand, said into his ears - "Dear messenger, my sovereignty covers the creatures other than Vaisnavana. Hence, leave the people sheltered under lord Madhusudana.…
verses.science: चिरायुष्यं हृषीकेश येन त्वां चिरमर्चये पुनस्त्वं द्रक्ष्यसे मां वै क्षीराब्धौ योगशायिनम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सुगतिम् अभिलषामि वासुदेवाद् अहम् अपि भागवते स्थितान्तरात्मा मधुवधवशगो ऽस्मि न स्वतन्त्रः प्रभवति संयमने ममापि कृष्णः
verses.transliteration: sugatim abhilaṣāmi vāsudevād aham api bhāgavate sthitāntarātmā madhuvadhavaśago 'smi na svatantraḥ prabhavati saṃyamane mamāpi kṛṣṇaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Brahma has employed me for taking into consideration, the account of the good and bad deeds performed/committed by the people, and thus, addressed me as Yama. The people who not obedient/devoted to the teacher and Visnu, are only governed by me. I myself salute the people who bow their heads before Sri Hari.
verses.hindi: 'मैं स्वयं भी भागवत-धर्म में स्थित होकर भगवान वासुदेव से सद्गति की कामना करता हूँ। मैं मधुसूदन के अधीन हूँ, स्वतंत्र नहीं; मेरे नियमन में भी श्रीकृष्ण ही समर्थ हैं।'
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Brahma has employed me for taking into consideration, the account of the good and bad deeds performed/committed by the people, and thus, addressed me as Yama. The people who not obedient/devoted to the teacher and Visnu, are only governed by me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma has employed me for taking into consideration, the account of the good and bad deeds performed/committed by the people, and thus, addressed me as Yama. The people who not obedient/devoted to the teacher and Visnu, are only governed by me.…
verses.science: इत्युक्त्वा पुण्डरीकाक्षस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भगवति विमुखस्य नास्ति सिद्धिर् विषम् अमृतं भवतीति नेदम् अस्ति वर्षशतम् अपीह पच्यमानं व्रजति न काञ्चनताम् अयः कदाचित्
verses.transliteration: bhagavati vimukhasya nāsti siddhir viṣam amṛtaṃ bhavatīti nedam asti varṣaśatam apīha pacyamānaṃ vrajati na kāñcanatām ayaḥ kadācit
verses.translation: By taking special care for the devotee towards god and on remembering their penance performed, I also wish a suitable position from lord Vasudeva. I am enslaved to Madhusudana and nowhere independent. Lord Visnu is capable enough to control
verses.hindi: 'भगवान से विमुख व्यक्ति को कभी सिद्धि नहीं मिलती—विष कभी अमृत हो जाए, ऐसा संभव नहीं। सौ वर्षों तक भी पकाए जाने पर लोहा कभी स्वर्ण नहीं बन सकता।'
verses.wordMeaning: gggfg wig wig fgg;ii^u By taking special care for the devotee towards god and on remembering their penance performed, I also wish a suitable position from lord Vasudeva. I am enslaved to Madhusudana and nowhere independent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: gggfg wig wig fgg;ii^u By taking special care for the devotee towards god and on remembering their penance performed, I also wish a suitable position from lord Vasudeva. I am enslaved to Madhusudana and nowhere independent.…
verses.science: हरि सुरेशं मुनिरुग्रतेजाः युक्तश्चिरकालसम्भ्रमाद् भृगोः स पौत्रो हरिभक्तिमुद्वहन्। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि शशिकलुषच्छविः कदाचिद् विरमति नो रविताम् उपैति चन्द्रः भगवति च हराव् अनन्यचेता भृशमलिनो ऽपि विराजते मनुष्यः
verses.transliteration: na hi śaśikaluṣacchaviḥ kadācid viramati no ravitām upaiti candraḥ bhagavati ca harāv ananyacetā bhṛśamalino 'pi virājate manuṣyaḥ
verses.translation: The person opposing the god, cannot achieve siddhi (salvation). The poison cannot anyway turn into nectar, the iron cannot be converted into gold even if the same is thrown into a furnace for many hundred years.
verses.hindi: 'चंद्रमा का कलंक कभी दूर नहीं होता और न ही चंद्रमा कभी सूर्य बन पाता है; किंतु भगवान श्रीहरि में अनन्य चित्त लगाने वाला मनुष्य अत्यंत मलिन होने पर भी तेज से शोभित हो उठता है।'
verses.commentary: Sense: ggfg g ggsgggrgg: g^rfg^imi The person opposing the god, cannot achieve siddhi (salvation). The poison cannot anyway turn into nectar, the iron cannot be converted into gold even if the same is thrown into a furnace for many hundred years.
verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले--देवेधर! इस समय आपके दर्शनसे ही मैं कृतार्थ हो गया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महद् अपि सुविचार्य लोकतत्त्वं भगवदुपास्तिम् ऋते न सिद्धिर् अस्ति सुरगुरुसुदृढप्रसाददौ तौ हरिचरणौ स्मरतापवर्गहेतोः
verses.transliteration: mahad api suvicārya lokatattvaṃ bhagavadupāstim ṛte na siddhir asti suragurusudṛḍhaprasādadau tau haricaraṇau smaratāpavargahetoḥ
verses.translation: The moon similarly cannot be absolved from the scare i.e. it cannot illumine like the sun. However, the exclusive devotee of lord Visnu, attains to honour and prestige in spite of being dirty in body. On going over the essence of the world it is only ascertained that no achievement can be obtained but for the worship of the god. You therefore, are advised to bring in memory at all moments, the feet of god for emancipation as these feet had graced the divine teacher (Devaguru) Jupiter (Brhaspati).
verses.hindi: 'लौकिक तत्त्वों का कितना ही गंभीर विचार क्यों न कर लिया जाए, भगवान की उपासना के बिना सिद्धि नहीं मिलती। अतः मोक्ष-प्राप्ति के लिए देवगुरुओं को भी सुदृढ़ कृपा देने वाले उन श्रीहरि के चरणों का स्मरण कीजिए।'
verses.wordMeaning: The moon similarly cannot be absolved from the scare i.e. it cannot illumine like the sun. However, the exclusive devotee of lord Visnu, attains to honour and prestige in spite of being dirty in body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The moon similarly cannot be absolved from the scare i.e. it cannot illumine like the sun. However, the exclusive devotee of lord Visnu, attains to honour and prestige in spite of being dirty in body.…
verses.science: श्रीभगवान् बोले--मृत्युको तो तुम पहले ही जीत चुके हो, अब चिरकालिक आयु भी तुम्हें प्राप्त हुई। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: शुभम् इदम् उपलभ्य मानुषत्वं सुकृतशतेन वृथेन्द्रियार्थहेतोः रमयति कुरुते न मोक्षमार्गं दहयति चन्दनम् आशु भस्महेतोः
verses.transliteration: śubham idam upalabhya mānuṣatvaṃ sukṛtaśatena vṛthendriyārthahetoḥ ramayati kurute na mokṣamārgaṃ dahayati candanam āśu bhasmahetoḥ
verses.translation: The people indulged redundantly in the pleasures of worldly affairs, only to destroy the opportunity for utilisation of human body so received as a result of hundreds of great deeds performed in the phase of previous life. The people not following the path of emancipation, are involved in the activity as if someone pumps wind to the sandal-wood for getting its ashes. II
verses.hindi: 'सैकड़ों पुण्यों से प्राप्त इस दुर्लभ और कल्याणकारी मनुष्य-जन्म को पाकर जो केवल इंद्रिय-भोगों में व्यर्थ रमता है और मोक्ष-मार्ग का अनुसरण नहीं करता, वह मानो राख के लिए बहुमूल्य चंदन को जला डालता है।'
verses.wordMeaning: The people indulged redundantly in the pleasures of worldly affairs, only to destroy the opportunity for utilisation of human body so received as a result of hundreds of great deeds performed in the phase of previous life. The people not following the path of emancipation,…

verses.translation: This great preaching of Yama which increases the devotion for lord Visnu, has been described by me to you all. Now, I will again highlight the precedent story i.e. the activities performed by Markandeya, the grandson of Bhrgu in the ancient period. Thus, the Ninth chapter on "Yamastaka" in Sri Nrsimha Purana approaches the end.

He married there on special pressure from Bhrgu and got a son Vedasira in appropriate course of time. He then performed a number of offerings for lord Narayana, performed Sraddha for Pitaras and honoured Atithis with offering them feast and entertainment. He then went to Prayaga, took a dip there in the greatest holy place (confluence of the three rivers) and started god Narayana under the tree

verses.translation: With a keen desire for seeing god Narayana under whose pleasure and grace he had conquered the death, he started the tough penance again. He gave up food and only breathed air for many years and thus inflicted troubles on his physique. In course of penance, he stood before lord Venlmadhava with full concentration after a formal worship with fragrance and flowers. Imagination in depth of lord Visnu with conch-shell, discus and club had been fixed in his lotus heart and he started reciting the psalm of the lord.
verses.hindi: जिन प्रभु की कृपा से उन्होंने पूर्वकाल में अपनी मृत्यु को जीता था, उन भगवान का प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन करने की इच्छा से वे परम तपस्या में लीन हो गए।

verses.science: प्रसन्न हों, प्रसन्न हों। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगत्पतिं क्षीरसमुद्रमन्दिरं तं शार्ङ्गपाणिं मुनिवृन्दवन्दितम् श्रियः पतिं श्रीधरम् ईशम् ईश्वरं नमामि गोविन्दम् अनन्तवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: jagatpatiṃ kṣīrasamudramandiraṃ taṃ śārṅgapāṇiṃ munivṛndavanditam śriyaḥ patiṃ śrīdharam īśam īśvaraṃ namāmi govindam anantavarcasam
verses.translation: I bow my head- before almighty, god to all, ever illumined god Govinda, who nourishes the World, who resides in Kslra ocean, who holds Sarhga bow in his hands, who is worshipped by the hermits, who is the husband of and always holds within his heart.
verses.hindi: 'मैं क्षीरसागर में निवास करने वाले जगत्पति, शार्ङ्गपाणि, मुनिवृंद-वंदित, लक्ष्मीपति, श्रीधर, ईश्वरों के ईश्वर और अनंत तेजस्वी गोविंद को प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow my head- before almighty, god to all, ever illumined god Govinda, who nourishes the World, who resides in Kslra ocean, who holds Sarhga bow in his hands, who is worshipped by the hermits, who is the husband of LaksmI and always holds LaksmI within his heart.
verses.science: आपकी जय हो, जय हो। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अजं वरेण्यं जनदुःखनाशनं गुरुं पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमं प्रभुम् सहस्रसूर्यद्युतिमन्तम् अच्युतं नमामि भक्त्या हरिम् आद्यमाधवम्
verses.transliteration: ajaṃ vareṇyaṃ janaduḥkhanāśanaṃ guruṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamaṃ prabhum sahasrasūryadyutimantam acyutaṃ namāmi bhaktyā harim ādyamādhavam
verses.translation: I bow my head with keen devotion before Adimadhava god Visnu, who is unborn, who is teacher, Purana Purusottama and master of all, whose brilliance is as much as thousands of suns and who is in the form of Acyuta.
verses.hindi: 'मैं अजन्मा, वरेण्य, जन-दुःखनाशक, पुरातन गुरु, पुरुषोत्तम, सहस्र सूर्यों के समान तेजस्वी और अच्युत आदि-माधव श्रीहरि को भक्तिपूर्वक प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.commentary: Sense: wfa *ra? 9 T ^RmamsieiH > ii?oii I bow my head with keen devotion before Adimadhava god Visnu, who is unborn, who is teacher, Purana Purusottama and master of all, whose brilliance is as much as thousands of suns and who is in the form of Acyuta.
verses.science: भद्र! अतिभद्र! ईश! कल्याणमय प्रभो! आपको जय हो, जय हो; आपको नमस्कार है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्कृतं पुण्यवतां परां गतिं क्षितीश्वरं लोकपतिम् प्रजापतिम् परं पराणाम् अपि कारणं हरिं नमामि लोकत्रयकर्मसाक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: puraskṛtaṃ puṇyavatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ kṣitīśvaraṃ lokapatim prajāpatim paraṃ parāṇām api kāraṇaṃ hariṃ namāmi lokatrayakarmasākṣiṇam
verses.translation: I salute lord Visnu who appears in physical form before the devotee of sacred soul, who is the supreme position of all, who is the master of the earth, lokas and the subject, who is para viz., the supreme cause among the causes and witness to the deeds of the three lokas.
verses.hindi: 'मैं पुण्यात्माओं द्वारा पूजित परम गति, पृथिवीपति, लोकपति, प्रजापति, परात्पर कारण और तीनों लोकों के कर्मों के साक्षी श्रीहरि को प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.commentary: Sense: I salute lord Visnu who appears in physical form before the devotee of sacred soul, who is the supreme position of all, who is the master of the earth, lokas and the subject, who is para viz., the supreme cause among the causes and witness to the deeds of the three lokas.
verses.science: है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: भोगे त्व् अनन्तस्य पयोदधौ सुरः पुरा हि शेते भगवान् अनादिकृत् क्षीरोदवीचीकणिकाम्बुनोक्षितं तं श्रीनिवासं प्रणतो ऽस्मि केशवम्

verses.hindi: 'जो अनादि सृष्टिकर्ता भगवान प्राचीन काल से क्षीरसागर में अनंत शेषनाग की शय्या पर शयन करते हैं और क्षीरसागर की तरंगों के जलकणों से अभिसिंचित रहते हैं, उन श्रीनिवास केशव को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.wordMeaning: I bow my head before god Kesava, the husband of LaksmT who slept on the bed of the body of Sesanaga 'Ananta' in the bottom of KsTrasagara in the ancient time, who is anadi Vidhata and who avails humidity of the water drops sprinkled by the waves of the KsTrasagara.…

verses.science: आपकी जय हो, आपको नमस्कार है॥ ६--१४॥ जिनकी नाभिसे कमल प्रकट हुआ है तथा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो नारसिंहं वपुर् आस्थितो महान् सुरो मुरारिर् मधुकैटभान्तकृत् समस्तलोकार्तिहरं हिरण्यकं नमामि विष्णुं सततं नमामि तम्

verses.hindi: 'जो महान देव नरसिंह रूप धारण करने वाले, मुरारि, मधु-कैटभ का अंत करने वाले, हिरण्यकशिपु के संहारक और समस्त लोकों की पीड़ा हरने वाले हैं, उन भगवान विष्णु को मैं निरंतर प्रणाम करता हूँ।'

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तम् अव्यक्तम् अतीन्द्रियं विभुं स्वे स्वे हि रूपे स्वयम् एव संस्थितम् योगेश्वरैर् एव सदा नमस्कृतं नमामि भक्त्या सततं जनार्दनम्

verses.translation: I always salute god Visnu, who has held the form of him who is a great god, who is enemy to Mura monster, who is the killer of Madhu and Kaitabha monsters and who is Hiranyagarbha as also who removes the sorrows and pains of the people (worldly). Tt ft
verses.hindi: 'मैं अनंत, अव्यक्त, अतींद्रिय, सर्वव्यापी, अपने-अपने दिव्य रूपों में स्वयं स्थित और योगेश्वरों द्वारा सदा वंदित भगवान जनार्दन को भक्तिपूर्वक निरंतर प्रणाम करता हूँ।'

verses.science: नमस्ते वासुदेवाय नमस्ते पीतवाससे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दम् एकं विरजं विदात्मकं वृन्दालयं योगिभिर् एव पूजितम् अणोर् अणीयांसम् अवृद्धिम् अक्षयं नमामि भक्तप्रियम् ईश्वरं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: ānandam ekaṃ virajaṃ vidātmakaṃ vṛndālayaṃ yogibhir eva pūjitam aṇor aṇīyāṃsam avṛddhim akṣayaṃ namāmi bhaktapriyam īśvaraṃ harim
verses.translation: I regularly bow with keen devotion my head before the god Janardana who is everlasting, inexpressive, beyond the power of perception, omnipresent and who himself appears in the varied forms and whose feet are worshipped by the yogis.
verses.hindi: 'मैं एकमात्र आनंदस्वरूप, निर्मल, ज्ञानमय, योगियों द्वारा पूजित, अणु से भी अणुतर, क्षय-वृद्धि से रहित, भक्तप्रिय और ईश्वर भगवान हरि को प्रणाम करता हूँ।'
verses.commentary: Sense: I regularly bow with keen devotion my head before the god Janardana who is everlasting, inexpressive, beyond the power of perception, omnipresent and who himself appears in the varied forms and whose feet are worshipped by the yogis.
verses.science: लोकाध्यक्ष जगत्पूज्य परमात्मन् नमोऽस्तु ते। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.translation: Vyasa said- Beloved son, the akasavanl suggested to Markandeya on completion of the psalm. O Brahman, why are you putting yourself in troubles when it is a fact that you cannot perceive god Madhava until and unless you take a dip in all the holy places! Complying with the suggestions delivered by akas'avanl, the learned Markandeya took a bath in all holy places yet he could not perceive god. He then said targeting the akasavani, I convey salutation to you whosoever you are; and request for suggesting any work that may ensure the return of the same quantum as that of bathing in holy places, if that work is successfully performed.
verses.hindi: (मार्कण्डेय ने कहा) 'हे भगवन्, समस्त तीर्थों का फल देने वाला वह स्तोत्र मुझे बताइए, जिसके जप से संपूर्ण तीर्थ-स्नान का फल मिल जाता है।'
