verses.translation: Yojanagandha. The king ruled in Hastinapura. During his regime he hosted a number of feedings to satiate the gods, sraddha to satiate the Pitrs and did everything benevolent for the subjects. After being blessed with the sons, he was dead. The son of from Ambalika was Pandu. Pandu also ruled as a kind and just king as long as he lived. Owing to the curse of a hermit, he had to die a premature death.
verses.hindi: परीक्षित से मातृवती के गर्भ से जनमेजय हुए, जिन्होंने ब्रह्महत्या के निवारण हेतु व्यास-शिष्य वैशंपायन से आदि से अंत तक संपूर्ण महाभारत का श्रवण किया।

verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ ca dharmataḥ kṛtvā divam āruroha | janamejayasya puṣpavatyāṃ śatānīkaḥ
verses.translation: Arjuna was his son from who pleased god Mahadeva as a result of his severe penance and thus got Pasupatastra from him. He then killed the Nivatakavaca monsters who were the enemy of god Indra and rendered the Khandava forest to the fire god when it was desired by him. God Agni then burnt Khandava forest into ashes and thus was satiated. He bestowed a number of boons on Arjuna. He sheltered king Virat for Ajnatavasa (unidentified living) with his brothers Yudhistira, Nakula and Sahadeva along with wife when the state was seized by Duryodhana under manipulation. Arjuna fought in favour of king Virat against the enemies who had abducted all the cows by an attack and thus defeated them. The cows were then brought back. At that time he defeated the great warriors like, Drona, Krpa, Salya, Kama etc. In the battle-field of Kuruksetra he in the company of Vasudeva fought against the mighty sons of Dhrtarastra and regained his kingdom by slaughtering ma, Drona, Krpa, Salya, Kama etc., great chivalrous Ksatriyas and the princes of a number of states including Duryodhana with the co-operation of etc. He then enthroned his eldest brother Yudhisthira as per law, ruled the state and finally, departed together to the abode of heaven.

verses.translation: TOT: Wife Arjuna got the son Abhimanyu from the womb of his wife Subhadra. He had killed a number of kings by jumping within Cakravyuha when the war of Mahabharata was waged. Abhimanyu had another son from Uttara. His name was Parlksita. Most religious Yudhisthira, at the time of his departure to Vanaprastha (departure to forest), enthroned Parlksita. He also ruled ideally and taking all care of subjects and lastly departed to the abode of Vaikuntha. Parlksita had a son from the womb of Matrvatl. His name was Janamejaya. He had heard the entire Mahabharata from the mouth of Vaisampayana, the disciple of Vyasa in order to sweep away the heinous evil of the murder of Brahmins (Brahmahatya). He was also a just king and after a certain period of time, he also went to his heavenly abode. Janamejaya had got a son Satanlka from his wife Puspavati. He ruled ideally and gradually became reluctant to the worldly affairs as also pains by virtue of Saunaka's preaching which influenced him. He performed a number of offerings and worshipped god Visnu, the supreme master of all the worlds, without any worldly desire and finally, acquired the abode of Visnu. Satanlka had a son Sahasranlka from his wife Phalavatl. He was enthroned at a very early age and developed his devotion for the god Nrsimha. His account of the deeds will be unveiled later on. Sahasranlka got a son Udayana from his wife Mrgavatl. He ruled for many years and did continue the worship of god Narayana. Then he attained the Vaikuntha Dhama. Udayana got a son Naravahana from his wife Vasavadatta. He also ruled judiciously and finally, breathed his last. Naravahana's son from Asvamedhadatta was Ksemaka. verses.transliteration: ḥtrayaḥ pravrajitāḥ | ḥśiṣṭānāṃ saptānāṃ saptadvīpāḥ pitrā dattāḥ | ḥtatra jambudvīpādhipater agnīdhrasya nava putrāḥ jātāḥ
verses.hindi: उनमें से तीन पुत्र संन्यस्त हो वन चले गए और शेष सात पुत्रों को पिता ने एक-एक द्वीप दे दिया। जंबूद्वीप के स्वामी आग्नीध्र के नौ पुत्र हुए—

verses.sanskrit: नाभिः किंपुरुषश् चैव हरिवर्ष इलावृतः रम्यो हिरण्ययश् चैव कुरुर् भद्रश् च केतुमान्

verses.transliteration: ḥnavavarṣāḥ vibhajya putrebhyaḥ pitrā dattā vanaṃ praviśatā | ḥagnīdhrīyaṃ himāhvayam | ḥyasyādhipatir nābheḥ ṛṣabhaḥ putro babhūva
verses.hindi: वन में प्रवेश करते समय पिता आग्नीध्र ने जंबूद्वीप को नौ वर्षों (खंडों) में विभक्त कर अपने पुत्रों को दे दिया। आग्नीध्र का हिमवर्ष (भारतवर्ष) नाभि को मिला, जिनके पुत्र ऋषभदेव हुए।

verses.science: मुख है, सुन्दर नेत्र हैं तथा अत्यन्त मनोहर मुसकान है, ऐसे अत्यन्त हृदयहारी आपके इस रूपको, जो ज्ञानियोंद्वारा वन्दित है, मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभाद् भरतो भरतेन चिरकालं धर्मेण पालितत्वाद् इदं भारतं वर्षम् अभूत् । ःइलावृतस्य मध्ये मेरुः सुवर्णमयश् चतुरशीतिसहस्राणि योजनानि तस्योच्छ्रायः । ःषोडशसहस्रम् अप्य् अधस्ताद् अवगाढः । ःतद्द्विगुणो मूर्ध्नि विस्तारः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣabhād bharato bharatena cirakālaṃ dharmeṇa pālitatvād idaṃ bhārataṃ varṣam abhūt | ḥilāvṛtasya madhye meruḥ suvarṇamayaś caturaśītisahasrāṇi yojanāni tasyocchrāyaḥ | ḥṣoḍaśasahasram apy adhastād avagāḍhaḥ | ḥtaddviguṇo mūrdhni vistāraḥ
verses.hindi: ऋषभदेव के पुत्र भरत हुए; भरत द्वारा दीर्घकाल तक धर्मपूर्वक पालित होने के कारण यह भारतवर्ष कहलाया। इलावृत वर्ष के मध्य सुवर्णमय मेरु पर्वत है, जिसकी ऊँचाई चौरासी सहस्र योजन है, सोलह सहस्र योजन यह पृथ्वी के नीचे धँसा हुआ है और इसके शिखर का विस्तार दुगुना है।

verses.science: मैं कृतार्थ हो गया, अब मैं कोई वर नहीं माँगता। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये ब्रह्मणः पुरी । ऐन्द्र्याम् इन्द्रस्य चामरावती । आग्नेय्याम् अग्नेस् तेजोवती । याम्यां यमस्य संयमनी । नैरृत्यां निरृतेर् भयंकरी । वारुण्यां वरुणस्य विश्वावती । ःवायव्यां वायोर् गन्धवती । ःउदीच्यां सोमस्य विभावरीति । ःनववर्षान्वितं जम्बूद्वीपं पुण्यपर्वतैः पुण्यनदीभिर् अन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye brahmaṇaḥ purī | aindryām indrasya cāmarāvatī | āgneyyām agnes tejovatī | yāmyāṃ yamasya saṃyamanī | nairṛtyāṃ nirṛter bhayaṃkarī | vāruṇyāṃ varuṇasya viśvāvatī | ḥvāyavyāṃ vāyor gandhavatī | ḥudīcyāṃ somasya vibhāvarīti | ḥnavavarṣānvitaṃ jambūdvīpaṃ puṇyaparvataiḥ puṇyanadībhir anvitam
verses.hindi: मेरु के मध्य में ब्रह्माजी की पुरी है; पूर्व में इंद्र की अमरावती, आग्नेय में अग्नि की तेजोवती, दक्षिण में यम की संयमनी, नैऋत्य में निऋति की भयंकरी, पश्चिम में वरुण की विश्वावती, वायव्य में वायु की गंधवती और उत्तर में चंद्रमा की विभावरी पुरी है। नौ वर्षों से युक्त यह जंबूद्वीप पावन पर्वतों और नदियों से संपन्न है।

verses.science: अपना मालिक हो जाय, तब काँचका भूषण पहनना कभी उचित नहीं हो सकता। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किंपुरुषादीन्य् अष्टवर्षाणि पुण्यवतां भोगस्थानानि साक्षाद् भारतवर्षम् एकं कर्मभूमिश् चातुर्वर्ण्ययुतम्

verses.hindi: किंपुरुष आदि आठ वर्ष पुण्यात्माओं के भोगस्थान हैं, किंतु एकमात्र भारतवर्ष ही चातुर्वर्ण्य से युक्त साक्षात् कर्मभूमि है।

verses.science: श्रीसूतजी कहते हैं--इस प्रकार अपने दर्शनमात्रसे दिव्य ज्ञान प्राप्त करके स्तुति करते हुए ध्रुवको देखकर भगवानूने उससे कहा श्रीभगवानुवाच आराध्य विष्णुं किमनेन…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव कर्मभिः स्वर्गं कृतेः प्राप्स्यन्ति मानवाः मुक्तिश् चात्रैव निष्कामैः प्राप्यते ज्ञानकर्मभिः अधोगतिम् इतो विप्र यान्ति वै पापकारिणः
verses.transliteration: tatraiva karmabhiḥ svargaṃ kṛteḥ prāpsyanti mānavāḥ muktiś cātraiva niṣkāmaiḥ prāpyate jñānakarmabhiḥ adhogatim ito vipra yānti vai pāpakāriṇaḥ
verses.hindi: यहीं पर मनुष्य शुभ कर्मों से स्वर्ग प्राप्त करते हैं और निष्काम ज्ञान-कर्म से यहीं से मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है; हे विप्र, पाप करने वाले यहीं से अधोगति को जाते हैं।

verses.commentary: Sense: Kusa, Kraunca, Saka and Puskara- the seven continents on this earth. Jambudvlpa is as much as one lakh yojana long and Palaksa etc., other continents are
verses.science: श्रीविष्णुतद्धक्तसमागमं विभाति देवैरपि वन्द्यमानः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ःअथ सप्त कुलपर्वताः कथ्यन्ते । ःमहेन्द्रो मलयः शुक्तिमान् ऋष्यमूकः सह्यपर्वतो विन्ध्यः पारियात्रः । ःइत्य् एते भारते कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: ḥatha sapta kulaparvatāḥ kathyante | ḥmahendro malayaḥ śuktimān ṛṣyamūkaḥ sahyaparvato vindhyaḥ pāriyātraḥ | ḥity ete bhārate kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: These dvipas are surrounded by the oceans known as Lavana, Isurasa, Sura, Ghrta, Dadhi, Dugdha and Suddhodaka more than double as compared to the Dvipas.
verses.hindi: अब सात कुलपर्वत कहे जाते हैं—महेंद्र, मलय, शुक्तिमान्, ऋष्यमूक, सह्य पर्वत, विंध्य और पारियात्र—ये सात भारतवर्ष के कुलपर्वत हैं।
verses.commentary: Sense: proportionately larger in an orderly manner. These dvipas are surrounded by the oceans known as Lavana, Isurasa, Sura, Ghrta, Dadhi, Dugdha and Suddhodaka more than double as compared to the Dvipas.
verses.science: अङ्कारकोऽपि शुक्रस्य तावन्माने व्यवस्थितः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सुरसा ऋषिकुल्या भीमरथी कृष्णावेणी चन्द्रभागा ताम्रपर्णी इत्य् एताः सप्त नद्यः । गङ्गा यमुना गोदावरी तुङ्गभद्रा कावेरी सरयूर् इत्य् एता महानद्यः पपघ्न्यः
verses.transliteration: narmadā surasā ṛṣikulyā bhīmarathī kṛṣṇāveṇī candrabhāgā tāmraparṇī ity etāḥ sapta nadyaḥ | gaṅgā yamunā godāvarī tuṅgabhadrā kāverī sarayūr ity etā mahānadyaḥ papaghnyaḥ
verses.translation: Priyavrata, the son of Manu, was the king of these seven dvipas. He got Agridhra etc., then sons. The three sons among them were reluctant to the worldly affairs so they became recluses. The rest of the sons i.e., seven in number, got the dvipas one each from their father in partition. The nine sons of Agridhra ruled over the Jambudvlpa. Their names were- Nabhi, Kirnpurusa, Harivarsa, Ilavrta, Ramya, Hiranmaya, Kuru, Bhadra and Ketuman.
verses.hindi: नर्मदा, सुरसा, ऋषिकुल्या, भीमरथी, कृष्णावेणी, चंद्रभागा और ताम्रपर्णी—ये सात नदियाँ हैं; तथा गंगा, यमुना, गोदावरी, तुंगभद्रा, कावेरी और सरयू—ये पापनाशिनी महानदियाँ हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata, the son of Manu, was the king of these seven dvipas. He got Agridhra etc., then sons. The three sons among them were reluctant to the worldly affairs so they became recluses. The rest of the sons i.e., seven in number,…

verses.translation: Rsabha got a son Bharata. This country is known after his name as Bharatavarsa as he ruled that segment for many long years. At the middle of Ilavrta varsa, there is a golden mountain known as Meru. Its height is eighty four yojanas. It has been buried in the earth to the measurement of sixteen thousand yojana and the width of its peak is double than it i.e., thirty two yojanas. There is the city of Brahma in the middle, Amaravatl in the east, the city Tejovati of Agni at Agnikona (north east), Samyamani of Yama in the south, the city Bhayankarl of Nairrti in Nairrtyakona (south-west) Vivavatl of Varuna god in the west, Gandhavatl of wind god in Vayavyakona (southern east) and Vibhapuri of the moon god in the north. This Jambudvlpa consisting of nine segments is surrounded by holy mountains and rivers. Kimpurusa etc., eight varsa are the places of enjoyments for the people of great deeds. Only Bharatavarsa is the Karmaksetra comprising of the four varnas. The people in Bharatavarsa only will attain to heaven by virtue of their great deeds and the devotees going by route of knowledge, attain emancipation by virtue of their deeds performed without passions or attachments. O Brahmins, the evil-doers of this land fall to the mean positions directly. Hence, deem the evil-doers fell definitely in the hell at the nether region.

verses.translation: There is space above the earth or environment. It is most comfortable for the acrobats or the space creatures. Now, the description on the heaven is given. Listen to it patiently. The people who have performed great deeds in India they along with gods reside in the heaven. The mountain king, Meru is located in the middle of the earth. It is of golden lustre and shines the earth adjoining. It is as high as eighty four thousand yojana and its portion of sixteen thousand yojana has been buried below the earth. It is surrounded by the land of the same measurement.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ, ये स्वर्ग पूर्व शिखर पर स्थित हैं। इस प्रकार मेरु के शिखर पर इक्कीस स्वर्ग प्रतिष्ठित हैं।

The east ridge is made of Indranila and the west ridge is made of precious stones. The middle ridge is at an altitude of fourteen lakh fourteen thousand yojana and the heaven Trivistapa is located there. The east ridge of umbrella feature on the mountain Meru. Amid the middle ridge and east ridge, there is dense darkness. It is located just in the middle of the middle ridge and the west ridge. The beautiful Apsaras live in the

verses.translation: II The heaven situated on the middle ridge of Meru is full of pleasure and amenities. Sveta, Paustika, Upasobhana and Kama as also the king of heaven Alhada reside on the west ridge. O the great Brahmin, the heavens namely, Nirmama, Niraharhkara, Saubhagya and Atinirmala are situated on the east ridge. There are twenty one heavens situated on the peak of the mountain Meru. The people observing Ahirnsa (non¬ violence) in principle, generous, performers of offerings and resolute to penance as also away from the anger only reside in these

verses.science: सूतजीने कहा--ब्रह्मन्! बहुत अच्छा, अब मैं बुद्धिमान् सहस्नानीकके चरित्रका और भगवानूके अवतारोंका वर्णन करूँगा, सुनिये राजकुमार सहस्रानीकको जब उत्तम ब्राह्मणों…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कपिलागोप्रदानेन परमार्थे महीयते गोवृषस्य प्रदानेन स्वर्गं मन्मथाम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: kapilāgopradānena paramārthe mahīyate govṛṣasya pradānena svargaṃ manmathām āpnuyāt
verses.translation: The people attain to the heaven Ananda who abandon their breathings (Pranas) by drowning for the sake of their duty. The people attain to Pramoda heaven who similarly offer their bodies fearlessly to the fire for philanthropic causes. Saukhya is obtained as a result of sacrifice made as to jump from the peak of a mountain for the sake of protection of the humanity. The people who do mytrdom for the cause of a nation while fighting against the enemy, get the Nirmala (or Atinirmala) heaven to reside. The people attaining death in the state of reclusion, resolution or 'upavasa, move to the heaven Trivistapa. The people attain Nakaprtha and Nirvrti heavens who perform the offering Srauta and Agnihotra. Paustika heaven is obtained if the man has constructed ponds and wells while in earthly living. Saubhagya is obtained to reside when the man has donated gold during his earthly living. The man who arranges wood for burning and relieving the public from the waves of shivering cold attains to Apsara heaven. The donor of gold and cows attains to Nirahamkara heaven.
verses.hindi: कपिला गौ के दान से मनुष्य परमार्थ-लोक में सम्मानित होता है और साँड़ सहित गौ के दान से मन्मथ स्वर्ग पाता है।

verses.transliteration: māghamāse saritsnāyī tiladhenupradas tathā chatropānahadātā ca svargaṃ yāty upaśobhanam
verses.translation: The man attains Santika heaven who donates land with reverence and for the common cause. The donor of silver attains to Nirmala heaven. Punyaha heaven is availed of if horses are donated and Mangala heaven by virtue of Kanyadana (by entrusting daughter to her husband through solemnised marriage). The Sveta heaven is attained when Brahmins are duly offered food and clothes. He seldom suffers from agony after availing of that heaven.
verses.hindi: माघ मास में नदी-स्नान करने वाला, तिलधेनु का दाता तथा छत्र और पादुका का दान करने वाला उपशोभन स्वर्ग को जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The man attains Santika heaven who donates land with reverence and for the common cause. The donor of silver attains to Nirmala heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The man attains Santika heaven who donates land with reverence and for the common cause. The donor of silver attains to Nirmala heaven.…

verses.translation: The donor of Kapila cows enjoys the pleasure of living in Paramartha heaven. Manmatha heaven is obtained for living when ones best ox is donated. Upasobhana heaven is obtained by virtue of regular bathe in a river particularly in the month of Magha, donation of the cow consisting mole as also umbrella and shoe. The king of heaven Alhada is obtained if the man has constructed a temple, served the Brahmins and did pilgrimage during his life time. Subha heaven is obtained if the man survives on a single cereal, single diet that too at night and observes the fasts as Triratra etc., during his life on the earth. Nirmala heaven is obtained by a man who takes a dip in a river, checks on anger
verses.hindi: नदी-स्नायी, जितक्रोध, दृढ़व्रती ब्रह्मचारी और प्राणिहित में रत मनुष्य निर्मल स्वर्ग पाता है; विद्यादान से मेधावी मनुष्य निरहंकार स्वर्ग प्राप्त करता है।

verses.translation: Brahmacarl (who observes Brahma) and philanthropist. The heaven Nirahamkara is obtained when a scholar educates others for no reward or fee.

verses.commentary: Sense: strong resolute, Brahmacarl (who observes Brahma) and philanthropist. The heaven Nirahamkara is obtained when a scholar educates others for no reward or fee.

verses.translation: A man according to his spirit and desire for fruit attached while donating something, obtains the heavens of that nature. Donation of daughter, cow, land and learning is called Alidana. The donor avails accession to from the hell if these four are donated with reverence by him. Moreover, the evils attached due to riding on a bull and milking the cow also are swept away by virtue of such donations. The man who donates all kinds of things available with him, attains to the peaceful and the heaven free from ailments and seldom returns from there. He himself resides at the west ridge of the Meru where god Brahma is enshrined. God Visnu is enshrined at its east ridge and god Siva at the middle ridge.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रेन्द्र, अब इसके पश्चात् ऊपर से ऊपर स्थित विमल, विपुल और प्रकाशमान स्वर्गमार्ग के विषय में सुनिए।

verses.translation: O the crown of Brahmin, listen to me about the Nirmala and Vimala route that lead to heaven hereinafter. There are ten routes leading to heaven and these are duly arranged one above another. On the first route, there is Kumara Karttikeya and Matrkas on the other. Similarly, Siddha- Gandharvas on the three, Vidyadharas on the fourth, king serpent on the fifth, Garuda, son of Vinata on the sixth, divine Pitras on the seventh, the king of Dharma on the eighth, Daksa on the ninth and Aditya is enshrined on the tenth route.
verses.hindi: पाँचवें पर नागराज, छठे पर विनतापुत्र गरुड़, सातवें पर दिव्य पितर, आठवें पर धर्मराज, नौवें पर दक्ष और दसवें पथ पर आदित्य स्थित हैं।

verses.translation: The god Sun moves at an altitude of one lakh two thousand yojana measured from the earth. The spot for his stay has been there at that altitude and the expanse of sun- orbit covers the distance as much as three times more than that altitude. The sun appears rising at Amaravat! at the time when it exists at noon in Vibhavarl, the realm of Moon. It further seems arising in Samyamani, the city of Yama when he exists at noon in Amaravat!. God sun always revolves round Meru mountain. He is stable at the premise of (axis of) Dhruva (the pole). Valakhilya etc., hermits pray at the time of his rising.
verses.hindi: जब भगवान भास्कर अमरावती में मध्याह्न में होते हैं, तब वे दक्षिण दिशा की संयमनी पुरी में उदय होते हुए दिखाई देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: आलिङ्ग्य दीर्घं निःश्वस्य मुक्तकण्ठं रुरोद ह सान्त्वयित्वा सुनीतिस् तं वदनं परिमार्ज्य च
verses.transliteration: āliṅgya dīrghaṃ niḥśvasya muktakaṇṭhaṃ ruroda ha sāntvayitvā sunītis taṃ vadanaṃ parimārjya ca
verses.translation: O the son of a destitute woman, do you too want to climb to the lap of the king? Remember that it is your mere folly. You are not worthy to have the kings lap as you have been born from the womb of a destitute woman. Tell me what great deed you have performed so as to climb on to the throne? Had any deeds been performed in your previous life, you would not have been brought into the womb of the destitute. In spite of being a prince, you could not enter into my womb. Take it as a token to understand that you had performed no great deeds in the previous life. See Uttama who really had performed great deeds and how comfortably and respectfully; he has acquired a seat on the lap of the king.
verses.hindi: ध्रुव उनसे लिपट गया और लंबी साँस लेकर फूट-फूटकर रोने लगा। सुनीति ने उसे सांत्वना दी और उसका मुख पोंछा।
verses.wordMeaning: O the son of a destitute woman, do you too want to climb to the lap of the king? Remember that it is your mere folly. You are not worthy to have the kings lap as you have been born from the womb of a destitute woman.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O the son of a destitute woman, do you too want to climb to the lap of the king? Remember that it is your mere folly. You are not worthy to have the kings lap as you have been born from the womb of a destitute woman.…
verses.science: निहतोऽहं कराघातैस्तथा खाटो मनोहरम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.science: रहित धर्मात्मा राजा युधिष्ठिर उस उत्तम तीर्थकी ओर प्रस्थान करके तीर्थधर्मका उपदेश करनेवाले किसी मुनिवरके दर्शनकी बात सोच रहे थे, इसी बीचमें बहुरोमा तथा स्थूल…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्यमाने नरपतौ शिशो केनापमानितः संपृच्छे जननि त्वाहं संयक् शंस ममाग्रतः

verses.sanskrit: भार्यात्वे ऽपि च सामान्ये कथं सा सुरुचिः प्रिया कथं न भवती मातः प्रिया क्षितिपतेर् असि

verses.sanskrit: कथम् उत्तमतां प्राप्त उत्तमः सुरुचेः सुतः कुमारत्वे ऽपि सामान्ये कथं चाहम् अनुत्तमः

verses.science: कौन हमारी रक्षा करनेवाला है? जो मनुष्य शरणमें आये हुए किसी भी भयपीडितकी रक्षा करता है, वह अनन्त पुण्यफलका भागी होता है; फिर जो मुझ उत्तम ब्राह्मणकी रक्षा करे…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: कथं त्वं मन्दभाग्यासि सुकुक्षिः सुरुचिः कथम् कथं नृपासनं योग्यम् उत्तमस्य कथं न मे
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tvaṃ mandabhāgyāsi sukukṣiḥ suruciḥ katham kathaṃ nṛpāsanaṃ yogyam uttamasya kathaṃ na me
verses.translation: Suta said- On being scolded and humiliated in the presence of courtiers, tears started flowing in streams from the eyes of innocent Dhruva but he did not react. The king too could not blutter even a single word as a reaction to such humiliation, as he was enslaved of her beauty. Dhruva suppressed the pain anyhow till the court was on in full swing and saluted king when the court was over. He then immediately left for his home.
verses.hindi: 'आप मंदभागिनी क्यों हैं और सुरुचि श्रेष्ठ गर्भ वाली क्यों है? राजसिंहासन उत्तम के लिए योग्य क्यों है और मेरे लिए क्यों नहीं?'
verses.wordMeaning: Suta said- On being scolded and humiliated in the presence of courtiers, tears started flowing in streams from the eyes of innocent Dhruva but he did not react. The king too could not blutter even a single word as a reaction to such humiliation,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- On being scolded and humiliated in the presence of courtiers, tears started flowing in streams from the eyes of innocent Dhruva but he did not react. The king too could not blutter even a single word as a reaction to such humiliation,…
verses.science: नरकमें पड़ता है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयि तात महाबुद्धे विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना निवेदयामि ते सर्वं मावमाने मतिं कृथाः
verses.transliteration: ayi tāta mahābuddhe viśuddhenāntarātmanā nivedayāmi te sarvaṃ māvamāne matiṃ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: Sunlti, on arrival home of Dhurva automatically guessed at the humiliation inflicted by the king by merely seeing his pale face at a glance. When Dhruva became confident of solitude, he could not resist any more the momentum of pain and started weeping bitterly. He embraced his mother with both arms round her neck and burst into streams of tears. Sunlti consoled him, wiped his tears with her delicate hands, fanned him with her sari and asked - Dear son, tell me the reason for your weeping. Who has humiliated you even in the presence of the king?
verses.hindi: 'हे महाबुद्धि वत्स, मैं विशुद्ध अंतःकरण से सब कुछ बताती हूँ; आप इस अपमान को मन पर न लीजिए।'
verses.wordMeaning: Sunlti, on arrival home of Dhurva automatically guessed at the humiliation inflicted by the king by merely seeing his pale face at a glance. When Dhruva became confident of solitude, he could not resist any more the momentum of pain and started weeping bitterly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sunlti, on arrival home of Dhurva automatically guessed at the humiliation inflicted by the king by merely seeing his pale face at a glance. When Dhruva became confident of solitude, he could not resist any more the momentum of pain and started weeping bitterly.…
verses.science: तत्र युद्धं प्रववृते दारुणं भीमहैत्ययोः अर्जुनोऽपि समायातो नैव पश्यति तं मुनिम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तया यद् उक्तं तत् सर्वं तथ्यम् एव न चान्यथा यदि सा महिषी राज्ञो राज्ञीनाम् अतिवल्लभा

verses.sanskrit: आतपत्रं च चन्द्राभं शुभे चापि हि चामरे भद्रासनं तथोच्चं च सिन्धुराश् च मदोत्कटाः

verses.science: राजन्! युधिष्ठिरके यों कहनेपर आकाशमें इस प्रकारका शब्द हुआ, यद्यपि वहाँ बोलनेवाला कोई व्यक्ति नहीं था-महाराज! यह (जो आपके पास खड़ा है, वह मुनि नहीं) दानव है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.translation: Dhruva replied - Beloved mother, I ask you something and expect a true reply from you. Suruci and you both are the co-wives of the king; still she is so beloved for what reason? Mother, tell me why you are not beloved to the king. Why Uttama, the son of Suruci, is better? If I see the right of prince, both are equal but what thing still draws the dividing line between us. Why are you destitute and why is Suruci the better mother? Why is Uttama only worthy of the throne and not I? How are my deeds mean and Uttamas better?
verses.hindi: 'हे कल्याणी जननी सुनीति, मेरा शांत वचन सुनिए—अब मेरे मन में उत्तानपाद से बढ़कर अन्य कोई सहारा नहीं रहा, ऐसा नहीं है।'

verses.translation: Sunlti said- Dear son, you are most wise. I satisfy all queries you have made solemnly and with truth in heart but don't loom frequently round humiliation. The statements of Suruci are all correct and nothing is false therein. She is and further, most darling to the king. The prince Uttama had come to her womb as a result of the great deeds performed in the previous life and he only is worthy to sit on the throne. The things like royal umbrella as white as the moon, a decent pair of fans (canvara), the highest throne, an intoxicated king elephant, the racing horses, a life free from ailments and calamities, a kingdom without enemies are only obtained with the grace of god Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: अनास्वादितगोविन्दपदाम्बुजरजोरसः मनोरथपथातीतं स्फीतं नाकलयेत् फलम्
verses.transliteration: anāsvāditagovindapadāmbujarajorasaḥ manorathapathātītaṃ sphītaṃ nākalayet phalam
verses.hindi: 'जिसने भगवान गोविंद के चरणकमल की रज का रस नहीं चखा, वह मनोरथ से भी परे इस विपुल फल को कभी नहीं पा सकता।'

verses.science: मार्कण्डेयवचः श्रुत्वा पाण्डुवंशसमुद्भवः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनर्चिताच्युतपदः पदम् आसादयेत् कथम् इन्द्रादिदुरवापं यन् मानवैः सुदुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: anarcitācyutapadaḥ padam āsādayet katham indrādiduravāpaṃ yan mānavaiḥ sudurāsadam
verses.translation: She said- Beloved son, may god Narayana, omnipresent, ocean of mercy and holder of conch, discus and gada weapons in hands protect you everywhere.
verses.hindi: 'भगवान अच्युत के चरणों की अर्चना किए बिना भला कोई वह परम पद कैसे पा सकता है जो इंद्र आदि देवताओं तथा मनुष्यों के लिए अत्यंत दुर्लभ है?'
verses.commentary: Sense: She said- Beloved son, may god Narayana, omnipresent, ocean of mercy and holder of conch, discus and gada weapons in hands protect you everywhere.
verses.science: अर्चयध्वं जगन्नाथं भूयो भूयो वदाम्यहम्। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि दूरे पदं तस्य सर्वासां संपदाम् इह कमलाकान्तकान्ताङ्घ्रिकमलं यः सुशीलयेत्
verses.transliteration: na hi dūre padaṃ tasya sarvāsāṃ saṃpadām iha kamalākāntakāntāṅghrikamalaṃ yaḥ suśīlayet
verses.hindi: 'जो लक्ष्मीपति भगवान के मनोहर चरणकमलों का भलीभाँति सेवन करता है, उसके लिए इस जगत की समस्त संपदाओं का पद तनिक भी दूर नहीं है।'

verses.science: फिर यहाँसे रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त हुआ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण महापातकसंततिः परमान्तकम् आप्नोति स विष्णुः सर्वदो ध्रुव
verses.transliteration: yasya smaraṇamātreṇa mahāpātakasaṃtatiḥ paramāntakam āpnoti sa viṣṇuḥ sarvado dhruva
verses.hindi: 'हे ध्रुव, जिनके स्मरण मात्र से महापातकों की परंपरा का पूर्ण अंत हो जाता है, वे भगवान विष्णु ही सबको सब कुछ देने वाले हैं।'
verses.commentary: Sense: q chmuMM ^m<w3T:iu^n

verses.science: धर्मपुत्र युधिष्ठिरकी भार्याका हरण करके तुम रेवा- तटवर्ती मठमें चले जाओगे, उस समय तुम्हें शापसे मुक्ति मिल जायगी। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद् आहुः परमं ब्रह्म प्रधानपुरुषात् परम् यन्मायया कृतं सर्वं स विष्णु कीर्तितो ऽर्थदः
verses.transliteration: yad āhuḥ paramaṃ brahma pradhānapuruṣāt param yanmāyayā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sa viṣṇu kīrtito 'rthadaḥ
verses.translation: Suta said- Dhruva, the child with childish valour entered into a flower garden by following the scented wind after leaving his palace. As that child was so far known to highways and mother as only god but unknown to the route of the forest he began to think a few moments with closed eyes.
verses.hindi: 'जिन्हें प्रधान (प्रकृति) और पुरुष से भी परे परम ब्रह्म कहा जाता है और जिनकी माया से यह सब कुछ रचित है, वे ही भगवान विष्णु समस्त मनोरथ पूर्ण करने वाले कहे गए हैं।'
verses.wordMeaning: Suta said- Dhruva, the child with childish valour entered into a flower garden by following the scented wind after leaving his palace.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- Dhruva, the child with childish valour entered into a flower garden by following the scented wind after leaving his palace.…
verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले--यह कहकर धर्मपुत्र युधिष्ठिरके देखते-ही-देखते वे राजा जयध्वज गरुडपर आरूढ हो विष्णुधामको चले गये, जहाँ लक्ष्मीजीके साथ भगवान् विष्णु सदा विर…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो यज्ञपुरुषो विष्णुर् वेदवेद्यो जनार्दनः अन्तरात्मास्य जगतः संतुष्टः किं न यच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo yajñapuruṣo viṣṇur vedavedyo janārdanaḥ antarātmāsya jagataḥ saṃtuṣṭaḥ kiṃ na yacchati
verses.hindi: 'जो यज्ञपुरुष, वेदवेद्य, जनार्दन और इस जगत के अंतरात्मा भगवान विष्णु हैं, उनके संतुष्ट हो जाने पर वे भला क्या नहीं देते?'

verses.science: करे तथा भलीभाँति भगवानूका पूजन करे तो उनको प्राप्त होनेवाले फलके विषयमें क्या कहना है? सूतजी बोले--मार्कण्डेयजीके उपर्युक्त वचन सुनकर पाण्डुवंशमें उत्पन्न रा…। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद् भूनर्तनवर्तिन्यः सिद्धयो ऽष्टौ नृपात्मज तम् आराध्य हृषीकेशं चतुर्वर्गो न दूरतः
verses.transliteration: yad bhūnartanavartinyaḥ siddhayo 'ṣṭau nṛpātmaja tam ārādhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ caturvargo na dūrataḥ

verses.sanskrit: सत्यम् उक्तं द्विजेन्द्रा वो विष्णोर् आराधनं प्रति कथं स भगवान् इज्यः स विधिश् चोपदिश्यताम्

verses.translation: On exit from the garden of the city, he thought - "What should I do? Where should I go? Who will assist me? When he came out from the grip of such pessimistic thoughts, he saw Saptarsi moving with phenomenal speed. Having seen them, who perhaps came there under the compulsion of his destiny, Dhruva was pleased. Their foreheads were smeared with Tilakas. They had kept Pavitrl of kusa grass in their fingers. Sacrificial thread was on their shoulder and they were seated on the hide of black deer. Dhruva went to them and bowed his head before them. His hands clasped and he explained his intention in humble speech after duly saluted them.
verses.hindi: (ध्रुव ने कहा) 'हे द्विजेंद्रो, आपने भगवान विष्णु की आराधना के विषय में परम सत्य कहा। कृपया यह उपदेश दीजिए कि उन भगवान का यजन किस विधि से किया जाए?'

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान् कलत्रं मित्राणि राज्यं स्वर्गापवर्गकम् वासुदेवं जपन् मर्त्यः सर्वं प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयम्

verses.translation: Suta said- The hermits fell in surprise on the humble speech, the etiquette, fascinating face and splendour in complexion of the boy and called him to sit by their side and said- "Dear son, we could not so far understand the reason for unattachment or reluctance of your mind from the worldly affairs. As unattachment generally takes place in the mind of people unsatisfied, how do you fall in that category when you are the son of a king who rules over the seven continents? What do you want from us? What is your desire?
verses.hindi: 'भगवान वासुदेव के मंत्र का जप करने वाला मनुष्य पुत्र, पत्नी, मित्र, राज्य, स्वर्ग और मोक्ष—सब कुछ निःसंदेह प्राप्त कर लेता है।'

O philanthropic hermits, I am only in need to know from you the position not yet occupied by any king, supreme and intact and rare even for the gods like Indra etc." As a reply to that child, the hermits explained solemnly as under

verses.translation: Suta said- All hermits vanished with these words and Dhruva too departed for the penance by doing concentration on Vasudeva. The twelve lettered hymn provides with all desires fulfilled definitely. He began to do japa according to the procedure told by hermits at the bank of Yamuna in Madhuvana. It was the effect of the reverence of Dhruva that he began to see god Vi§nu, lotus-eyed within his heart. His figure was divine. It increased the vigour of Dhruva and he vigorously started japa of that hymn. No physical pains like hunger, thirst, rain, cyclone, storm and excess heat etc., could disturb him. His mind was diving into the ocean of pleasure at all moments. He had even forgotten his physique. It is said that the gods created several causes for disturbance under suspicion of his penance, but all those were proved futile for that child. That hermit in Visnu form did not fall in the trap of the hurdles like perpetual living at a single

verses.translation: The prince was dazzled and fall in prey of disappointment as a reason of seeing the master of three-world before him. He tangled on the questions as to what to say and what to do for a while. His- eyes were filled with tears of pleasure and hair uplift in a state of romance. He only could say "O the master of three-world" and then fell on the feet of god. His brows were shivering and saluting with full length of body laid on the ground, staring at god he wept for many hours rolling here and there due to excess state of pleasure. The lotus-eyed god was seen that day by Dhruva who is worshipped by Narada, Sanandana, Sanaka and Sanatkumara etc. and other yogis, the Yogls'vara whose eyes were filled with the tears of kindness. God Cakradhara, caught Dhruva by his hands and lifted him up. He dusted his body full of dust, embraced him

verses.sanskrit: अखिलमुनिजननिवहनमितचरणः । खरकदनकरः । चपलचरितः । देवाराधितपादजलः । सजलजलधरश्यामः । शमितसौभपतिशाल्वाधामा । अभिरामरामातिविनयकृतनवरसरसापहतेन्द्रियसुररमणीविहितान्तःकरणानन्दः । अनादिनिधनः । अधननिजद्विजमित्रोद्धरणधीरः । अवधीरितसुरनाथनाथितविपक्षपक्षः । ऋक्षराजबिलप्रवेशापहतस्यमन्तकापमार्जित निजापवाददूरितहृतत्रैलोक्यभारः । द्वारकावासनिरतः । स्वरितमधुरवेणुवादनश्रवणामृतप्रकटित अतीन्द्रियज्ञानः । यमुनातटचरः । द्विजधेनुभृङ्गगणैस् त्यक्तनिजनिजाहारः । संसारदुस्तरपारावारसमुत्तारणाङ्घ्रिपोतः । स्वप्रतापानलहुतकालयवनः । वनमालाधरवरमणिकुण्डलालंकृतश्रवणः । नानाप्रसिद्धाभिधानः । निगमविबुधमुनिजनवचनमनोगोचरः । कनकपिशङ्गकौशेयवासो भगवान् भृगुपदकौस्तुभविभूषितोरःस्थलः । स्वदयिताक्रूरनिजजननीगोकुलपालकचतुर् भुजशङ्खचक्रगदापद्मतुलसीनवदल दामहारकेयूरकटकमुकुटालंकृतः । सुनन्दनादिभागवतोपासितविश्वरूपः । पुराणपुरुषोत्तमः । उत्तमश्लोकः । लोकावासो वासुदेवः । श्रीदेवकीजठरसंभूतः । भूतपतिविरञ्चिनतचरणारविन्दः । वृन्दावनकृतकेलिगोपिकाजनश्रमापहः । सततं संपादितसुजनकामः । कुन्दनिभशङ्खधरम् इन्दुनिभवक्त्रं सुन्दरसुदर्शनम् उदारतरहासं विद्वज्जनवन्दितम् इदं ये रूपम् अतिहृद्यम् अखिलेश्वरं नतो ऽस्मि । स्थानाभिकामी तपसि स्थितो ऽहम् त्वां दृष्टवान् साधुमुनीन्द्रगुह्यम् काचं विचिन्वन्न् इव दिव्यरत्नं स्वामिन् कृतार्थो ऽस्मि वरान् न याचि

verses.hindi: 'समस्त मुनिजनों द्वारा वंदित चरणों वाले, खर-दूषण के संहारक, अद्भुत लीलाकारी, देवताओं द्वारा अर्चित चरणोदक वाले, सजल मेघसमान श्याम, सौभपति शाल्व के मदमर्दक, अनादि-अनंत, निर्धन द्विज-मित्र (सुदामा) के उद्धारक, इंद्र द्वारा संरक्षित विपक्षियों के विजेता, जांबवान् की गुफा में जाकर स्यमंतक मणि द्वारा अपने अपवाद को मिटाने वाले, त्रिलोकी के भारहर्ता, द्वारकावासी, मधुर वेणुनाद से अतींद्रिय ज्ञान प्रकट करने वाले, यमुनातटविहारी, संसार-सागर से पार उतारने वाले चरण-नौका रूप, अपने प्रतापाग्नि से कालयवन को भस्म करने वाले, वनमाला व मणिकुंडलधारी, वेद-देव-मुनियों के मन-वचन से अगोचर, सुवर्ण पीतांबरधारी, भृगुपद व कौस्तुभ से सुशोभित वक्षस्थल वाले, चतुर्भुज शंख-चक्र-गदा-पद्म व तुलसीदलमालाधारी, मुकुट-कुंडल-कंकण से अलंकृत, सुनंदन आदि भागवतों द्वारा उपासित विश्वरूप, पुराणपुरुषोत्तम, उत्तमश्लोक, देवकीनंदन वासुदेव, ब्रह्मा-शिव द्वारा वंदित चरणकमल, वृंदावनविहारी, सज्जनों की कामना पूर्ण करने वाले, कुंदसमान शंखधारी, चंद्रमुख, सुंदर सुदर्शनधारी, उदार हास्य वाले अखिलेश्वर को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ। हे स्वामिन्, मैं तो एक सांसारिक स्थान की इच्छा से तपस्या करने बैठा था और जैसे काँच का टुकड़ा खोजते हुए किसी को दिव्य रत्न मिल जाए, वैसे ही मैंने मुनींद्रों के लिए भी गुह्य आपका दर्शन पा लिया—अब मैं कृतार्थ हो गया, मुझे कोई अन्य वर नहीं चाहिए।'

verses.science: पृथ्वीप्रदक्षिणफलं प्राप्य विष्णुपुरे वसेत्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.hindi: 'हे नाथ, पहले कभी न देखे गए आपके इन चरणकमलों को देखकर अब मैं इन्हें दृढ़ता से थामे रहूँगा और कभी न छोड़ूँगा। मैं कोई सांसारिक कामना नहीं माँगता; भला ऐसा कौन मूर्ख होगा जो कल्पवृक्ष के पास जाकर केवल भूसा माँगे?'

verses.science: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वां मोक्षबीजं शरणं प्रपन्नः शक्नोमि भोक्तुं न बहिःसुखानि रत्नाकरे देव सति स्वनाथे विभूषणं काचमयं न युक्तम्

verses.translation: The prince Dhruva then asked only that he could gain the power to worship him. God Visnu touched the white conch-shell an apparent seance like, to the lips of Dhruva on hearing his desire. The heart of Dhruva was already purified as a result of the preaching delivered by Marici etc., hermits and now with the touch of the conch-shell, the sun of knowledge has arisen with all radiation therein. He thus, in the pleasure of knowledge, began to pray to the god in following words
verses.hindi: 'हे देव, मोक्ष के बीज स्वरूप आपकी शरण में आकर अब मैं बाहरी तुच्छ सुखों का भोग नहीं करना चाहता। जब रत्नाकर स्वयं अपने स्वामी हों, तब काँच के आभूषण की कामना करना उचित नहीं है।'
verses.wordMeaning: The prince Dhruva then asked only that he could gain the power to worship him. God Visnu touched the white conch-shell an apparent seance like, to the lips of Dhruva on hearing his desire.…

verses.translation: Dhurva said- I salute the god whose lotus feet are worshipped by all hermits, who had killed the monster Khara and Dhenukasura disguised as a donkey, whose childhood was full of capricious acts, whose feet washed water (Gahga) is worshipped by the gods, whose complexion is like the watery clouds, who had made cool for ever the Dhama (splendour) of Salva, the king of Saubha aircraft, who had exhibited Rasallla with innovative introduction of love within the hearts of the beautiful Gopls (the damsels of Gopas) and who filled the hearts of the divine damsels come under the influence of that Rasa, who is beyond beginning and end, who with patience, brought prosperity to the once poorest friend Sudama, who had defeated the enemy on request made by god Indra, who had washed the scare imposed on him by bringing back the Syamantaka gem, once lost from the cave of the king bear Jambavan and killed Durita, who lives in Dvarakapuri daily, who exhibits the intuitive power by playing the flute with ear-pleasing melody and walks around the bank of Yamuna river, whose flute playing is so enchanting as the birds, cows and bees abandon their food in order to listen to the same, whose lotus feet are ship-like for crossing the ever tough ocean of world, who had made oblation Kalayavana to his fire of valour, who wears the wild garland, whose
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार वरदान देकर कृतार्थ करने के बाद भगवान मुकुंद प्रत्यक्ष शरीर से ही धीरे-धीरे अपने भक्त की ओर बारंबार मुड़कर देखते हुए अपने परम धाम चले गए।

verses.commentary: Sense: ipT 3T d=<ci< yt|Tts Dhurva said- I salute the god whose lotus feet are worshipped by all hermits, who had killed the monster Khara and Dhenukasura disguised as a donkey, whose childhood was full of capricious acts, whose feet washed water (Gahga) is worshipped by the gods,…
verses.science: राजकुमार! भक्तिपूर्वक देवदेव विष्णुकी एक बार प्रदक्षिणा करनेसे मनुष्योंको जो फल मिलता है, उसे सुनिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तावच् च सद्यः सुरसिद्धसङ्घः श्रीविष्णुतद्भक्तसमागमं तम् दृष्ट्वाथ वर्षन् सुरपुष्पवृष्टिं तुष्टाव हर्षाद् ध्रुवम् अव्ययं च
verses.transliteration: tāvac ca sadyaḥ surasiddhasaṅghaḥ śrīviṣṇutadbhaktasamāgamaṃ tam dṛṣṭvātha varṣan surapuṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tuṣṭāva harṣād dhruvam avyayaṃ ca
verses.translation: Vedas and the gods and hermits, who puts on yellow silk golden clothes, whose chest is adorned with the foot-prints of Bhrgu and kaustubha gem, who favours his devotee Akrura, mother and Gokula, who is adorned with the garlands of basil, pearls, keyura, bangle and crown with conch, discus, gada and lotus flower in four hands, the universal form Hari, worshipped by Sunandana etc., devotees, who is Purana Purusottama, illustrious and Vasudeva, the living sites of all lokas, who appeared from the womb of who is saluted with reverence by Siva and Brahma, who provides relaxation to the Gopls, weary of the acts done in Vrndavana, who fulfils the desires of gentlemen, who holds the white conch-shell radiant as kunda flowers, whose face is moon-like, beautiful eyes, fascinating smile and who is worshipped by the scholars with this enchanting complexion.
verses.hindi: तत्काल ही देवता और सिद्धों के समूह श्रीविष्णु और उनके भक्त का वह अद्भुत समागम देखकर दिव्य पुष्पों की वर्षा करने लगे और हर्षपूर्वक अचल ध्रुव की स्तुति करने लगे।
verses.wordMeaning: ears are trimmed with the pretty rings made of gems, who is popular with a number of names, who is invisible and inaccessible to the words of the Vedas and the gods and hermits, who puts on yellow silk golden clothes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: ears are trimmed with the pretty rings made of gems, who is popular with a number of names, who is invisible and inaccessible to the words of the Vedas and the gods and hermits, who puts on yellow silk golden clothes,…
verses.science: मुक्त होकर विष्णुलोकमें पूजित होता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रियाभिमत्या च सुनीतिसूनुर् विभाति देवैर् अपि वन्द्यमानः यो ऽयं नृणां कीर्तनदर्शनाभ्याम् आयुर् यशो वर्धयति श्रियं च
verses.transliteration: śriyābhimatyā ca sunītisūnur vibhāti devair api vandyamānaḥ yo 'yaṃ nṛṇāṃ kīrtanadarśanābhyām āyur yaśo vardhayati śriyaṃ ca
verses.translation: As a man finds the divine gem under the phenomenon of his luck in spite of his search for the piece of glass, I also exactly have been opportuned of seeing you in an apparent form, so tough to see for the great hermits even in spite of my basic desire for obtaining the highest position. O lord, I am now fulfilled and no other boon is required by me. Your lotus feet which I could see this time luckily a rare thing to find, cannot be abandoned by me now. I will not ask for the enjoyment any more as a stupid man only will expect mere fodder from Kalpavrksa. O god, I am shelter by you who are the sole cause for emancipation and I am unable to fall down again for the worldly pleasure. When the sea (treasure of gems) has becomes ones master, he will not like to satisfy with the ornaments made of glass. O god, hence, I don't ask for any other thing except everlasting devotion to your lotus feet. O master god, please, boon me this only. I frequently, pray to you.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार सुनीति के पुत्र ध्रुव देवताओं द्वारा भी वंदित होते हुए असीम शोभा से प्रकाशित हैं; इनके नाम-कीर्तन और दर्शन से मनुष्यों की आयु, यश और श्री की वृद्धि होती है।
verses.wordMeaning: As a man finds the divine gem under the phenomenon of his luck in spite of his search for the piece of glass, I also exactly have been opportuned of seeing you in an apparent form,…
verses.commentary: Sense: As a man finds the divine gem under the phenomenon of his luck in spite of his search for the piece of glass, I also exactly have been opportuned of seeing you in an apparent form,…
verses.science: होता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं ध्रुवः प्राप पदं दुरापं हरेः प्रसादान् न च चित्रम् एतत् तस्मिन् प्रसन्ने द्विजराजपत्रे न दुर्लभं भक्तजनेषु किंचित्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ dhruvaḥ prāpa padaṃ durāpaṃ hareḥ prasādān na ca citram etat tasmin prasanne dvijarājapatre na durlabhaṃ bhaktajaneṣu kiṃcit
verses.translation: Suta said- Seeing Dhruva so excellent in prayer by virtue of divine knowledge so obtained, the god said
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार ध्रुव ने भगवान हरि की कृपा से वह दुर्लभ पद प्राप्त किया—इसमें कोई आश्चर्य नहीं, क्योंकि गरुड़ध्वज प्रभु के प्रसन्न होने पर भक्तजनों के लिए कुछ भी दुर्लभ नहीं रहता।
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- Seeing Dhruva so excellent in prayer by virtue of divine knowledge so obtained, the god said-
verses.science: (अर्थात् पूरे एक कल्पतक) इन्द्र्लोकमें निवास करता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यमण्डलमानात् तु द्विगुणं सोममण्डलम् पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे तस्मान् नक्षत्रमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: sūryamaṇḍalamānāt tu dviguṇaṃ somamaṇḍalam pūrṇe śatasahasre dve tasmān nakṣatramaṇḍalam
verses.hindi: सूर्यमंडल के परिमाण से दुगुना चंद्रमंडल है और उससे दो लाख योजन ऊपर नक्षत्रमंडल स्थित है।

verses.science: यो गां पयस्विनीं विष्णो: कपिलां सम्प्रयच्छति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वे लक्षे ऽपि बुधस्यापि स्थानं नक्षत्रमण्डलात् तावत्प्रमाणभागे तु बुधस्याप्य् उशना स्थितः
verses.transliteration: dve lakṣe 'pi budhasyāpi sthānaṃ nakṣatramaṇḍalāt tāvatpramāṇabhāge tu budhasyāpy uśanā sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Sri god said- "Infamy to the effect that Dhruva could not get anything of worldly importance, may spread in the commune of people. Hence, you first obtain the supreme position once wished by you. Subsequently, you will regain me by the flux of a certain time frame. You along with your mother Suniti will be in vicinity of me thereafter as an axis to all stars and planets and will be praised by Kalpavrksa as also all people.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रमंडल से दो लाख योजन ऊपर बुध ग्रह का स्थान है और बुध से उतने ही अंतर पर शुक्र ग्रह स्थित हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Sri god said- "Infamy to the effect that Dhruva could not get anything of worldly importance, may spread in the commune of people. Hence, you first obtain the supreme position once wished by you. Subsequently, you will regain me by the flux of a certain time frame.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sri god said- "Infamy to the effect that Dhruva could not get anything of worldly importance, may spread in the commune of people. Hence, you first obtain the supreme position once wished by you. Subsequently, you will regain me by the flux of a certain time frame.…
verses.science: एवं यः पूजयेद्राजन् नरसिंहं नरोत्तमः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारको ऽपि शुक्रस्य तावन्माने व्यवस्थितः लक्षद्वयं तु भौमस्य स्थितो देवपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: aṅgārako 'pi śukrasya tāvanmāne vyavasthitaḥ lakṣadvayaṃ tu bhaumasya sthito devapurohitaḥ
verses.hindi: शुक्र से उतने ही परिमाण पर मंगल ग्रह स्थित हैं और मंगल से दो लाख योजन ऊपर देवगुरु बृहस्पति स्थित हैं।

verses.sanskrit: सौरिर् बृहस्पतेश् चोर्ध्वं द्विलक्षे तु व्यवस्थितः तस्माच् छनैश्चराद् ऊर्ध्वं लक्षे सप्तर्षिमण्डलम्

verses.hindi: बृहस्पति से दो लाख योजन ऊपर शनिदेव स्थित हैं और शनिदेव से एक लाख योजन ऊपर सप्तर्षिमंडल स्थित है।

verses.science: कारयेल्लक्षहोमं तु ग्रामे यत्र पुराधिपः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षिमण्डलाद् ऊर्ध्वम् एकं लक्षं ध्रुवः स्थितः मेढीभूतः समस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य सत्तम
verses.transliteration: saptarṣimaṇḍalād ūrdhvam ekaṃ lakṣaṃ dhruvaḥ sthitaḥ meḍhībhūtaḥ samastasya jyotiścakrasya sattama
verses.translation: Srisutaji said- Thus, god appeared in his apparent form before Dhruva, fulfilled his desire with the above boons, saw frequently while vanishing from there and finally disappeared as also departed to Vaikuntha Dhama. In the meantime, the commune of gods gathered there, enjoyed the scene of face to face presence of god and the devotee, started showering flowers from the sky including words of appreciation for Dhruva. Dhurva, the son of Sunlti, is still enriched with honour and prosperity both, being worshipped by gods and he will incessantly enhance the age, fame and wealth of people who will see and worship him for ages to come.
verses.hindi: हे सत्तम, सप्तर्षिमंडल से एक लाख योजन ऊपर ध्रुव स्थित हैं, जो संपूर्ण ज्योतिश्चक्र के केंद्र-स्तंभ (मेढ़ीभूत) हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: qfsq guit gfofacskrwiT- Srisutaji said- Thus, god appeared in his apparent form before Dhruva, fulfilled his desire with the above boons, saw frequently while vanishing from there and finally disappeared as also departed to Vaikuntha Dhama. In the meantime,…

verses.science: शङ्करायतने चापि कोटिहोमं नराधिप। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावात् तपति विप्रेन्द्र अधश् चोर्ध्वं च रश्मिभिः कालसंख्यां त्रिलोकस्य स करोति युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: svabhāvāt tapati viprendra adhaś cordhvaṃ ca raśmibhiḥ kālasaṃkhyāṃ trilokasya sa karoti yuge yuge
verses.hindi: हे विप्रेन्द्र, सूर्यदेव अपने स्वभाव से अपनी किरणों द्वारा नीचे और ऊपर तपाते हुए युग-युग में तीनों लोकों की कालगणना करते हैं।

verses.science: नरसिंहं समाराध्य लक्षहोमं तु कारयेत् एवमादिफलोपेते नरसिंहार्चनं नृप। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: जनस् तपस् तथा सत्यम् एतांल् लोकान् द्विजोत्तम ब्रह्मणा मुनिशार्दूल विष्णुभक्तिविवर्धितः

verses.hindi: हे मुनिशार्दूल द्विजोत्तम, जनलोक, तपोलोक और सत्यलोक—इन लोकों को ब्रह्माजी के सहित विष्णुभक्ति से वर्धित ध्रुव प्रकाशित करते हैं।

verses.science: गौ दान करता है और उन भगवान् नृसिंहके समक्ष उसका उत्तम दूध थोड़ा-सा भी अर्पण करता है, वह विष्णुलोकमें सम्मानित होता है तथा राजन्! उसके पितर चिरकालतक श्वेतद्वी…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.transliteration: ūrdhvagatair dvijaśreṣṭha raśmibhis tapate raviḥ adhogataiś ca bhūrlokaṃ dyotate dīrghadīdhitiḥ
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ, दीर्घ किरणों वाले सूर्यदेव ऊर्ध्वगामी किरणों से ऊपरी लोकों को तपाते हैं और अधोगामी किरणों से भूर्लोक को प्रकाशित करते हैं।

verses.transliteration: ādityamaṇḍalādhastād bhuvarlokaṃ pratiṣṭhitam trailokyasyeśvaratvaṃ ca viṣṇudattaṃ śatakratoḥ
verses.hindi: सूर्यमंडल के नीचे भुवर्लोक प्रतिष्ठित है और भगवान विष्णु द्वारा इंद्र को त्रिलोकी का स्वामित्व प्रदान किया गया है।

verses.science: नरेश! इसी प्रकार शङ्करजीके मन्दिरमें भी संयमशील ब्राह्मणोंके द्वारा उन्हें भोजन और दक्षिणा देकर एक करोड्की संख्यामें हवन कराना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालैः स सहितो लोकान् रक्षति धर्मतः वसेत् स्वर्गे महाभाग देवेन्द्रः स तु कीर्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: lokapālaiḥ sa sahito lokān rakṣati dharmataḥ vaset svarge mahābhāga devendraḥ sa tu kīrtimān
verses.translation: Thus, by the grace of god Visnu, Dhruva had obtained the supreme and rare position as it is not surprising. Nothing remains impossible or rare for a devotee on whom god is pleased. The dimension of moon is just double than the dimension of the sun- orbit. The galaxy is as high as two lakh yojana from the moon, Budha is situated at an altitude of two lakh yojana from the galaxy and Venus is situated at an equal altitude from the Mars situated at two lakh yojana from Venus and the Jupiter (Devaguru) is situated at the distance of two lakh yojana from the Mars. The Saturn further is situated at the distance of two lakh yojana from Jupiter and the orbit of Saptarsi is situated at the distance of two lakh yojana from the Saturn. Dhruva is situated at the distance of one lakh yojana from the orbit of Saptarsi. O the crown of sages, he is the nucleus of the orbit of light
verses.hindi: वे कीर्तिमान् महाभाग देवराज इंद्र लोकपालों के साथ धर्मपूर्वक लोकों की रक्षा करते हुए स्वर्ग में निवास करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, by the grace of god Visnu, Dhruva had obtained the supreme and rare position as it is not surprising. Nothing remains impossible or rare for a devotee on whom god is pleased. The dimension of moon is just double than the dimension of the sun- orbit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, by the grace of god Visnu, Dhruva had obtained the supreme and rare position as it is not surprising. Nothing remains impossible or rare for a devotee on whom god is pleased. The dimension of moon is just double than the dimension of the sun- orbit.…
verses.science: और ब्राह्मणभोजन करानेसे उसका दोष मिट जाता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽधस्तान् मुने चेदं पातालं विद्धि सप्रभम् न तत्र तपते सूर्यो न रात्रिर् न निशाकरः

verses.commentary: Sense: O the great Brahmin, the god Sun usually transmits heat to the lokas (worlds) above and below through his rays. He only ascertains the quantum of time for the three- worlds in every age. O the best hermit,

verses.translation: The Sun god created the three-worlds and he sweeps out all evils. He stands like an umbrella and appears from one orbit to another. Thus, the light is transmitted by him. The Bhuvarloka is situated below the orbit of Sun. God Visnu has entrusted the administration of three-worlds to Satakratu

verses.science: सुक्तास्ते मुनिशार्दूल ये विष्णुं नार्चयन्ति वै त्वत््रसादाच्छुतं होतन्नरसिंहार्चनक्रमम्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.translation: Indra. He along with the lokapalas protects these worlds in orderly manner. O learned, that illustrious Indra resides in the heaven. Below these seven lokas, the nether region is situated. Neither heat of sun nor light of moon exists there i.e., there is no cycle of day and night. O the great Brahmin, the people residing in the nether region are self- illuminating. Maharloka is situated above one crore yojana from the heaven. O Brahmin, the Janaloka is situated at an altitude just double than Maharloka i.e., two crore yojana. It is called the fifth loka. Tapoloka is situated at an altitude of four crore from that. Satyaloka is located above eight crore yojana from there. It is also called Brahmaloka. All these lokas are arranged one above the other like an umbrella. Visnuloka is situated at sixteen crore yojana from the Brahmaloka. The philanthropists have described the magnificence of Visnuloka in Varahapurana. O Brahmin, Parama Purusa is situated above it. Parama Purusa is apparent supreme soul distinct from the Brahmanda. The man known to this fact, does penance and acquire knowledge and thus, absolves himself from the bondage of ignorance (Avidya).
verses.hindi: तप और ज्ञान से संपन्न साधक जीव-पाशों से मुक्त हो जाता है। हे निष्पाप, मैंने आपको भूगोल की यह संपूर्ण व्यवस्था सुनाई; जो इसे सम्यक् रूप से जानता है, वह परम गति को प्राप्त होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Indra. He along with the lokapalas protects these worlds in orderly manner. O learned, that illustrious Indra resides in the heaven. Below these seven lokas, the nether region is situated. Neither heat of sun nor light of moon exists there i.e.,…

verses.sanskrit: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि चरितं तस्य धीमतः सहस्रानीकस्य हरेर् अवतारांश् च मे शृणु

verses.translation: Thus, the end of thirtyone chapter in Nrsirhha
verses.hindi: (सूतजी ने कहा) अच्छा, अब मैं आपको बुद्धिमान राजा सहस्रानीक का चरित्र और भगवान श्रीहरि के पावन अवतारों की कथा सुनाता हूँ, आप सुनिए।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the end of thirtyone chapter in Nrsirhha
verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले--नृप! पूर्वकालमें इसी विषयको बृहस्पतिजीने शौनक ऋषिसे पूछा था, इसके उत्तरमें उनसे शौनकजीने जो कुछ बताया, वही मैं तुमसे कह रहा हूँ। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.translation: Description on Sahasranlka, Sri Nrsimha . worship and magnificence of god
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों द्वारा अपने राज्य पर अभिषिक्त किए जाने पर राजपुत्र सहस्रानीक धर्मपूर्वक राज्य का पालन करने लगे।
verses.commentary: Sense: Description on Sahasranlka, Sri Nrsimha . worship and magnificence of god
verses.science: बृहस्पतिजी बोले--विप्रेन्द्र लक्षहोम और कोटिहोम- के लिये जो भूमि प्रशस्त हो, उसको मुझे बताइये और होमकर्मकी विधिका भी वर्णन कीजिये॥ ४१/॥ मार्कण्डेयजी बोले-नृप…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पालयतो राज्यं राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः भक्तिर् बभूव देवेशे नरसिंहे सुरोत्तमे

verses.sanskrit: तं द्रष्टुम् आगतः साक्षाद् विष्णुभक्तं भृगुः पुरा अर्घ्यपाद्यासनै राजा तम् अभ्यर्च्याब्रवीद् इदम्

verses.translation: O Suta, I am now inclined to listen to the account of deeds performed by Sahasranlka and the story pertaining to the various incarnations of god Visnu. O revered scholar, please, let me know the same.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन काल में उन विष्णुभक्त राजा से मिलने साक्षात् महर्षि भृगु पधारे। राजा ने अर्घ्य, पाद्य और आसन देकर उनकी पूजा की और बोले—
verses.commentary: Sense: BharadvajajI said- O Suta, I am now inclined to listen to the account of deeds performed by Sahasranlka and the story pertaining to the various incarnations of god Visnu. O revered scholar, please, let me know the same.
verses.science: चतुरस्रं चतुष्कोणं तुल्यसूत्रेण कारयेत्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नरसिंहं प्रतिष्ठाप्य देवदेवं सनातनम् आराधयितुम् इच्छामि विधानं तत्र मे वद

verses.translation: Suta said- O Brahmin, it is very well. I will now describe the deeds performed my the wise Sahasranlka and the incarnations of god. Please, listen to it attentively.
verses.hindi: 'मैं सनातन देवाधिदेव भगवान नरसिंह की स्थापना करके उनकी आराधना करना चाहता हूँ; कृपया मुझे उसका समुचित विधान बताइए।'
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- O Brahmin, it is very well. I will now describe the deeds performed my the wise Sahasranlka and the incarnations of god. Please, listen to it attentively.
verses.science: जुहुयादेकचित्तेन स्वाहाकारान्वितां बुध: गायत्री छन्दसां माता ब्रह्मयोनिः प्रतिष्ठिता। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अवतारान् अशेषांश् च देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः श्रोतुम् इच्छामि सकलांस् तान् पुण्यान् अपि मे वद

verses.sanskrit: शृणु भूपालपुत्र त्वं न हि कश्चित् कलौ युगे हरौ भक्तिं करोत्य् अत्र नृसिंहे चातिभक्तिमान्

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावाद् यस्य भक्तिः स्यान् नरसिंहे सुरोत्तमे तस्यारयः प्रणश्यन्ति कार्यसिद्धिश् च जायते

verses.translation: Having crowned by the great Brahmins, the erstwhile prince ruling, the king so crowned had become a devotee to the supreme god Nrsiriiha. In ancient times, once the great hermit Bhrgu himself had come to see such a Visnu devotee king. The king honoured Bhrgu with arghya (sprinkle water), padya (washing the feet) and cisana (offering of seat) and said- O great hermit, I have become holy as a reflection of your image which I could see this time. The people devoid of great deeds can rarely see you in this Kali era. I am eager to worship with a permanent installation of everlasting Nrsimha here. Please tell me the procedure for such an installation of icon. Moreover, I am curious to listen to all incarnations Sri Hari had accepted. So, please tell me the story of all incarnations in which Sri Hari had appeared on this earth.
verses.hindi: 'जिनकी स्वभाव से ही सुरोत्तम भगवान नरसिंह में भक्ति होती है, उनके समस्त शत्रु नष्ट हो जाते हैं और प्रत्येक कार्य सिद्ध होता है।'
verses.wordMeaning: Having crowned by the great Brahmins, the erstwhile prince ruling, the king so crowned had become a devotee to the supreme god Nrsiriiha. In ancient times, once the great hermit Bhrgu himself had come to see such a Visnu devotee king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Having crowned by the great Brahmins, the erstwhile prince ruling, the king so crowned had become a devotee to the supreme god Nrsiriiha. In ancient times, once the great hermit Bhrgu himself had come to see such a Visnu devotee king.…
verses.science: है; सभी बातें न संघटित हों तो पूर्व-पूर्वकी भूमि उत्तम है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् अतीव हरेर् भक्तः पाण्डुवंशे ऽपि सत्तमः तेन ते निखिलं वक्ष्ये शृणुष्वैकाग्रमानसः

verses.translation: Bhfgu replied - O prince, nobody in this Kali era worships god Nrsimha with keen devotion. A usual birth of devotion for god Nrsimha, automatically destroys all enemies of such a devotee and all his efforts meet grand success. Your are only a gentle man in your Pandu dynasty who is so devoted to god Nrsimha. I would, therefore, tell you all that is required by you. Be attentive and listen to the same.
verses.hindi: 'जो भक्तिमान् मनुष्य भगवान नरसिंह का सुंदर मंदिर बनवाता है, वह समस्त पापों से मुक्त होकर विष्णुलोक प्राप्त करता है।'
verses.wordMeaning: Bhfgu replied - O prince, nobody in this Kali era worships god Nrsimha with keen devotion. A usual birth of devotion for god Nrsimha, automatically destroys all enemies of such a devotee and all his efforts meet grand success.…

verses.science: इसके बाद यजमानको चाहिए कि वह ब्राह्मणोचित कर्मका पालन करनेवाले वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मणोंको शास्त्रोक्त रीतिसे आमन्त्रित करे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.translation: The devotee is absolved from all evils and attains a place in the abode of Visnu who installs god Nrsimha in a beautiful temple constructed for it. One who arranges to design a fascinating icon of god Nrsimha, gets relieved from all evils and ultimately takes a departure to Visnuloka (abode of Visnu). O greatman, the man who decorates and installs god Nrsimha orderly and without any physical passions in mind attains relief from all physical ills. A regular worship of god Nrsimha after the installation of the idol, fulfils all desires of the devotee and he attains to the supreme position. All gods in ancient times, had worshipped god Visnu and it was the grace of god which had made all gods including Brahma to attain their higher places. O king, the kings of heroic deeds like Mandhata etc. had directly attained their place in heaven, by virtue of their devotion to god Visnu. There is no scope for any other thought and in fact, the regular worshipper of the king god Nrsimha enjoys the pleasure of both salvation and heaven. You too will definitely attain to the aim duly thought by you as a result of exclusive concentration on god Nrsimha throughout your life under a firm determination. O king, the man attains a permanent place beyond the cycle of birth and death who makes the sculptures to design an icon of god Nrsimha and establishes the same in a temple in pursuance of the prescribed procedure. In case, the man could devote himself in a regular manner to worship of god so immortal and chivalrous as his lotus feet are worshipped by gods as also the demons, he attains the apparent form of god
verses.hindi: 'हे राजन्, जो भगवान जनार्दन की मूर्ति बनवाकर विधिपूर्वक स्थापना करता है, उसका विष्णुलोक से कभी पुनरागमन नहीं होता।'

verses.translation: The king said- O lord, I am curious to listen to the holy procedure for the worship of god particularly and in detail under the grace of your revered self. Tell me separately the consequences for a man cleans and sweeps as also another who washes the temple and trims it? What consequence or fruit is availed of when Kesava is bathed with pure water and further, tell me the consequence for bathing the god with milk, curd, ghee and pancagavya. What are the consequences for bathing the icon of god with hot water and that of with the water mixed with camphor and aguru? What are further the consequences for offering arghya, padya and acamana, for bathing with the recital of hymns and offering clothes?

verses.science: वध किया; और राजकुमार! जिस प्रकार उन महात्माने यथा बद्धो बलिः पूर्वं वामनेन महात्मना। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतच् चान्यच् च यत् किंचिद् अज्ञानान् न प्रचोदितम् तत् सर्वं कथय ब्रह्मन् भक्तस्य मम केशवे

verses.translation: What consequences are for the worship of god with sandal and saffron and what are the consequences for lighting dipaka and incense sticks? What is the fruit for offering sweet meat (naivedya) and for going round (pradaksina) the temple. Similarly, what is the consequence for offering salute, psalm and prayer? What are the consequences for offering fan, cavtiara (palanquin), the flag and the conch-shell? O Brahmin, as my heart is absolutely tangled with god Kesava, please, tell me ail that has been enquired of and that too where my little consciousness could not access?
verses.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्, यह सब तथा अन्य जो कुछ मैंने अज्ञानवश न पूछा हो, वह सब मुझ केशव-भक्त को विस्तार से बताइए।
verses.wordMeaning: What consequences are for the worship of god with sandal and saffron and what are the consequences for lighting dipaka and incense sticks? What is the fruit for offering sweet meat (naivedya) and for going round (pradaksina) the temple. Similarly,…

verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य नित्य भगवान नरसिंह के मंदिर का संमार्जन (स्वच्छता) करता है, वह समस्त पापों से मुक्त होकर विष्णुलोक में आनंद मनाता है।
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- Bhrgu, the great hermit heard the queries but he assigned the reply to Markandeya and left that place at once. In pursuance of the instruction of Bhrgu, the great hermit, Markandeya appreciate the devotion of king for Hari and began to introduce the topic.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा युधिष्ठिरो राजा पञ्चभिर् भ्रातृभिर् युतः द्रौपद्या सह राजेन्द्र काननं विचचार ह

verses.translation: Markandeya said- O the king of Pandu clan, listen to the procedure of lord Visnu's worship in an orderly manner. You are devoted to Visnu and I, therefore, will tell you it all. The person who sweeps the temple of god Nrsimha, kicks-off his evils and attains to the pleasure of Visnuloka. The person who smears the land or premises of the temple, with cowdung, soil and water, attains to undepleting fruit for the same and enshrines himself in the abode of god Visnu. O innocent heart, an ancient episode is available in this context which is capable to sweep away all evils from the heart of a man.
verses.hindi: हे राजेंद्र, प्राचीन काल में राजा युधिष्ठिर अपने भाइयों और द्रौपदी के साथ वन में विचरण कर रहे थे।

verses.translation: Maharsi Narada had came at that place earlier to them and returned to his other destination. As the mental disposition of king Yudhisthira was free from the clutches of anger and disgust, he was thinking about having a holy meet with any hermit capable to guide them regarding that holy place. In the meantime, the monsters, Bahuroma and Sthulasira entered there. The monster, Bahuroma disfigured himself as a hermit with the mala-fide intention to abduct Draupadi. He pretended as if a hermit is in meditation there on a seat of kusa grass. A Kamandalu was kept beside him and Pavitrl of kusa grass was in his hand. He seemed to be reciting hymns with his eyes focused on the fore portion of the nose. A garland of Rudraksa was rotating on his fingers. He was seen when the Pandavas were walking in the forest nearby the bank of Narmada.

verses.translation: Before king Yudhisthira could complete his request to that hermit, another disfigured hermit alias a monster, Sthulasira appeared there. He was crying with fear and calling someone to provide protection. His expression was - Oh, who is here to protect us? The person usually attains everlasting wealth and fame for safe-guarding the interests of the man sheltered by him but here I am, a Brahmin whose protection brings unending consequences. On the one hand, the donation of the entire earth with daksina of the Meru mountain and protection of the dying people on the other are all equal. The person who ignores Brahmins, cow, woman and babies suffering under the clutches of the wicked, definitely falls in the hell known as Raurava (crying and weeping pains). I am looted of all that I had with me and prepared for the death owing to the suffering inflicted by the monsters. Who is so brave as to protect me? The wicked monster has snatched away my sphatic garland, kamandala and beautiful cot and slapped me with the loot of all that I had.
verses.hindi: द्रौपदी को उसी के पास छोड़कर वे सभी पांडव आवेश में उस दानव को पकड़ने के लिए काफी दूर निकल गए।

King Yudhisthitra then turned to the orbit of Sun god and prayed to the gods to disclose the truth for an such event with the recollection of his truthfulness, great deeds and bona- fide speech.

verses.commentary: Sense: Bhima then in a state of fury blew his fist on the head of that monster who was about to flee from there. The monster too became furious and blew the fist on Bhima. This struck a fierce fight between Bhima and that monster. Bhima could break his skull with extreme labour.
verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजी बोलेपूर्वकालमें देवासुर-संग्राममें जब देवगण हैत्योंद्वारा पराजित हो गये, तब वे सभी मिलकर क्षीरसागरनन्दिनी श्रीलक्ष्मीजीके पति भगवान् विष्णुकी शर…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: राजन् परमधर्मज्ञ हरिभक्तपरायण विष्णुभक्तिमतां पुंसां श्रेष्ठो ऽसि पुरुषर्षभ

verses.translation: On the other side, Arjuna reached the hermitage of that hermit but he neither saw that hermit nor his chaste wife Draupadl. He then climbed on a tree and saw from there that a monster was running fast with Draupadl on his shoulders. He further saw Draupadl wailing in the state of severe fear and bluttering loudly their names. Having seen Draupadl in that piteous condition, Arjuna ran towards her with making acute
verses.hindi: '"हे परम धर्मज्ञ और हरिभक्त राजन्, आप विष्णुभक्त पुरुषों में सर्वश्रेष्ठ पुरुषर्षभ हैं—"'
verses.wordMeaning: On the other side, Arjuna reached the hermitage of that hermit but he neither saw that hermit nor his chaste wife Draupadl. He then climbed on a tree and saw from there that a monster was running fast with Draupadl on his shoulders.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the other side, Arjuna reached the hermitage of that hermit but he neither saw that hermit nor his chaste wife Draupadl. He then climbed on a tree and saw from there that a monster was running fast with Draupadl on his shoulders.…
verses.science: 'वासुकिश्चागतस्तत्र राजन्नारायणाज्ञया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संमार्जनपरो नित्यं उपलेपरतस् तथा तन् मे वद महाभाग त्वया किं विदितं फलम्
verses.transliteration: saṃmārjanaparo nityaṃ upaleparatas tathā tan me vada mahābhāga tvayā kiṃ viditaṃ phalam
verses.translation: Owing to the force he was bearing while running, a number of trees were felled. That monster also guessed his power and he started running after leaving Draupadl behind. Arjuna did not yet leave him and continued chasing. That monster fell at last on the ground and turned in the appearance of god Visnu, with four hands and the conch, discus, gada etc., in them. Arjuna fell at sun rise still saluted and said.
verses.hindi: '"हे महाभाग, आप नित्य मंदिर में संमार्जन और उपलेपन में लगे रहते हैं; कृपया बताइए कि आपको इसका क्या फल ज्ञात है?"'
verses.wordMeaning: sound. Owing to the force he was bearing while running, a number of trees were felled. That monster also guessed his power and he started running after leaving Draupadl behind. Arjuna did not yet leave him and continued chasing.…

verses.sanskrit: कर्माण्य् अन्यानि सन्त्य् एव विष्णोः प्रियतराणि वै तथापि त्वं महाभाग एतयोः सततोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: karmāṇy anyāni santy eva viṣṇoḥ priyatarāṇi vai tathāpi tvaṃ mahābhāga etayoḥ satatodyataḥ
verses.hindi: '"भगवान विष्णु के अतिप्रिय अन्य भी अनेक कर्म हैं, फिर भी आप इन दोनों कर्मों में ही सदा उद्यत क्यों रहते हैं?"'

verses.translation: Arjuna said- God, why have you spread your illusion here? O god, I salute you and apologise for whatever 1 have done wrong under the deceit of your own illusion. O Jagannatha, all this have been done due to ignorance. I therefore, ask for your apology. How is a man expected to have such consciousness as to recognise you in the changed form.
verses.hindi: '"जातिस्मर होने के कारण मैं इसे जानता हूँ और यह श्रोताओं के लिए अत्यंत विस्मयकारी है। हे विप्रेन्द्र, पूर्वजन्म में मैं रैवत नामक ब्राह्मण था—"'

verses.translation: The four-armed said- O luckiest Arjuna, listen to my excellent deed in company of your brothers. It enhances the pleasure of audience. I was a popularly known king Jayadhvaja of Candra clan. I used to concentrate on the worship of god Narayana and the temple of Narayana was swept by me regularly. I smeared the temple daily and would light dlpaka at night. A gentle Brahmin, Vltihotra was my priest (Purohita) in those days. He fell in surprise when he saw me sweeping the temple.

verses.translation: Markandeya learned of Vedas and Puranas i.e., Vltihotra asked me one day - O king, you are the best among all other devotees of god Visnu because you sweep the temple daily. I therefore, ask you the consequences for the sweeping and smearing of the temple. Kindly, tell me whatever you know in this regard. There are numerous other works too and that equally please god yet you have confined your activity to these two works only. In case you know the fruit for such deeds and again if the same is not worth concealing and you love me to that extent, then please tell me the reality.
verses.hindi: '"हे द्विजोत्तमो, वहाँ सौ से भी अधिक ब्रह्मकल्पों तक दिव्य रूप और दिव्य भोगों का आनंद उठाकर—"'

verses.translation: Jayadhvaja said- O great Brahmin, listen to the deed performed by me in the previous life. I am known to the matters pertaining to the previous life because of my strong memory, My deed is worth surprise of the audience. O the crown of Brahmin, 1 was a Brahmin renowned as Raivata. I would then even push and inspire certain persons not authorised for doing yajna (offering) and thus, I was a priest (Purohits) of numerous villages. My deeds were not confined to this but I used to criticise others, was cruel and used to sell illicit and prohibited things. My relations had abandoned me owing to my perpetual involvement in forbidden deeds. I was a heinous evil-doer and always had envy of Brahmins. I was interested in the others wives and my passions were to snatch others money. To kill the creatures was my hobby. To sip wine daily and jealous of Brahmins was my routine. Thus, I indulged myself in evils and robbery was also not strange to me.
verses.hindi: '"क्रोधित होकर उन्होंने मुझे शाप दिया कि हे राजन्, तू राक्षस हो जा। उनका यह शाप सुनकर—"'
verses.wordMeaning: Jayadhvaja said- O great Brahmin, listen to the deed performed by me in the previous life. I am known to the matters pertaining to the previous life because of my strong memory, My deed is worth surprise of the audience. O the crown of Brahmin,…

In brief, the temple was delapidated. In order to satisfy my lust through intercourse with those women, I cleaned a little portion of the floor and lighted a lamp so that the things may seen there. (I had cleaned the floor and lighted the lamp only to satiate my lust) however, all my evils were effaced. verses.sanskrit: यः करोति हरेर् अर्चां मधुना स्नापयन् नरः अग्निलोके स मोदित्वा पुनर् विष्णुपुरे वसेत्

verses.translation: Suta said- The king Sahasranika of Pandu clan again tended to worship of god after hearing these words of the hermit Markandeya. O Brahmins, please, listen therefore, that god Narayana provides his devotees with emancipation engaged deliberately or innocently. I further reiterate the statement that you all should do worship of Jagannatha if you desire to cross the ever tough worldly ocean. The worshippers of god Visnu, saviour of the sheltered are honourable, adorable and worthy to salute particularly.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य मधु से स्नान कराकर श्रीहरि की अर्चना करता है, वह पहले अग्निलोक में आनंद भोगकर फिर विष्णुपुरी में निवास करता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Suta said- The king Sahasranika of Pandu clan again tended to worship of god after hearing these words of the hermit Markandeya. O Brahmins, please, listen therefore, that god Narayana provides his devotees with emancipation engaged deliberately or innocently.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- The king Sahasranika of Pandu clan again tended to worship of god after hearing these words of the hermit Markandeya. O Brahmins, please, listen therefore, that god Narayana provides his devotees with emancipation engaged deliberately or innocently.…

verses.sanskrit: पापकञ्चुकम् उन्मुच्य यथा जीर्णम् अहिस् त्वचम् दिव्यं विमानम् आस्थाय विष्णुलोके महीयते

verses.commentary: Sense: Sri Sahasranlka asked - O great learned and revered Markandeya, kindly, tell now the fruits for the deed performed as to remove or clean Nirmalya (the sandal smeared and the flowers offered).
verses.science: हिरण्याक्ष इति ख्यातो महाबलपराक्रमः पाताले निवसन् हैत्यो देवानृपरुरोध सः। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.translation: O king, a man offering a bath with pancagavya with the recital of hymns, attains the fruit ever reviving. One who washes the Padapltha (the slipper, a small bench for keeping the feet) duly by rubbing Vita leaves and using water, gets leave from his sins. Brahmaloka is obtained when a bath is offered with kusa and flower mixed water. A bath with gem kept water ensures Surayloka and a bath offered with gold kept water ensures Kuberaloka. A bath with water mixed with camphor and aguru ensures first Indraloka and then the abode of Visnu. The man attains Adityaloka and then is respected in Visnuloka who offers a bath to Govinda with the water brought from all renowned holy places.
