verses.translation: The illustrious Visvamitra thus completed the yajna under the protective cover provided by Rama and then satisfied the Rtvijas with donations abundantly. He then honoured the member participating in the yajna and appreciated both Rama and Laksmana for their bravery. The gods who attained their share from yajna then showered flowers on Sri Rama.

She had become a boulder due to the curse inflicted by Gautama, her husband when her debauchery was observed by him with Indra long-long years ago. The became free from the curse and got her usual shape as a phenomena of seeing Rama and returned to her husband. entertained them and a vast bow of Sankara was put in the pavilion after worship was performed, with flowers and the sandal etc.

verses.translation: The gallant and brave princes from a number of countries, had already reached Janakapura with a passion to marry Slta when they reached there. The Janaka duly Then the king Janaka made a declaration addressing all those kings - "O Princes, Slta can be a bride to the prince who will break this bow into two parts. The kings present there began to stretch the bow after the declaration but the shocks caused by the bow were even unbearable to them and their body felt a shivering experience with a push downward. It ashamed all the princes and kings. O King, Janaka, the king on failure of the kings, made the bow again set as before and waited for the arrival of Rama. Just then, Vis'vamitra entered into the palace

verses.translation: Janaka greeted Sri Rama, Laksmana and Visvamitra along with his disciples came there. Janaka became happy when he introduced with the etiquette and modesty he just saw in Rama and Laksmana. He offered them all the chairs made of gold for sitting. Having done this formality he asked Vis'vamitra - O Lord, tell me know what is to be done?"

verses.translation: Markandeya said- "In response to Janakas statement, the hermit said- O king, prince Rama is god Visnu and appeared as son of Das'aratha for the protection of all the three-worlds. verses.translation: Then the excellent bow was put as before with affirmation to the instructions of Vis'vamitra . On being allowed by Visvamitra, Rama, the son of Dasaratha stood up in the presence of all kings and bowing his head to the Brahmins and the god as well, he picked up the bow in his hands. He then put the string on it and just gave a jerk. This action with force split the bow into two parts. As the promise was kept, Slta came with a nice garland, put it round the neck of Rama in the presence of all Ksatriya kings and accepted him as her husband with all formalities duly performed. It made the kings upset and they began to shoot arrows at him with attack from all sides. Sri Rama also took his bow and shot at them. It cut the arrows and split their chariots. Sr! Rama with the application of his arts cut their bows and the flags too. The king of Mithila too arranged his army and began to give protection cover to Rama in that battle. Laksmana too drove away those kings by defeat and captured their elephants, horses and a number of chariots. He chased the kings who departed by leaving their chariots behind but registered by Janaka and Visvamitra

verses.translation: Having surpassed the army of the king, king Janaka entered into his decent palace in the company of Sr! Rama and Laksmana. He just then sent a messenger to king Dasaratha. The king Dasaratha then heard the entire news since Rama's departure and became happy. King Dasaratha then visited Mithila with his army, horses, elephants and chariots, the queens and sons etc. Janaka warmly greeted king Dasaratha. verses.sanskrit: श्वश्रूणाम् अर्पयित्वा तां निवृत्ता विविशुः पुरम् ततस् तु रामं गच्छन्तम् अयोध्यां प्रबलान्वितम्

verses.translation: Rama, stayed in Mithilapurl for a few days more with his brothers, mothers and mighty father. Having seen then Dasaratha passionate to return with his sons to Ayodhya, king Janaka offered wealth and gems, beautiful garments, trained elephants, horses along with slaves and maid servants to Rama and Slta. He bade farewell to his daughter Slta with reciting the hymns of the Vedas and blessing. Janaka then saluted king Dasaratha, Visvamitra and Vasistha and came back to his palace. The queens of Janaka also returned to the palace after assigning their daughters to their mother-in- laws and with the inspiration to serve their husband and in-laws.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् सीता को उनकी सासुओं को सौंपकर वे सब लौटकर नगर में चली गईं। उधर विशाल सेना के साथ श्रीराम को अयोध्या जाते हुए—

verses.translation: Vasistha said- You all should not worry for Rama. The father, mother, brother and other service class should not regret for the forthcoming problem and pain. Rama is incarnated to god Visnu. He has appeared in your palace ensuring protection for the world as a whole. The god himself he here whose mere prayer removes the person from the worldly fears. Hence, apprehension of any kind will prove only a folly. Where the story of Rama merely is told and heard, the people living in that place are seldom caught in the hands of contagious diseases and premature death.

verses.translation: As Vasistha could finish his words, Parasurama came there and said to Rama - "O Rama, give up your name or fight with me." Rama replied to him - "How can I give up my name? So, be alert, I will fight." He then took his bow and put an arrow on the same. His jerk of bow was so phenomenal that the splendour of Visnu came out from the mouth of Parasurama and entered into Rama. Parasurama pleased with this and said- "O warrior, you only are Rama and the doubt my mind has been shattered now. I could understand you. You are incarnated to god Visnu in this physical form. Go on your way as you desire, protect the interests of gods and support saints by giving them protection from the clutches of wicked people. Kill all wicked. verses.science: तब सब धर्मोको जाननेवाले पुरोहित वसिष्ठजीने वहाँ आकर सबको शान्त किया और राजाके मृत शरीरको तेलसे भरी हुई नौकामें रखवाकर, मन्त्रिगणोंके साथ विचार करके, भरत-शतरु…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.hindi: 'और स्वयं भगवान विष्णु का परम पद प्राप्त करने के लिए महान तप-प्रयास करूँगा।' ऐसा निश्चय करके राजा ने सभी दिशाओं में आज्ञा भेजी।

verses.sanskrit: प्राज्ञान् भृत्यान् महीपालान् मन्त्रिगणश् च त्वरान्वितः रामाभिषेकद्रव्याणि ऋषिप्रोक्तानि यानि वै

verses.hindi: शीघ्रतापूर्वक विद्वान सेवकों, राजाओं और मंत्रियों को निर्देश दिया—'ऋषियों द्वारा बताए गए श्रीराम के अभिषेक की समस्त सामग्री—'

verses.science: दुःखी हो "हा तात! हा राम! हा सीते! हा लक्ष्मण!” इस प्रकार बारम्बार पुकारते हुए बहुत विलाप करने लगे यह देख भरत और शत्रुघ्न भी दुःखी होकर रोने लगे उस समय कैकेय…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तानि भृत्याः समाहृत्य शीघ्रम् आगन्तुम् अर्हथ दूतामात्याः समादेशात् सर्वदिक्षु नराधिपान्
verses.transliteration: tāni bhṛtyāḥ samāhṛtya śīghram āgantum arhatha dūtāmātyāḥ samādeśāt sarvadikṣu narādhipān
verses.hindi: 'हे सेवको, एकत्र करके शीघ्र ले आओ! हे दूत और मंत्रियो, मेरी आज्ञा से सभी दिशाओं के राजाओं को—'
verses.commentary: Sense: £"dmicMi: mifaqRN\9ii

verses.science: दे दिया, जिसके कारण भाई लक्ष्मण और देवी सीताके साथ श्रीरघुनाथजीको वनमें जानेको विवश होना पड़ा, उससे बढ़कर दुष्टा कौन स्त्री होगी? अरी दुष्टे! ओ मन्दभागिनी! त…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आहूय तान् समाहृत्य शीघ्रम् आगन्तुम् अर्हथ अयोध्यापुरम् अत्यर्थं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: āhūya tān samāhṛtya śīghram āgantum arhatha ayodhyāpuram atyarthaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam
verses.hindi: 'आमंत्रित करके शीघ्र यहाँ ले आओ! अयोध्या नगरी को सब ओर से दिव्य शोभा से सुसज्जित करो—'
verses.commentary: Sense: TTftT cTT^ WRFFgr^ri
verses.translation: 3TTftT cTT^ WRFFgr^ri
verses.science: तूने सोचा होगा कि महात्मा लक्ष्मण और साध्वी सीताके साथ रामको घरसे निकालकर महाराजा दशरथ मेरे ही पुत्रको राजा बना देंगे। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जनाः कुरुत सर्वत्र नृत्यगीतादिनन्दितम् पुरवासिजनानन्दं देशवासिमनःप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: janāḥ kuruta sarvatra nṛtyagītādinanditam puravāsijanānandaṃ deśavāsimanaḥpriyam
verses.hindi: 'हे नागरिकों, सर्वत्र नृत्य-गीत आदि से आनंदोत्सव मनाओ! यह जान लो कि नगरवासियों को आनंद और देशवासियों के मन को प्रीति देने वाला—'
verses.commentary: Sense: RT: fR?T Trail ^rijfUdlRHKrrRI

verses.science: श्रीरामचन्द्रजी गये हैं, जहाँ नियम और व्रतका आचरण करनेवाली, समस्त शुभलक्षणोंसे युक्त, अत्यन्त सौभाग्य- शालिनी पतिव्रता विदेहराजकुमारी सीताजी विद्यमान हैं। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: रामाभिषेकं विपुलं श्वो भविष्यति जानथ श्रुत्वेत्थं मन्त्रिणः प्राहुस् तं नृपं प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: rāmābhiṣekaṃ vipulaṃ śvo bhaviṣyati jānatha śrutvetthaṃ mantriṇaḥ prāhus taṃ nṛpaṃ praṇipatya ca
verses.hindi: 'श्रीराम का विशाल राज्याभिषेक कल ही होने वाला है!' यह सुनकर मंत्रियों ने राजा को प्रणाम करके कहा—
verses.commentary: Sense: qraifuddi-K ^raiftmT: fsraRiR n

verses.science: तत्र यास्यामि कैकेयि महत्पापं त्वया कृतम् स एव राजा दुष्टात्मे भृत्योऽहं तस्य वै सदा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शोभनं ते मतं राजन् यद् इदं परिभाषितम् रामाभिषेकम् अस्माकं सर्वेषां च प्रियंकरम्
verses.transliteration: śobhanaṃ te mataṃ rājan yad idaṃ paribhāṣitam rāmābhiṣekam asmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca priyaṃkaram
verses.translation: Markandeya said- Rama began to live in Ayodhya for the pleasure of his father, enjoying all luxuries, increasing the gaiety of the subjects after marriage. When Rama was in Ayodhya, his brother Bharata went to his maternal house with his brother Satrughna. Later on king Dasaratha, taking Rama mighty, modest, young, learned and worth to select for the crown thought of entrusting the responsibility of the kingdom and royal affairs so that he could do efforts to attain the abode of god Visnu. In order to
verses.hindi: 'हे राजन्, आपने जो विचार व्यक्त किया है वह अत्यंत उत्तम है; श्रीराम का राज्याभिषेक हम सबके लिए परम प्रिय है।'
verses.wordMeaning: Markandeya said- Rama began to live in Ayodhya for the pleasure of his father, enjoying all luxuries, increasing the gaiety of the subjects after marriage. When Rama was in Ayodhya, his brother Bharata went to his maternal house with his brother Satrughna.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Markandeya said- Rama began to live in Ayodhya for the pleasure of his father, enjoying all luxuries, increasing the gaiety of the subjects after marriage. When Rama was in Ayodhya, his brother Bharata went to his maternal house with his brother Satrughna.…
verses.science: क्क गतोऽस्यद्य वै तात किं करोमीह तद्वद। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो दशरथस् तैस् तान् सर्वान् पुनर् अब्रवीत् आनीयन्तां द्रुतं सर्वे संभारा मम शासनात्
verses.transliteration: ityukto daśarathas tais tān sarvān punar abravīt ānīyantāṃ drutaṃ sarve saṃbhārā mama śāsanāt
verses.translation: "Come with the goods required and prescribed by Munis duly collected. Messengers and ministers, go can come with the kings ruling in all directions by duly inviting him. O native of Ayodhyapuri, decorate this entire city properly and arrange music and dance everywhere so properly that this city becomes a pleasure pouring for all native and appear fantastic to the natives of the entire country. Be known to the fact that Rama will be enthroned tomorrow with royal grandeur.
verses.hindi: उनके ऐसा कहने पर राजा दशरथ ने पुनः सबको आज्ञा दी—'मेरे आदेश से शीघ्र ही समस्त आवश्यक संभार यहाँ लाए जाएँ।'
verses.wordMeaning: implement this thought, the king immediately ordered his officers, officials, the kings subjugated and ministers - "Come with the goods required and prescribed by Munis duly collected. Messengers and ministers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: implement this thought, the king immediately ordered his officers, officials, the kings subjugated and ministers - "Come with the goods required and prescribed by Munis duly collected. Messengers and ministers,…
verses.science: चसिष्ठो भगवानाह कालकर्मविभागवित्। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः सारभूता च पुरी चेयं समन्ततः अद्य शोभान्विता कार्या कर्तव्यं यागमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ sārabhūtā ca purī ceyaṃ samantataḥ adya śobhānvitā kāryā kartavyaṃ yāgamaṇḍalam
verses.hindi: 'आज चारों ओर से इस नगरी को अत्यंत सुंदर सजाया जाए और यज्ञमंडप का निर्माण किया जाए।'
verses.commentary: Sense: RratJT: RTffRT fg wrq-fd ^il’oii

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवमुक्ता राज्ञा ते मन्त्रिणः शीघ्रकारिणः तथैव चक्रुस् ते सर्वे पुनः पुनर् उदीरिताः
verses.transliteration: ity evamuktā rājñā te mantriṇaḥ śīghrakāriṇaḥ tathaiva cakrus te sarve punaḥ punar udīritāḥ
verses.hindi: राजा द्वारा बारंबार प्रेरित किए जाने पर शीघ्रकारी मंत्रियों ने वैसा ही किया।

verses.science: संस्कारं लम्भयामास विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तहर्षः स राजा च शुभं दिनम् उदीक्षयन् कौशल्या लक्ष्मणश् चैव सुमित्रा नागरो जनः
verses.transliteration: prāptaharṣaḥ sa rājā ca śubhaṃ dinam udīkṣayan kauśalyā lakṣmaṇaś caiva sumitrā nāgaro janaḥ
verses.translation: Having heard this, the ministers bowed their heads before the king and said- "O king, your idea is the best and we all are agreed to the same. Incoronation of Rama is the most benevolent for us.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नचित्त राजा उस शुभ दिन की प्रतीक्षा करने लगे। कौशल्या, लक्ष्मण, सुमित्रा तथा समस्त नगरवासी—
verses.commentary: Sense: Having heard this, the ministers bowed their heads before the king and said- "O king, your idea is the best and we all are agreed to the same. Incoronation of Rama is the most benevolent for us.
verses.science: भ्राता हैं, वे ही राजा होनेके अधिकारी हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रामाभिषेकम् आकर्ण्य मुदं प्राप्यातिहर्षितः श्वश्रुश्वशुरयोः सम्यक् शुश्रूषणपरा तु सा

verses.science: मातासे यों कहकर भरतजी अत्यन्त दुःखी हो, वहाँ 'फूट-फूटकर रोने लगे और विलाप करने लगे-'हा दुःखी बालकको छोड्कर आप कहाँ चले गये ? बताइये, मैं अब यहाँ क्या करूँ ?…। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुदान्विता सिता सीता भर्तुर् आकर्ण्य शोभनम् श्वोभाविन्य् अभिषेके तु रामस्य विदितात्मनः

verses.hindi: पवित्र सीताजी भी अपने पति के मंगलमय अभिषेक का समाचार सुनकर परम प्रसन्न हुईं। कल होने वाले आत्मज्ञानी श्रीराम के राज्याभिषेक के पूर्व—

verses.science: भरतको इस प्रकार विलाप करते देख काल और कर्मके विभागको जाननेवाले भगवान् वसिष्ठजी मन्त्रियोंके साथ वहाँ आकर बोले--'बेटा! उठो, उठो; तुम्हें शोक नहीं करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दासी तु मन्थरानाम्नी कैकेय्याः कुब्जरूपिणी स्वां स्वामिनीं तु कैकेयीम् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्

Slta, always engaged in the service of her in¬ laws, became overjoyed when she heard this news favouring her husband.

verses.translation: God Rama, the metaphysician or intuitive, was to be enthroned on the next day. In the meantime, the hump, backed maid servant of Kaikeyl i.e., Manthara said to her - "O lucky person, I explain a news and request you to listen. Your husband king Das'aratha has now planned to spoil you. Rama, the son of Kaus'alya, will become the king of Ayodhya tomorrow. This entire state with wealth, chariots and treasure will go to Rama and Bharata will
verses.hindi: ललाट पर श्वेत वस्त्र बाँधकर लेट गई। उधर राजा दशरथ ने मंत्रियों के साथ समस्त राजकार्यों की मंत्रणा करके—

verses.sanskrit: पुण्याहःस्वस्तिमाङ्गल्यैः स्थाप्य रामं तु मण्डले ऋषिभिस् तु वसिष्ठाद्यैः सार्धं संभारमण्डपे

verses.translation: Look at the art of destiny; Bharata too has gone far this time and living at his maternal house. Alas, to what extent is it painful. You are unlucky because you are now left for suffering on behalf of the step-wife.
verses.hindi: पुण्याहवाचन, स्वस्तिवाचन और मंगलकर्मों के साथ वसिष्ठ आदि ऋषियों के मध्य संभार-मंडप में श्रीराम को प्रतिष्ठित किया—

verses.science: रामभक्त गुहने युद्धके लिये सुसज्जित हो, अपनी सेना गोलाकार खड़ी की और कवच धारणकर, रथारूढ़ हो, उस विशाल सेनासे घिरे हुए उसने मार्गमें भरतको रोक दिया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.hindi: वे कैकेयी को श्रीराम के अभिषेक का शुभ समाचार सुनाना चाहते थे। किंतु कैकेयी के महल में अंधकार देखकर राजा बोले—

verses.science: इस प्रकार विश्वास दिलानेपर गुह उन्हें गङ्गातट- पर ले आया और झुंड-की-झुंड नौकाएँ मँगाकर उनके द्वारा उन सबको पार कर दिया। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.translation: With these words to Manthara, Kaikeyl took out all ornaments she had worn on her body, threw the beautiful garments and the flower garlands as well. She put on a coarse garment on her body. She reput the flowers once removed, smeared ash and dust on the body and she pretended as if suffering from pain and fits with an ugly complexion made. She wrapped a white cloth round the forehead, put out the lamp in the evening and laid down on the ground uncleaned and filled with ash and dust.

verses.translation: King Das'aratha returned from the pavilion after a little stay where the song and dance programmes were arranged and echo of trumpet, conch, kliala etc., was spreading everywhere. That place was appropriate for Nandi sraddha and Jagarana. Sri Rama was seated there after due consult made with the ministers on all affairs and Punya Vacana, Svastivacana and Marigalapatha performed by the Vasistha etc., Rsis. On his return to the palace, he first wished to inform Kaikeyl about the auspicious coronation of Rama and he reached the threshold of Kaikeyl’s palace. Old soldiers were appointed as guards there. The king asked for her when he saw the palace of Kaikeyl sinking in the dark.

verses.translation: All people are decorating their houses with possible means. Tell me why you have not decorated your palace? With these words, the king lighted the lamps there and then entered there. He saw that Kaikeyi was sleeping on the floor. Her every organ of body looked ugly. The king lifted her up to his chest and spoke these words - "Darling, listen to my suggestions? O beautiful lady, your beloved Rama who loves you more than his own mother, will be enthroned tomorrow."
verses.hindi: 'आपके समस्त रत्न आदि तो मेरे ही हैं, इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं। किंतु हे राजन्, पूर्वकाल में देवासुर संग्राम में प्रसन्न होकर जो दो वरदान—'

verses.translation: The lady did not respond on the statement of the king. She began to sigh with pain and anger in her face. The king embraced her and said- O beautiful Kaikeyi, tell me the cause for your pain. Be happy and get yourselves the desired garments, ornaments and gems etc., whatever you desire. O philanthropic lady, my desire will see culmination when the coronation of Rama will over tomorrow. That store will again fill-up during the regime of Rama and this is the cause I have left the door of treasury wide open. Darling, give honour and importance to a greater extent to the bona-fide of Rama

Laksmana replied "O treasure of mercy, don't pass such cruel order to me. I will follow wherever you want to go. Rama then turned to Slta and said- "Darling Sita, go to the palace' of your father or live in the palace of Sumitra or Kaus'alya. Go back there and wait for me till I return."

verses.translation: Bharata thundered on Kaikeyl when all facts were disclosed by her. He said- "Alas, you are very wicked. Your heart is filled with mala-fides. Who can be more wicked than a woman who exiled Rama and Laks mana as also STta compelled to enter into the forest? O wicked, wretched, how could you dare so? You would have thought that king Dasaratha will enthrone me happily on the throne when Rama along with chaste Sita depart to the exile. I am ashamed of being your son. However, listen to my decision that I will not accept incoronation by keeping separation from Rama. I will also visit the place where Rama, greatest in men, conversant to religion, known to all scriptures, wise and affectionate elder brother; where Sita, a chaste, meritorious, luckiest, daughter of Videha is and where Laksmana, a devoted brother, gallant, ideal character and bright brother has gone. Kaikeyl, you have committed a heinous crime of exiling Rama. O wicked heart, the wisest Rama is my elder brother and he only is eligible to sit on the throne. I am merely like his slave.
verses.hindi: अपने महाबली परिवार सहित मार्ग में भरत को रोककर ललकारा—

His expressions were piteous as that of a common and worldly young chap with the words as to where he has gone leaving him alone? What should be done then? He again remembered Rama, Slta and Laksmana moaning on their departure to the forest.

verses.transliteration: naukāvṛndair anekais tu snātvāsau jāhnavījale bharadvājāśramaṃ prāpto bharatas taṃ mahāmunim
verses.translation: Muni Vasistha, conversant with the deed and the might of time, came there where Bharata was ceaselessly weeping. He consoled him by addressing him as son - "O son, you should not moan over the death of your father as the time and deed is predominant. It is your first and foremost duty now to arrange his funeral ceremony instead of moaning. Rama is incarnated to god Visnu and appeared on this earth with the sole objective to kill the wicked and provide protection to the saints. A number of acts are to be performed by Rama in the forest. He will therefore, keep himself busy with those acts and return only when those will be completed.
verses.hindi: गंगाजल में स्नान करके भरत महामुनि भरद्वाज के आश्रम में पहुँचे—

verses.translation: Thus, on completion of the funeral ceremony, Bharata began to march to the forest through the route adopted by Rama in the company of his ministers, mothers, the four corps army (viz., elephant, horses, infantry and chariots) so as to meet Rama. Guha resisted Bharata on the way by issuing his army order to march in circle formation so that the army marching with Bharata can be surpassed because he was confused of Bharata's intention. He thought that Bharata is coming to attack Rama. He addressed Bharata with harsh words as - "O wicked, rude, traitor, whether you are not satisfied with exile of Rama with his brother and wife and now marching to kill him too. Otherwise, why have you brought so huge an army?"

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् आकर्ण्य पुनः प्राह भरतं पुरतः स्थितम् नृणां पितृसमो ज्येष्ठः स्वधर्मम् अनुवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ity ākarṇya punaḥ prāha bharataṃ purataḥ sthitam nṛṇāṃ pitṛsamo jyeṣṭhaḥ svadharmam anuvartinām
verses.translation: Rama said to Laksmana - "Brother, it appears to me as if Bharata is coming to see us. As Rama could complete his words, Bharata came there and fell at his feet. He began to weep bitterly. The army was at a distance and only Bharata, his ministers and some Brahmins had come to Rama. Within minutes, the mothers, near and dear ones and friends surrounded Rama and all of them began weeping.
verses.hindi: यह सुनकर श्रीराम ने सामने खड़े भरत से पुनः कहा—'स्वधर्म का पालन करने वाले मनुष्यों के लिए ज्येष्ठ भ्राता पिता के समान होता है।'

verses.science: राजन्! उस समय लक्ष्मणने उनसे जो समयोचित बात कही थी, वह तुम मुझसे सुनो। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा न लङ्घ्यं वचनं मया पितृमुखेरितम् तथा त्वया न लङ्घ्यं स्याद् वचनं मम सत्तम

verses.hindi: 'हे सत्तम, जैसे मेरे लिए पिता के मुख से निकला वचन अलंघनीय है, वैसे ही आपके लिए मेरा वचन भी अलंघनीय होना चाहिए।'

verses.sanskrit: मत्समीपाद् इतो गत्वा प्रजास् त्वं परिपालय द्वादशाब्दिकम् एतन् मे व्रतं पितृमुखेरितम्

verses.translation: When Rama knew the death of his father, he took a dip in the holy river with brother and wife and gave a joint palm of water to the dead soul. He then bowed his head at the feet of mother, teachers and the elders, expressed regret and said to Bharata
verses.hindi: 'अतः आप मेरे पास से लौटकर प्रजाओं का पालन कीजिए। पिताजी द्वारा दिया गया मेरा यह बारह वर्षीय वनवास का व्रत है—'
verses.commentary: Sense: When Rama knew the death of his father, he took a dip in the holy river with brother and wife and gave a joint palm of water to the dead soul. He then bowed his head at the feet of mother, teachers and the elders, expressed regret and said to Bharata
verses.science: आकर्ण्य सीतास्वनमागतोऽहं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तद् अरण्ये चरित्वा तु आगमिस्यामि ते ऽन्तिकम् गच्छ तिष्ठ ममादेशे न दुःखं कर्तुम् अर्हसि

verses.translation: "Learned Bharata, go back to Ayodhya
verses.hindi: 'इसे वन में पूर्ण करके मैं अवश्य आपके पास लौट आऊँगा। अब आप जाइए और मेरे आदेश का पालन कीजिए; दुःख मत कीजिए।'
verses.commentary: Sense: SRJteri W W |tT: w •q^TR^II^'SII WT TTfi arcrat uRmihui "Learned Bharata, go back to Ayodhya
verses.science: श्रीरामका जयन्तको दण्ड देना; शरभङ्ग, सुतीक्ष्ण और अगस्त्यसे मिलना उस समय श्रीरामचन्द्रजीने सारे वनोंको छान डाला, समस्त पर्वतों तथा उनकी चोटियोंपर जानेवाले मा…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो भरतः प्राह बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः यथा पिता तथा त्वं मे नात्र कर्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: ityukto bharataḥ prāha bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ yathā pitā tathā tvaṃ me nātra karyā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Bharata replied - "O ideal man, I have decided that there will be no return without you. I will follow you like Laksmana and Slta wherever you go."
verses.hindi: श्रीराम के ऐसा कहने पर आँसुओं से भरे नेत्रों वाले भरत बोले—'मेरे लिए आप पिता के ही समान हैं, इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं।'
verses.commentary: Sense: immediately and rule there because the entire state has become like an orphan after the death of our revered father. Bharata replied - "O ideal man, I have decided that there will be no return without you. I will follow you like Laksmana and Slta wherever you go."
verses.science: तृण एवं लताओंसे आच्छादित वनस्थलियों तथा खुले मैदानोंमें, नदीके किनारे, गड़ॉमें और कन्दराओंमें देखनेपर भी जब उन महानुभावको अपनी प्रिया सीताका पता नहीं लगा, तब…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.science: उसी समय राजा रामचन्द्रजीने रावणद्वारा मारे गये जटायुको देखा और कहा-अहो! आपको किसने मारा? आह! आप ऐसी दुर्दशाको पहुँच चुके हैं? पता नहीं, जीवित हैं या मर गये। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्वेषम् एव मद्वेषं त्वद्व्रतं मे महाव्रतम् त्वं द्वादशाब्दिकाद् ऊर्ध्वं यदि नायासि सत्तम
verses.transliteration: tvadveṣam eva madveṣaṃ tvadvrataṃ me mahāvratam tvaṃ dvādaśābdikād ūrdhvaṃ yadi nāyāsi sattama
verses.translation: Rama again said- "Gentle Bharata, elder brother is eligible to be respected as father for the men abiding religion. As I should not violate the words of my father, you the same way should not violate my order. Move from here and administer the subjects. I will again come to Ayodhya on completion of the twelve years of exile and see you. Go and comply with my order. Don't regret please.
verses.hindi: 'आपका वेष ही मेरा वेष होगा और आपका व्रत ही मेरा महाव्रत होगा। किंतु हे सत्तम, यदि बारह वर्ष बीतने पर आप न लौटे—'
verses.wordMeaning: Rama again said- "Gentle Bharata, elder brother is eligible to be respected as father for the men abiding religion. As I should not violate the words of my father, you the same way should not violate my order. Move from here and administer the subjects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama again said- "Gentle Bharata, elder brother is eligible to be respected as father for the men abiding religion. As I should not violate the words of my father, you the same way should not violate my order. Move from here and administer the subjects.…
verses.science: भगवान् रामके इतना कहते ही वह पक्षी उस समय बड़े कष्टसे मधुर वाणीमें बोला-“राजन्! इस समय मैंने जो कुछ देखा है और तत्काल ही उसके लिये जो कुछ किया है, वह मेरा सारा। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो हविर् यथा चाग्नौ प्रधक्ष्यामि कलेवरम् इत्य् एवं शपथं कृत्वा भरतो हि सुदुःखितः
verses.transliteration: tato havir yathā cāgnau pradhakṣyāmi kalevaram ity evaṃ śapathaṃ kṛtvā bharato hi suduḥkhitaḥ
verses.hindi: 'तो मैं हवि की भाँति अग्नि में प्रवेश कर अपना शरीर भस्म कर दूँगा!' इस प्रकार कठिन प्रतिज्ञा करके अत्यंत दुःखी भरत ने—

verses.sanskrit: बहु प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा नमस्कृत्य च राघवम् पादुके_२ शिरसा स्थाप्य भरतः प्रस्थितः शनैः
verses.transliteration: bahu pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtya ca rāghavam pāduke_2 śirasā sthāpya bharataḥ prasthitaḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Bharata replied with tears in his eyes - "Brother, there is no need to think whether I should give you the same respect as that to father, because as the father, the same you are. I will now comply with your order but please, give me your sandal. I will reside in Nandlgrama by resorting to the sandals and do penance up to twelve years. My apparel and mission will be the same as that of yours. In case, you do not appear just on the end of twelve years, I will make my body as oblation to the fire. Grieved Bharata did Pradaksina of Rama several times with this resolution, frequently bowed his head and he slowly moved from there with the sandals on his head.
verses.hindi: श्रीराम की अनेक प्रदक्षिणाएँ और प्रणाम किए तथा उनकी दोनों पादुकाएँ अपने मस्तक पर धारण करके धीरे-धीरे प्रस्थान किया।
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata replied with tears in his eyes - "Brother, there is no need to think whether I should give you the same respect as that to father, because as the father, the same you are. I will now comply with your order but please, give me your sandal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata replied with tears in his eyes - "Brother, there is no need to think whether I should give you the same respect as that to father, because as the father, the same you are. I will now comply with your order but please, give me your sandal.…
verses.science: जीवित था, अब यहाँसे स्वर्गलोकको जाऊँगा। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: स कुर्वन् भ्रातुर् आदेशं नन्दिग्रामे स्थितो वशी तपस्वी नियताहारः शाकमूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: sa kurvan bhrātur ādeśaṃ nandigrāme sthito vaśī tapasvī niyatāhāraḥ śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Bharata began to live in Nandlgrama by enslaving his sensory organs, vegetables and root and fruits as regular diet, concentration of mind and with following the instructions of his brother. The holy- hearted Bharata held his hair tangled, bark apparel on the body and wild fruits as diet. He began to rule the stately affairs with Rama's words in his mind.
verses.hindi: वे जितेंद्रिय भरत भाई की आज्ञा का पालन करते हुए नंदिग्राम में तपस्वी बनकर नियमित शाक-मूल-फल का आहार करते हुए रहने लगे।

Indra, the king of gods, expelled that criminal from his palace when he got the news and discussed the matter with other secretaries. verses.science: मार्कण्डेयजी बोले--वालीसे वैर हो जानेके कारण उसके लिये दुर्गम स्थानमें रहनेवाले वानरराज सुग्रीवने दूरसे ही श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणको आते देखा और देखकर पवनकुमार हन…। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रं तन्नेत्रम् एकं तु भस्मीकृत्य समाययौ ततः प्रभृति काकानां सर्वेषाम् एकनेत्रता

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुषैकेन पश्यन्ति हेतुना तेन पार्थिव उषित्वा तत्र सुचिरं चित्रकूटे स राघवः

verses.science: वहाँ स्थित होकर सुग्रीवने पुनः पवनकुमारसे कहा-- “हनूमन्! तुम भी तपस्वीका वेष धारण करके शीघ्र जाओ और पूछो कि “वे कौन हैं? किसके पुत्र हैं? और किस लिये वहाँ ठह…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगाम दण्डकारण्यं नानामुनिनिषेवितम् सभ्रातृकः सभार्यश् च तापसं वेषम् आस्थितः

verses.translation: Rama said to Jayanta, O wicked, my
verses.hindi: अनेक मुनियों से सेवित दंडकारण्य में गए। भाई और पत्नी के साथ तपस्वी वेष धारण किए—

verses.science: बातें सच-सच जानकर मुझसे बताओ' उनके इस प्रकार कहनेपर हनुमानजी संन्यासीके रूपमें पम्पासरके उत्तम तटपर गये और भाई लक्ष्मणके साथ विद्यमान श्रीरामचन्द्रजीसे बोले-…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: धनुःपर्वसुपाणिश्च सेषुधिश् च महाबलः ततो ददर्श तत्रस्थान् अम्बुभक्षान् महामुनीन्
verses.transliteration: dhanuḥparvasupāṇiśca seṣudhiś ca mahābalaḥ tato dadarśa tatrasthān ambubhakṣān mahāmunīn
verses.translation: Amogha and it his the target once made. Hence, offer any of your organ and then only your life can be saved. You have committed a heinous crime hence it is necessary to punish you. On these words, Jayanta offered his eyes for the arrow. That weapon returned when one eye of Jayanta was singed. O king, since then, all crows became one-eyed. This is the reason why all crows stare with one eye.
verses.hindi: हाथ में धनुष और पीठ पर तरकश बाँधे महाबली श्रीराम ने वहाँ निवास करने वाले केवल जल का आहार करने वाले महामुनियों—
verses.wordMeaning: weapon is Amogha and it his the target once made. Hence, offer any of your organ and then only your life can be saved. You have committed a heinous crime hence it is necessary to punish you. On these words, Jayanta offered his eyes for the arrow.…

verses.science: आप कहाँसे आ गये? यहाँ आनेका क्या प्रयोजन है ?-- ये सब बातें मेरे समक्ष ठीक-ठीक बताइये '। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अश्मकुट्टान् अनेकांश् च दन्तोलूखलिनस् तथा पञ्चाग्निमध्यगान् अन्यान् अन्यान् उग्रतपश् चरान्

verses.science: राजा दशरथो नाम बभूव भुवि विश्रुतः। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा प्रणिपत्योच्चै रामस् तैश् चाभिनन्दितः ततो ऽखिलं वनं दृष्ट्वा रामः साक्षाज् जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā praṇipatyoccai rāmas taiś cābhinanditaḥ tato 'khilaṃ vanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ sākṣāj janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Rama departed to Dandakaranya, offering place of a number of saints after passing several days with his brother and wife in Citrakuta. He was in the apparel of an ascetic, bow and arrow in his hands and a Tarakasa was tied on his back. On his visit there, Rama saw the great hermits busy with penance. Some among them were taking nothing as food but only water. A large number out of them were living on the thrashed and crushed cereals gwing to complete loss of teeth. They were called Asmakutta. Some among them were using their teeth as the thrasher and by the reason, called Dantolukhali. Some were busy with penance with their sitting in the middle of a blazed fire from five directions. Some greatmen were even more hard in their penance. Rama saluted them and they also greeted Rama heartily.
verses.hindi: उन सबको सादर प्रणाम कर और उनका आशीर्वाद पाकर साक्षात् भगवान जनार्दन श्रीराम ने संपूर्ण वन का अवलोकन किया—
verses.wordMeaning: Rama departed to Dandakaranya, offering place of a number of saints after passing several days with his brother and wife in Citrakuta. He was in the apparel of an ascetic, bow and arrow in his hands and a Tarakasa was tied on his back. On his visit there,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama departed to Dandakaranya, offering place of a number of saints after passing several days with his brother and wife in Citrakuta. He was in the apparel of an ascetic, bow and arrow in his hands and a Tarakasa was tied on his back. On his visit there,…

verses.sanskrit: शिलाभिश् छाद्य गतवाञ् शरभङ्गाश्रमं ततः तं नत्वा तत्र विश्रम्य तत्कथातुष्टमानसः

verses.translation: Subsequently Rama in the company of his brother and wife proceeded forward with his eyes on the entire forest as he was stepping forward with simultaneous necessary directions to Slta regarding the beautiful flowers and all other excellent things of the forest; he just saw a monster whose eyes were red and of dark complexion. He was as huge as a mountain. His jaws were bright, had large arms and hair as golden as the evening cloud. He was making a noise and used to put in pain for nothing the other creatures. Rama with Laks mana took their arrows immediately and penetrated the body of that monster. They dashed his huge corpse on a trench and covered it with rocks. They reached the cottage of Sarabhanga, a hermit, after this. He saluted him and stayed there for a few hours. He discussed several topics with him and became happy.
verses.hindi: शिलाओं से ढक दिया और फिर शरभंग मुनि के आश्रम गए। उन्हें प्रणाम कर वहाँ विश्राम किया और उनकी कथाओं से संतुष्ट होकर—
verses.wordMeaning: Subsequently Rama in the company of his brother and wife proceeded forward with his eyes on the entire forest as he was stepping forward with simultaneous necessary directions to Slta regarding the beautiful flowers and all other excellent things of the forest;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Subsequently Rama in the company of his brother and wife proceeded forward with his eyes on the entire forest as he was stepping forward with simultaneous necessary directions to Slta regarding the beautiful flowers and all other excellent things of the forest;…
verses.science: ही खोज करते हुए ये वीरवर कमलनयन श्रीराम यहाँ आये हैं, जिससे तुम्हें यहाँ इनका दर्शन हुआ है। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

Rama got a sword and Visnu's bows and a Tarakasa, spelled with undepleted arrows. He then marched further and settled at Pahcavati, a place near Godavari river. The king eagle Jatayu came to Rama there, explained about his family and stood before him. Rama also told all about him and expected his assistance to

verses.science: सुग्रीवं प्राह धर्मात्मा रामः कमललोचनः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो ऽसौ जटायुस् तु रामम् आलिङ्ग्य सादरम् कार्यार्थं तु गते रामे भ्रात्रा सह वनान्तरम्

verses.sanskrit: अहं रक्ष्यामि ते भार्यां स्थीयताम् अत्र शोभन इत्य् उक्त्वा गतवान् रामं गृध्रराजः स्वम् आश्रमम्

verses.sanskrit: मन्मथाकारसदृशं कथयन्तं महाकथाः कृत्वा मायामयं रूपं लावण्यगुणसंयुतम्

verses.translation: Jatayu embraced Rama and will guard Slta whenever you move to another forest for any purpose. Hence, live here without worry. The king eagle then returned to his cottage situated southward which was filled with several varieties of birds.
verses.hindi: जो कामदेव के समान मनोहर थे और पावन कथाएँ सुना रहे थे, एक दिन कामपीड़ित होकर रावण की बहन—
verses.commentary: Sense: Jatayu embraced Rama and said-"I will guard Slta whenever you move to another forest for any purpose. Hence, live here without worry. The king eagle then returned to his cottage situated southward which was filled with several varieties of birds.
verses.science: यह सुनकर श्रीमान् रामचन्द्रजीने भी सुग्रीवका। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.translation: Surpanakha, the sister of Ravana once heard that Rama is beautiful as a sex god and living with his brother and wife with recreation on several stories. She filled with lust for Rama turned herself into a beautiful lady. Sweet songs were on her lips while strolling in the forest where Rama was with his brother and wife. She said to Rama fearlessly -"O beloved, I love you too much. Please, accept me as a maid slave. See that the man earns sin if he neglects a woman herself appearing for
verses.hindi: 'जो स्वयं प्रेम करने वाली स्त्री को त्यागता है, उसे बड़ा दोष लगता है।' शूर्पणखा के ऐसा कहने पर श्रीराम ने उससे कहा—

verses.science: उनके द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जानेपर सुग्रीवने लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरमचन्द्रजीसे कहा “ रघुनन्दन! इस समय महान् वर्षाकाल आ पहुँचा है; इनद्रके वर्षा करते रहनेपर इस वनमें…। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतीव निपुणा चाहं रतिकर्मणि राघव त्यक्त्वैनाम् अनभिज्ञां त्वं सीतां मां भज शोभनम्

verses.science: ककुत्स्थनन्दन श्रीरामने लक्ष्मणसे क्रोधपूर्वक कहा-- गते तु वर्षाकालेऽहमागमिष्यामि तेऽन्तिकम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य नात्र वने भार्या त्वाम् असौ संग्रहीष्यति इत्युक्ता सा पुनः प्राह रामं राजीवलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: tasya nātra vane bhāryā tvām asau saṃgrahīṣyati ityuktā sā punaḥ prāha rāmaṃ rājīvalocanam
verses.hindi: 'वन में उनके साथ उनकी पत्नी नहीं है, वे आपको स्वीकार कर लेंगे।' तब उसने पुनः कमलनयन श्रीराम से कहा—

verses.science: तं दुष्ठमग्रतः कृत्वा हरिसेनासमन्वितम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा स्याल् लक्ष्मणो भर्ता तथा त्वं देहि पत्रकम् तथैवम् उक्त्वा मतिमान् रामः कमललोचनः
verses.transliteration: yathā syāl lakṣmaṇo bhartā tathā tvaṃ dehi patrakam tathaivam uktvā matimān rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ
verses.translation: Rama replied - "O spinster, I have already a wife and you can appeal before Laksmana." Having heard this, that monstress said- "O Rama, I am expert at coition while Slta is alien to that art. Hence, abandon her and accept me.”
verses.hindi: 'जैसे लक्ष्मण मेरे पति बन जाएँ, वैसा लिखकर मुझे एक पत्र दे दीजिए।' तब बुद्धिमान कमलनयन श्रीराम ने 'ठीक है' कहकर—
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama replied - "O spinster, I have already a wife and you can appeal before Laksmana." Having heard this, that monstress said- "O Rama, I am expert at coition while Slta is alien to that art. Hence, abandon her and accept me.”
verses.science: वालिहन्ता शरो दुष्ट करे मेऽद्यापि तिष्ठति। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्ध्य् अस्या नासिकाम् इति मोक्तव्या नात्र संशयः इति रामो महाराजो लिख्य पत्रं प्रदत्तवान्

verses.science: त्वामृते कोऽवमन्येत कपीन्द्र पापचेतस। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणः प्राह राक्षसीं कामरूपिणीम् न लङ्घ्यं रघववचो मया तिष्ठात्मकश्मले
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ prāha rākṣasīṃ kāmarūpiṇīm na laṅghyaṃ raghavavaco mayā tiṣṭhātmakaśmale

verses.sanskrit: तां प्रगृह्य ततः खड्गम् उद्यम्य विमलं सुधीः तेन तत्कर्णनासां तु विच्छेद तिलकाण्डवत्

verses.translation: Religion abiding Rama replied - "I do not keep any contact with anothers wife. Go to Laksmana. His wife is not with him here in this forest. Perhaps he will therefore accept you. Surpanakha said to Rama on this -"Very well, then gave me a letter so that Laksmana may be my husband. Rama accepted and give her a letter for Laksmana. Laksmana was ordered in that letter - "Laks mana, cut her nose definitely and don't let her go without it."
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर बुद्धिमान लक्ष्मण ने उसे पकड़कर अपनी निर्मल तलवार उठाई और तिल के डंठल की भाँति उसके कान और नाक काट डाले।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्ननासा ततः सा तु रुरोद भृशदुःखिता हा दशास्य मम भ्रातः सर्वदेवविमर्दक

verses.hindi: नाक कटने पर वह अत्यंत दुःखी होकर रोती हुई चिल्लाने लगी—'हा समस्त देवताओं के मर्दक मेरे भाई दशानन!'

verses.sanskrit: हा कष्टं कुम्भकर्णाद्या-याता मे चापदा परा हा हा कष्टं गुणनिधे विभीषण महामते

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवम् आर्ता रुदती सा गत्वा खरदूषणौ त्रिशिरसं च सा दृष्ट्वा निवेद्यात्मपराभवम्

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशसहस्राणि राक्षसानां बलीयसाम् अग्रे निजग्मुस् तेनैव रक्षसां नायकास् त्रयः

verses.sanskrit: रावणेन नियुक्तास् ते पुरैव तु महाबलाः महाबलपरीवारा जनस्थानम् उपागताः

verses.translation: Surpanakha happily moved from there and gave that letter to Laksmana. Having seen that over-excited monstress, Laksmana said- O spotted woman, stop and he caught her. He lifted up the sword and cut the nose and her ears like the sesamum crop.
verses.hindi: वे महाबली राक्षस पहले से ही रावण द्वारा वहाँ नियुक्त थे। अपनी विशाल सेना सहित वे जनस्थान में आ धमके—
verses.commentary: Sense: Surpanakha happily moved from there and gave that letter to Laksmana. Having seen that over-excited monstress, Laksmana said- O spotted woman, stop and he caught her. He lifted up the sword and cut the nose and her ears like the sesamum crop.
verses.science: सीताकी खोज करानेके लिये अवश्य ही आपके पास आऊँगा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि तद्बलं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसानां बलीयसाम् संस्थाप्य लक्ष्मणं तत्र सीताया रक्षणं प्रति

verses.translation: She began to weep bitterly and cried - O humilator of all gods, my brother Ravana, an adversity has been thundered on me. O brother Kumbhkarna, I am under the blow of heavy pain. O wise Vibhisana, I have to cross with such a calamity.
verses.hindi: महाबली राक्षसों की उस सेना को देखकर श्रीराम ने लक्ष्मण को सीताजी की रक्षा के लिए वहीं नियुक्त किया—
verses.commentary: Sense: She began to weep bitterly and cried - O humilator of all gods, my brother Ravana, an adversity has been thundered on me. O brother Kumbhkarna, I am under the blow of heavy pain. O wise Vibhisana, I have to cross with such a calamity.
verses.science: जनवृत्तविदां लोके सर्वज्ञानां महात्मनाम्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.transliteration: sauvarṇaṃ mṛgapotaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā sītā yaśasvinī bhāvikarmavaśād rāmam uvāca patim ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: At the end of Khara and other monsters, Surpanakha came to Ravana wailing. Having seen the nose cut-off her, Ravana planned for the abduction of Sita. He went to and said- "O maternal uncle, come with me on this Puspaka Vimana near the place where Rama is residing. You will then convert yourself into the form of a golden deer and start moving slowly near the place wherefrom Sita could see you. She will desire to have your hide for domestic chores and send Rama to catch you. You have to the run fast to dense forest as soon as Rama will come to catch you. You have to copy the sound of Rama and cry loudly for help so that Laksmana also could move to your direction. Then I will go to Sita on Puspaka Vimana and abduct her because I am passionate for her. You will then come voluntarily to Lanka.

verses.translation: Rama appointed Laksmana to guard her and chased the golden deer. That deer ran towards the forest and Rama shot an arrow on his body. Marica cried " Laksmana, Laks mana" copying Rama's voice while dying, came in his usual form and fell down dead. Having heard that sound, Slta said to Laks mana, "Dear Laksmana, go to the place from where this sound has come. It is undoubtedly a cry from your brother and it appears to me that Rama is in pain.
verses.hindi: 'आपने दीर्घकाल तक इस महावन में बहुत कष्ट सहे हैं; अब सुंदर मुख वाले आपके पति श्रीराम को पुनः राज्य मिल गया है—'

verses.translation: Having heard this from chaste Slta, Laks mana said- "Don’t give any place for doubt regarding Rama as there is no fear for him anywhere. Slta lost her temper and took it as if Laksmana is abusing the relation which was due to the pressure of the probabilities i.e., times effect. She said- "I know your intention to marry me on the death of Rama; otherwise why would you not visit there?" Laksmana could not endure such harsh words and immediately left that place for going to Rama.

verses.translation: As Laksmana left for the forest, Ravana suddenly appeared before Slta in disguise of an ascetic and said- "O lady, Bharata has come from Ayodhya. He is conversing with Rama in the forest. Rama has sent me to bring you there. Ride on this Vimana. Bharata has made agree to Rama now and he is proposing to return to Ayodhya. Rama has also caught a deer for your recreation. Alas, you have to suffer so severe a pain in this forest and that too for so long. Your husband and his humble brother have got the permission to enthrone. Hence, ride on this aircraft to reach them quickly.

verses.translation: Slta began to live with her brain and senses focused on Rama in acquaintance of such dangerous monstresses who were guarding her. She started ceaseless wailing there. Slta enslaved so by Ravana was in a gloomy disposition as Sarasvatl, swan moving feels when the miser retains it with him and not for all.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ शीघ्रं त्वं सीतां मृगयितुं प्रभो इत्य् एवं वदता तेन लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना

verses.hindi: 'हे प्रभो, शीघ्र उठिए, उठिए और सीताजी की खोज कीजिए।' महात्मा लक्ष्मण के इस प्रकार प्रोत्साहन देने पर—
verses.commentary: Sense: The ornaments tied in a cloth piece which were dropped down by Slta while the in Puspaka Vimana came into hands of four monkeys who were strolling in the forest. They took it to Sugriva, their king and explained that a fierce battle was fought by
verses.science: वायुनन्दन हनुमानूके इस प्रकार अनुरोध करनेपर कमलनयन श्रीरामने अपनी अंगूठी निकालकर दे दी, जिसपर 'राम' नाम खुदा हुआ था। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्थापितो नरपतिर् दुःखितो दुःखितेन तु भ्रात्रा सह जगामाथ सीतां मृगयितुं वनम्
verses.transliteration: utthāpito narapatir duḥkhito duḥkhitena tu bhrātrā saha jagāmātha sītāṃ mṛgayituṃ vanam
verses.translation: Jatayu with Ravana. Rama on the other side, returned when the disguised golden deer, Marica, was killed by him. He saw Laksmana on the way to the cottage and soon reached there. Having seen Slta absent from there, he began to weep bitterly. Laks mana also began to weep due to such a chaotic condition. Having seen his brother befallen on the ground, he lifted him up with shoulders and tried to console.
verses.hindi: दुःखी लक्ष्मण द्वारा उठाए गए दुःखी महाराज श्रीराम भाई के साथ सीताजी को खोजने वन में निकल पड़े।
verses.wordMeaning: Jatayu with Ravana. Rama on the other side, returned when the disguised golden deer, Marica, was killed by him. He saw Laksmana on the way to the cottage and soon reached there. Having seen Slta absent from there, he began to weep bitterly.…

verses.science: वानर इस समय मेरी आज्ञा सुन लें-तुम पर्वतों और वनोंमें विलम मत जाना। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: आकर्ण्य सीतास्वनम् आगतो ऽहं सीतां विमोक्तुं स्वबलेन राघव युद्धं च तेनाहम् अतीव कृत्वा हतः पुनः खड्गबलेन रक्षसा

verses.translation: He visited the cottages of the hermits, inspected the oasis surrounded with dense grasses and creepers, the open fields, the banks of rivers, trenches and caves but nowhere could Sita be seen. It gulled his grief in multiple. In the meantime, Rama saw the injured Jatayu and said- "Alas, who has injured you? Oh, you are so badly injured. It is not known whether you are living or dead now. You were my only helper this time when I am so grieving on the sudden missing of Slta but you are in such a piteous stage.
verses.hindi: 'हे राघव, सीताजी की पुकार सुनकर मैं अपने बल से उन्हें छुड़ाने आया और मैंने उस राक्षस से घोर युद्ध किया, किंतु अंत में उसने तलवार के बल से मुझे घायल कर दिया।'

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि दग्ध्वा तद्देहं स्नातो दत्त्वा जलाञ्जलिम् भ्रात्रा स गच्छन् दुःखार्तो राक्षसीं पथि दृष्टवान्

verses.sanskrit: उद्वमन्तीं महोल्काभां विवृतास्यां भयंकरीम् क्षयं नयन्तीं जन्तून् वै पातयित्वा गतो रुषा

verses.translation: That bird could with pain say humbly - "O king, whatever I have seen and did immediately is worth listening to you. Ravana with his shrewd art had abducted Slta and on Puspaka Vimana, he rode Slta and thus, he fled towards south. Slta was weeping bitterly. I waged a fierce battle
verses.hindi: जो मुख से महा-उल्का जैसी ज्वाला उगल रही थी, भयंकर खुले मुख से प्राणियों का संहार कर रही थी; उसे परास्त कर वे आगे बढ़े।
verses.commentary: Sense: That bird could with pain say humbly - "O king, whatever I have seen and did immediately is worth listening to you. O the protector of this entire earth, don't be sad and manage to kill that wicked monster with his whole army, wf

verses.sanskrit: रुन्धानं राममार्गं तु दृष्ट्वा तं दग्धवाञ् शनैः दग्धो ऽसौ दिव्यरूपी तु खस्थो रामम् अभाषत

Rama performed his funeral, took a bath and gave water through palm for the peace of the departed soul. He then proceeded forward with his brother. Suddenly he met a monstress. She was vomitting fire from her mouth. Her mouth was opened. She was dreadful and killing whosoever creatures coming in front. Rama killed her in a fury. He then marched further. He saw Kabandha when he was moving for the other forest. He was most ugly. His mouth was in his belly, had large arms and a formidable chest. When he stood in the way to Rama

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदिवं यामि धन्यो ऽस्मि त्वत्प्रसादान् न संशयः त्वं सीताप्राप्तये सख्यं कुरु सूर्यसुतेन भोः

verses.translation: O warrior Rama, you have destroyed my ugliness lived long due to the curse of a hermit. I am now going to heaven. No doubt, I am gratified. You should befriend Sugrlva, the son of Sun god, for the search of Sita. Your mission will achieve success when you will go there and give an account of the incident. O king, hence, go directly to Rsyamukha mountain from here.
verses.hindi: 'निश्चय ही आपकी कृपा से मैं धन्य होकर स्वर्ग जा रहा हूँ। हे नृपश्रेष्ठ, आप सीता की प्राप्ति के लिए सूर्यपुत्र—'
verses.wordMeaning: O warrior Rama, you have destroyed my ugliness lived long due to the curse of a hermit. I am now going to heaven. No doubt, I am gratified. You should befriend Sugrlva, the son of Sun god, for the search of Sita.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O warrior Rama, you have destroyed my ugliness lived long due to the curse of a hermit. I am now going to heaven. No doubt, I am gratified. You should befriend Sugrlva, the son of Sun god, for the search of Sita.…
verses.science: रामदूता वयं सर्वे सीतान्वेषणकर्मणि सुग्रीवसे मैत्री; वालिवध; सुग्रीवका प्रमाद और उसकी भर्त्सना। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.translation: Kabandha went to heaven with these words. Laksmana then entered with Rama into a cottage where no saints and hermits existed. He saw there a lady ascetic Sabarl who had got a holy heart due to service for the saints and hermits. They stayed there and talked with her. Sabarl greeted Rama properly and offered Bera etc., wild fruits to eat. She then told her account of life, wished for success of Rama's mission, set herself on pyre before Rama and went to the heavenly abode. Rama did her funeral and then marched to another place.
verses.hindi: वहाँ निवास करने वाली और मुनिश्रेष्ठों की सेवा से निष्पाप हुई तापसी शबरी को देखकर श्रीराम ने उनसे आदरपूर्वक संवाद किया।

A king named Dasaratha was renowned on this earth. Rama, my elder brother is the eldest son of that king. The nice ceremony of incoronation was precluded by our step-mother Kaikeyl. Then, in pursuance of the order of our revered father, my elder brother Rama left Ayodhya with Slta, his wife and me to this forest. Having arrived in forest he entered into Dandakaranya which was surrounded with hermits. A wicked man abducted his wife Sita from there and this is the reason that we are looking for him here. This all is our story and I have told you.

verses.translation: Rama on the other hand began to live on the peak of the mountain Nllakantha in that huge forest in the company of his brother Laksmana. He passed the rainy season with severe pricks of separation from Sita. When the pleasant season (sarada) appeared, he talked with Laksmana about the plan. Sugriva violated his promise as he did not appear there. Reacting on this negligence, Rama said to Laksmana - "Laksmana, go immediately to Pampapura. See the reason why that wicked monkey has not come till date. He had express told that he would appear just with the expiry of the rainy season. Go now quickly to the wicked monkey who has forgotten his promise and indulges in physical courtship with Tara. Bring him here with his monkeys too. If he denies, say to him that the arrow which brought death to Ball is still with Rama. So, do compliance with Rama's directions as it is only good for you.
verses.hindi: 'और आपके मित्र सदा मेरे मित्र होंगे तथा अनेक वानरों के साथ सीता की खोज के लिए—'

verses.translation: Sita to Rama wherever she is found. Who except you can dare to cheat a friend who put an example by killing Bali at first and recovering the throne for you. Remember that you had promised in the presence of gods, fire and water treating them as witnesses in the express words - "O king, I will help you for searching Sita. Your enemies are my enemies and your friends will be my friends from this day. I will come to you definitely with an army of monkeys for searching Sita." Who can be next to you to dare reverse or otherwise the promise. You thus, have made your work done but omitted his work. The proverbs such as "the mind reverts when ones work is done through others" and "the calf skips the udder in which milk is less" do exactly apply to the wicked like you. The prudent men in this world seldom forget the good one had done for them. The scriptures suggest remedy for the sinner but there is no remedy for the ungrateful man. I have neither read nor heard any remedy for the ungratefulness and the ungrateful undoubtedly suffer from severe calamities. Hence, don’t be ungrateful. Remember your promise recently made. Come now to the shelter of Rama and apologise for the omission. If still you deny, listen to the declaration of Rama - "I will despatch like Ball to Yama’s home." verses.transliteration: aṅgadas tūrṇam utthāya tasyājñāṃ śirasā dadhe ityukte dūrataḥ sthāpya vānarān atha jāmbavān
verses.translation: Rama on this request said Sugrlva - "Warrior Sugrlva, come beside me, tell me are you all well." Sugrlva said with clasped hands - "O king, my well-being is related to the search of Slta and it will be perfectly achieved when I assign her to you."
verses.hindi: अंगद तुरंत उठ खड़े हुए और उनकी आज्ञा शिरोधार्य की। तत्पश्चात् नीतिज्ञ जांबवान् ने अन्य वानरों को कुछ दूर रोककर—
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama on this request said Sugrlva - "Warrior Sugrlva, come beside me, tell me are you all well." Sugrlva said with clasped hands - "O king, my well-being is related to the search of Slta and it will be perfectly achieved when I assign her to you."
verses.science: बन्धयित्वा महासेतुं तेन गत्वा स राघवः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं मारुतात्मजम् एकतः स्थाप्य तान् आह नीतिमान् नीतिमद् वचः

verses.science: रामादेशादथोत्प्लुत्य दूतकर्मसु तत्परः ततो वानरसेनाभिः संख्यातीताभिरच्युतः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयतां वचनं मे ऽद्य सीतान्वेषणकर्मणि श्रुत्वा च तद् गृहाण त्वं रोचते यन् नृपात्मज

verses.hindi: 'हे राजकुमार, सीता की खोज के विषय में आज मेरी बात सुनिए और यदि उचित लगे तो उसे स्वीकार कीजिए।'

verses.sanskrit: भूषणानि च दृष्टानि तया क्षिप्तानि तेन वै तान्य् अस्माभिः प्रदृष्टानि सुग्रीवायार्पितानि च

verses.translation: In reply to Sugriva, Hanuman with permission of Rama said- "0 Sugriva, listen attentively to me. The pain of separation from Slta puts Rama anxious all the time and he has even abandoned the fruits etc. and live without food. Laksmana too is sad always. This anxiety from both hearts goes to Ayodhya and keeps Bharata in misery and its reflection becomes the cause for pain to the subjects. Take into account this condition and search for Slta immediately.
verses.hindi: 'और सीताजी द्वारा गिराए गए आभूषण भी देखे गए, जिन्हें हमारे वानरों ने उठाकर सुग्रीव को सौंपा था।'
verses.wordMeaning: In reply to Sugriva, Hanuman with permission of Rama said- "0 Sugriva, listen attentively to me. The pain of separation from Slta puts Rama anxious all the time and he has even abandoned the fruits etc. and live without food. Laksmana too is sad always.…

verses.science: श्रीराम आदिका समुद्रतटपर जाना; विभीषणकी शरणागति और राज्याभिषेक। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जटायुवाक्याद् राजेन्द्र सत्यम् इत्य् अवधारय एतस्मात् कारणात् सीता नीता तेनैव रक्षसा

verses.hindi: 'हे राजेंद्र, जटायु के वचन से यह पूर्ण सत्य समझिए कि उसी दुष्ट राक्षस रावण ने—'

verses.sanskrit: रावणेन महाबाहो लङ्कायां वर्तते तु सा त्वां स्मरन्ती तु तत्रस्था त्वद्दुःखेन सुदुःखिता

verses.sanskrit: स्थिता प्रायेण ते देवी सीता दुःखपरायणा हितम् एव च ते राजन्न् उदधेर् लङ्घने क्षमम्

verses.translation: When the statement of Hanuman was over, Jambavan sought permission of Rama and stood up. He said Sugriva - "O Sugriva, consider the words of Hanuman all right. A firm thought in my mind assures that Slta, the chaste, meritorious lady will still be undeviated and unharmed; however her location is yet unknown. Nobody in this earth can do any harm to Slta whose mind is exclusively concentrated on Rama, the great philanthropist. Hence, order the monkeys for the search immediately.
verses.hindi: 'हे राजन्, दुःखमग्ना देवी सीता प्रायः वहीं स्थित हैं; अतः आपके हित में यही है कि समुद्र लाँघने में समर्थ—'

verses.translation: Following the words of Jambavan, Sugriva was pleased and he immediately sent a number of monkeys to the west, sent one lakh monkeys to the north and a similar approach was followed for the east for the mission of searching Slta. The wise Sugriva then said to Arigada - "O Aiigada, go to the south for the search of Slta. Jambavan, Hanuman, Dvivida and Nila etc., gallant and brave' monkeys will be in your company. Go and see Slta and locate the place, her condition and particularly her conduct, who has abducted her and where has she kept her? On having this information, return as early as possible."

verses.translation: Hanuman because he is only capable to jump across the sea. Nobody among the monkeys except Hanuman is able to succeed in this mission. This only is my opinion and I think it will prove all benevolent to all of us if duly accepted.

verses.commentary: Sense: should therefore, assign this work to Hanuman because he is only capable to jump across the sea. Nobody among the monkeys except Hanuman is able to succeed in this mission. This only is my opinion and I think it will prove all benevolent to all of us if duly accepted.

verses.science: जघान रामोऽथ रणे बाणवृष्टिकरं नृप श्रीराम आदिका समुद्रतटपर जाना; विभीषणकी शरणागति और राज्याभिषेक २२९। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ते जाम्बवान् आह तां सिद्धां सुमहामतिः सुग्रीवस्य वयं भृत्या आगता ह्य् अत्र शोभने

verses.hindi: तब महामति जांबवान् ने उस सिद्ध तपस्विनी से कहा—'हे शोभने, हम सुग्रीव के सेवक हैं और यहाँ—'

verses.sanskrit: रामभार्यार्थम् अनघे सीतान्वेषणकर्मणि कांदिग्भूता निराहारा अदृष्ट्वा जनकात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration: rāmabhāryārtham anaghe sītānveṣaṇakarmaṇi kāṃdigbhūtā nirāhārā adṛṣṭvā janakātmajām
verses.translation: Rama then said to Sugriva - "O king, Slta is in a forest in the south. Hanuman can only search her. He will definitely return with success in his mission. Please, have courage as my statement is true." Laksmana said on the basis of omen for good he experienced - "Hanuman will come after meeting Slta." Thus, Sugriva and Laksmana took care of Rama with continued consolation.
verses.hindi: 'हे निष्पापे, श्रीराम की पत्नी सीताजी की खोज में आए हैं; जनकनंदिनी को न देख पाने के कारण हम निराहार और दिशाभ्रमित हो गए हैं।'

verses.translation: The gallant monkeys sent under the lead of Angada. were tired badly but could not find STta. Owing to non-availability of food for several days, they were starving. In course of their stroll round the forest, they saw a meritorious wife of Rsi in a cave. Having felt their presence in the cottage, she asked -"Whose messengers are you? From where have you come and what is the purpose of your visit here?

verses.translation: Sita, who was abducted by Ravana and to locate the place where she was kept. He faced the east, bowed his head to Atmayoni Brahma including gods, Rama, Laksmana and with reverence bowed before the sea and rivers with clasped hands. He then embraced his monkey friends and did Pradaksina of them. All monkeys blessed - "O warrior, go through the holy way of air and return without any major hindrances." The gallant Hanuman then got his own power. He became as mighty as the air itself. He lifted his head high and looked at the distant route. With a feeling of six kind perfect luxuries, be pressed the peak of Mahendra mountain with his feet and jumped upward.

verses.sanskrit: यदि नेच्छति मां सीता ततः खादत मानुषीम् इत्य् उक्त्वा गतवान् दुष्टो रावणः स्वं निकेतनम्

verses.sanskrit: ततो भयेन तां प्राहू राक्षस्यो जनकात्मजाम् रावणं भज कल्याणि सधनं सुखिनी भव

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्ता प्राह ताः सीता राघवो ऽलघुविक्रमः निहत्य रावणं युद्धे सगणं मां नयिष्यति

verses.sanskrit: नाहम् अन्यस्य भार्या स्याम् ऋते रामं रघूत्तमम् स ह्य् आगत्य दशग्रीवं हत्वा मां पालयिष्यति

verses.science: इस प्रकार प्रतिज्ञा पूर्ण करके श्रीरामचन्द्रजी अपना चित्त भरतजीकी ओर लगा रहनेके कारण वहाँसे दिव्यपुरी अयोध्याको गये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तास् त्रिजता प्राह स्वप्ने दृष्टम् अनिन्दिता शृणुध्वं दुष्टराक्षस्यो रावणस्य विनाशनः

verses.sanskrit: रक्षोभिः सह सर्वैस् तु रावणस्य मृतिप्रदः लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रामस्य विजयप्रदः

verses.translation: Hanuman saw STta surrounded with the monstresses under an Asoka tree. She was seated there and that tree was flourishing with green leaves and flowers. Hanuman climbed on that tree and assuming her STta with full confidence, sat there. As he could sit there, Ravana came there in company of various women. He said to STta - "Darling, I am suffering from sensuality. Accept me please. Put on jewels on your body and shift your mind from Rama to me." STta. shrank her body with fear, took a straw before her and began to reply slowly - "O wicked and sensuous Ravana, get out from here immediately. I curse on you that Rama's arrows soon lick your blood."
verses.hindi: 'समस्त राक्षसों सहित रावण की मृत्यु देने वाला, भाई लक्ष्मण सहित श्रीराम को विजय देने वाला—'

verses.hindi: 'और आपके महावीर देवर लक्ष्मण शीघ्र ही यहाँ आएँगे तथा सपरिवार रावण का वध कर आपको यहाँ से ले जाएँगे।'

She said- "O wicked monstresses, listen to a dream that predicts destruction of Ravana, his death with all other monsters, indicative of Rama's victory and maker of Slta's rc-mccting with Rama. He then gave the ring, told the special marks on the bodies of Rama and Laksmana and said- "Gentle lady, Stigma is the king of gallant and chivalrous monkeys. verses.translation: All of a sudden, an idea struck his mind and he destroyed the Asoka-vatika, stood at the gate of it and cried loudly - "Victory to Rama." He killed all monsters whosoever came to resist him with their commanders. The commander Aksakumara was killed with his charioteer and horses. Indrajlt, another son of Ravana however, captured him under some specific devices. He then took him to Ravana. On exit from there, he burnt the entire Lanka into ashes with loud cry as "Victory to Rama, to Sugrlva and to Laksmana." Threatened Ravana and again met with Slta. He then crossed the sea, met with monkeys and received honour from all when he gave the news of Slta to them.
verses.hindi: 'राक्षसियों से घिरी हुई निरंतर आपका ही स्मरण कर रही हैं। सुंदर मुख वाली आपकी पत्नी अश्रुपूर्ण और दीन अवस्था में—'

verses.translation: With monkey friends, he then entered into Madhuvana slapped all guards and drunk honey in the company of all monkeys. Dadhimukha, a monkey, resisting them was badly beaten. With extreme gaiety, they all then reached near Rama and Laksmana. He bowed his head before king Rama and Laksmana, disclosed the whole account starting from jumping over the sea to the meeting with Slta and said that - "I saw Slta in As'oka-vatika, the monstresses had surrounded her and she was frequently and with pricks of separation remembering you. A stream of tears was flowing from her eyes and she was in a depressed state. O Rama, your wife Slta is in her chaste and safe conduct even in so dangerous a place. I searched eveiywhere but found her in Asoka-vatika, talked with her and she also reposed faith in me. She has sent her chest ornament, studded with gems for you."

verses.translation: With these words, Hanuman gave that bangle to Rama and said- "Your wife has also sent a message." Please listen to me - "O great resolute king, remember the event when at Citrakuta mountain your head was in my lap and Jayanta had dishonoured you. O beloved, the excellent act that you performed on that day for the purpose to punish the crow for his slight offence, cannot be expected from the gods and the monsters also. You had shot that time the Brahmastra but whether this Ravana will be left unpunished and scot-free? With this and many other events Slta told and then she began weeping bitterly. All this is the account of Sita's misery. Do efforts to remove her misery." Having heard the message from Slta, the ornament brought by Hanuman increased the pain of Rama. He embraced Hanuman to his chest and began weeping. Then he moved from there

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus ends the fiftieth chapter on an incarnation of Rama in Nrsimha Purana
verses.science: यः कार्तवीर्य निजघान रोषात् नतोऽस्मि विष्णुं पुरुषोत्तमं सदा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विभीषणो ऽस्मि मां रक्ष अहं ते शरणं गतः इत्य् उक्त्वा निपपाताथ प्राञ्जली रामपादयोः
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇo 'smi māṃ rakṣa ahaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ity uktvā nipapātātha prāñjalī rāmapādayoḥ
verses.translation: Lanka, Ravana's defeat, slaughter of Kumbhakarna, Mcghnada and other monsters, Coronation of Rama etc.
verses.hindi: 'मैं विभीषण हूँ, आपकी शरण में आया हूँ, मेरी रक्षा कीजिए!' ऐसा कहकर वे हाथ जोड़े श्रीराम के चरणों में गिर पड़े।
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama's visit at sea-shore, shelter of Vibhl$ana, proposal to make him the king of Lanka, Ravana's defeat, slaughter of Kumbhakarna, Mcghnada and other monsters, Coronation of Rama etc.
verses.science: सेतुं महान्तं जलधौ बबन्ध यः सम्प्राप्य लङ्कां सगणं दशाननम्। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयास्त्राच् च संत्रस्तः सागरो ऽभ्येत्य मूर्तिमान् आह रामं महादेवं रक्ष माम् अपकारिणम्
verses.transliteration: āgneyāstrāc ca saṃtrastaḥ sāgaro 'bhyetya mūrtimān āha rāmaṃ mahādevaṃ rakṣa mām apakāriṇam
verses.translation: Markandcya said- Rama reached the sea-shore with a huge army of monkeys after he heard the gloomy living of Slta. Sugriva and Jambavan too reached the descent shore adorned with Talavana. Rama was looking as the full moon in the company of monkeys. He stayed with Laks mana and started observing the immense depth of the sea. In Lanka, on the other hand, Ravana scolded his brother Vibhlsana even on a good advice he had given. He then with learned ministers came to Rama and said with clasped hands - O Rama
verses.hindi: और आग्नेयास्त्र से संत्रस्त होकर स्वयं समुद्रदेव मूर्तिमान् होकर उपस्थित हुए और महादेव श्रीराम से बोले—'मुझ अपराधी की रक्षा कीजिए!'
verses.wordMeaning: Markandcya said- Rama reached the sea-shore with a huge army of monkeys after he heard the gloomy living of Slta. Sugriva and Jambavan too reached the descent shore adorned with Talavana. Rama was looking as the full moon in the company of monkeys.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Markandcya said- Rama reached the sea-shore with a huge army of monkeys after he heard the gloomy living of Slta. Sugriva and Jambavan too reached the descent shore adorned with Talavana. Rama was looking as the full moon in the company of monkeys.…
verses.science: होकर पृथ्वीका भार दूर करें। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: मार्गो दत्तो मया ते ऽद्य कुशलः सेतुकर्मणि नलस् च कथितो वीरस् तेन कारय राघव
verses.transliteration: mārgo datto mayā te 'dya kuśalaḥ setukarmaṇi nalas ca kathito vīras tena kāraya rāghava
verses.hindi: 'हे राघव, आज मैंने आपको मार्ग दे दिया है; आपकी सेना में सेतु-निर्माण में कुशल वीर नल हैं, उन्हीं के द्वारा आप—'

verses.science: 'बलराम-श्रीकृष्ण-अवतारके चरित्र श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यावदिष्टं तु विस्तीर्णं सेतुबन्धनम् उत्तमम् ततो नलमुखैर् अन्यैर् वानरैर् अमितौजसैः
verses.transliteration: yāvadiṣṭaṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ setubandhanam uttamam tato nalamukhair anyair vānarair amitaujasaiḥ
verses.translation: I am the younger brother of Ravana. My name is and I am under your shelter. Please, escort me. With these words, he fell down at the feet of Rama. Rama understood his wish, picked him up, did a Tllaka and said- "I declare that the kingdom of Lanka will go to you." stood there and talked with Rama on various other matters.
verses.hindi: 'जितना चाहें उतना विस्तृत उत्तम महासेतु बँधवा लीजिए।' तब नल आदि अमित तेजस्वी वानरों से—

verses.sanskrit: बन्धयित्वा महासेतुं तेन गत्वा स राघवः सुवेलाख्यं गिरिं प्राप्तः स्थितो ऽसौ वानरैर् वृतः

Should I pick the fence, the parks and the entire Lanka with gate and city up here, or pick this whole army at once for attack on that city or make plain this trifle sea with boulders and rocks. Please, order me what I should do? My arms can do everything.

verses.translation: When all monsters were killed, Ravana annoyed too much on seeing their wives wailing. That brave monster came hurriedly with a bow in his hands. He was surrounded by the monsters and said furiously - "Where is that Rama?" He began to shower arrows on monkeys from chariot. The monkeys began to run here and there as the arrows penetrated their organs. Rama asked the fleeing monkeys - "Why has such a situation chaotic arisen? What has the fear befallen on them?

verses.translation: Rama took his bow with anger and stretched it. The sound so generated had echoed the directions and the eiher. He then began to fight against Ravana. Sugiiva, Jambavan, Hanuman, Aiigada, Vibhlsana, Laksmana and other mighty monkeys also participated and began to attack on the army. A dreadful war was waged there between Rama and Ravana. Rama made powerless all weapons exercised by Ravana and then killed his charioteer and horses by shooting eleven arrows. Ravana's bow was also cut by using Bhalla arrow. He then shot fifteen arrows which beheaded him of ten heads. The enemy of gods badly suffered as a result of Rama's blows. His ministers escorted him in unconscious state and took to the palace.
verses.hindi: युद्ध के लिए आते हुए उन शत्रुओं को देखकर लक्ष्मण ने छह तीक्ष्ण बाणों से उन्हें यमलोक पहुँचा दिया—

verses.translation: Kumbhakarna, who was awakened by the noise created through drumming and piping, crossed the fort of Lanka and gradually came out copying an elephant. His body was tall and he was very thick and fat. His eyes were fearful. That mighty monster began to move in the battle field by making the monkeys his prey. hit trident on his chest and by using his hands and mouth, he cut both his ears and the nose respectively.

verses.translation: Rama then killed all commanders of the army and beheaded him. He then defeated Indrajit with the help of Garuda. Having heard the failure of Meghanada’s efforts and on the earth of Kumbhakarna, Ravana got angry and ordered his son Tris'ira, Atikaya, Mahakaya, Devantaka and Narantaka - "O sons, kill both persons i.e., Rama and Laks tnana in battle. He then turned to Mahodara and Mahaparsva and said- "You will duly prepare yourself for the killing of enemy in this battle and go with a large army.

Sugriva killed, Kumbha, an egoist of his power and Hanuman killed Nikumbha, who was the cause of trouble for the gods. Virupaksa was killed by Vibhlsana by using his Gada. Bhlrna and Mainda killed Svapati, Angada, Jambavan and other monkeys killed other monsters. O king, Sri Rama, while fighting killed Mahalaksa and Mahacala monsters whole showered the arrows on him.

verses.translation: Then Indrajit forwarded on the chariot, obtained through the power of hymns and began to shower arrows on all monkeys. Hanuman brought the medicine at night under motivation of Jambavanfto cure the wounds of Rama and the army as a whole. He picked up Rama and all monkeys from the ground by virtue of the medicine, took blazing ulka (a fire band) and burnt down all elephants, horses, the chariots in Lanka. Rama subsequently, killed Meghanada through Laksmana by snooting arrows in all directions like a cloud.
verses.hindi: यह सुनकर महाबली लक्ष्मण ने कमलनयन श्रीराम से कहा—'आप यहीं ठहरिए, इस राक्षस से पहले मैं युद्ध करूँगा।'

verses.translation: O king, I have described all activities as performed by Rama on the earth. The persons who read and hear this episode with sheer devotion, definitely attain the abode of Rama endowed by Rama himself. Thus ends the fifty-second chapter on an incarnation of Rama in Nrsimha Purana
verses.hindi: दिव्य अयोध्यापुरी लौटे जहाँ भरत द्वारा विनयपूर्वक अनुरोध किए जाने पर वसिष्ठ आदि श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों ने उनका राज्याभिषेक किया और प्रतापी श्रीराम ने दीर्घकाल तक धर्मपूर्वक राज्य किया।

verses.science: द्वापरे तच्च मासेन अहोरात्रेण तत्कलौ। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञादिकं कर्म निजं च कृत्वा पौरैस् तु रामो दिवम् आरुरोह राजन् मया ते कथितं समासतो रामस्य भूम्यां चरितं महात्मनः इदं सुभक्त्या पठतां च शृण्वतां ददाति रामः स्वपदं जगत्पतिः
verses.transliteration: yajñādikaṃ karma nijaṃ ca kṛtvā paurais tu rāmo divam āruroha rājan mayā te kathitaṃ samāsato rāmasya bhūmyāṃ caritaṃ mahātmanaḥ idaṃ subhaktyā paṭhatāṃ ca śṛṇvatāṃ dadāti rāmaḥ svapadaṃ jagatpatiḥ
verses.translation: Thus keeping his words properly, Rama began since long his concentration for Bharata, returned to Ayodhya. He then accepted the throne on pressure by Bharata. He ruled for a long period abiding by the religion and he went to heaven with all
verses.hindi: अंत में अपने समस्त यज्ञ आदि कर्तव्य पूर्ण कर श्रीराम अयोध्यावासियों सहित दिव्य धाम को पधारे। हे राजन्, मैंने आपको महात्मा श्रीराम का यह पार्थिव चरित्र संक्षेप में सुनाया; जो इसे परम भक्ति से पढ़ते और सुनते हैं, जगत्पति श्रीराम उन्हें अपना परम पद प्रदान करते हैं।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus keeping his words properly, Rama began since long his concentration for Bharata, returned to Ayodhya. He then accepted the throne on pressure by Bharata. He ruled for a long period abiding by the religion and he went to heaven with all
