verses.translation: Brahma said- I am unable to efface the impact of the curse thundered by that hermit and the same is the position of god Sankara. Only worship to god Visnu can do some good in this direction. Indra should worship god Visnu with reciting the eighteen-letter hymn and it should be done regularly. He can thus, be absolved from the feminine form. O Indra, do continuous japa after a bath, with obeisance and in concentration for self-purification the hymn - "Orh Namo Narayanaya." You may be absolved from the feminine form when japa will access to the number two lakhs. Indra complied with the instructions given by Brahma and he was absolved from the impact of the curse with the grace of god Visnu.
verses.hindi: हे इन्द्र, दो लाख जप पूर्ण होने पर आप स्त्रीभाव से मुक्त हो जाएँगे। ब्रह्मा का यह वचन सुनकर इन्द्र ने वैसा ही किया और तब भगवान विष्णु की कृपा से वे स्त्रीभाव से मुक्त हो गए।
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma said- I am unable to efface the impact of the curse thundered by that hermit and the same is the position of god Sankara. Only worship to god Visnu can do some good in this direction.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma said- I am unable to efface the impact of the curse thundered by that hermit and the same is the position of god Sankara. Only worship to god Visnu can do some good in this direction.…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं केचित् प्रशंसन्ति समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनाः क्षमां केचित् प्रशंसन्ति तथैव च दयार्जवम्

verses.science: राजेन्द्र! महात्मा पुण्डरीकको उस शालग्रामक्षेत्रमे निवास करते बहुत समय बीत गया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां चतुर्णाम् इह केवलम् उपायः पदभेदेन बहुधैवं प्रचक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ caturṇām iha kevalam upāyaḥ padabhedena bahudhaivaṃ pracakṣyate
verses.translation: The man who listens to this ancient story that provides with emancipation, receives sacrosanct knowledge and attains to god Visnu in the light of such knowledge.
verses.hindi: इस लोक में धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष—इन चारों के लिए केवल मार्ग-भेद से अनेक प्रकार के उपाय कहे जाते हैं।
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who listens to this ancient story that provides with emancipation, receives sacrosanct knowledge and attains to god Visnu in the light of such knowledge.
verses.science: हाथ जोड़कर उन्हें अर्घ्य निवेदन किया, फिर यथोचितरूपसे उनके चरणोंमें मस्तक झुकाया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं चावस्थिते लोके कृत्याकृत्यविधौ नराः व्यामोहम् एव गच्छन्ति विमुक्ताः पापकर्मभिः

verses.translation: Thus, here ends the sixty-third chapter in Nrsimha Purana

verses.translation: Sri Bharadvaja said- Suta, a few people appreciate the truth by telling it the exerciser of the industry, some others say the penance and purity as the best. Some people appreciate Samkhya and some others Yoga. Certain people treat the furrow, stone and gold as equal, some consider knowledge the best means to implement the industry. Some people appreciate forgiveness, some kindness and some others simplicity. Some people consider donation as the best means, some people suggest any other measure the best. Other people treat as best due knowledge and some others explain reclusion as the best. Some people having faith in offering treat the Agnistoma as the best. The people who know the elements of Sarhkha, consider if the best for the concentration of the soul. Thus, Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa the four asramas is told differently due to the discrimination of the names. The persons who have made their heart holy, being not clear on what to do and what not to do, fall always in affection. O omniscient, the best measure out of the truth etc., measures and prescribed by the hermits as requisite duty, kindly tell of such a measure which can fulfil our desires.

verses.translation: The learned Pundarika was a Brahmana. He used to follow all the rules made for the bachelors under sheer obedience to his teachers. He had conquered his senses and anger and used to observe sandhya regularly. He was expert in the Veda and the parts of the Vedas and well conversant with other scriptures too. He used to worship Agni by collecting fuel daily morning and evening. Like an apparent form of Narada, he used to worship god Vis nu in a systematic manner and concentrate on their imagination. Penance and study were an essential part of his routine. He would bring water, fuel and flowers etc., necessary material and always keep his teachers satisfied. He used to serve teachers like his own parents. He would live on alms and became a favourite to the people on account of his bona-fide behaviour. He used to study Brahmavidya and exercise Pranayama. O king, he has developed a sense to see all things like himself. His wip therefore set aside the attachments and arrived at the stage of emancipation.

verses.translation: That holy place was surrounded by ascetics and learned hermits. There were fantastic cottages of hermits whose names are written in the Puranas. That place is adorned with Cakra river and the boulders there bear the marks of discus. As it was fantastic so it was solitary. It was widely extended and the heart automatically felt pleasure there. Some creatures were marked with discus and they were holy to see. The travellers were all at pleasure there. Learned Pundarlka began to live happily at that holy place. He used to take a dip in holy Devahrda, the water of Sarasvatl capable of bringing back the memory of pre-birth, in cakra kunda, in the pious water of Narayan! and other rivers flowing nearby that area.

verses.translation: Owing to the effect of that area and the splendour of the holy places located there, that great soul of a hermit became happy and holy at heart. Thus, being holy at heart, practice in Dhyanayoga and with a desire to achieve axiom, he began to worship god Visnu there. By putting a good check on his sensory organs, keeping himself free from worries, he lived there alone for a long period. They lived on vegetables, roots and fruits with sole satisfaction. He used to exercise Yoga with Yama, Niyama, Asana, Bandha, Tibra, Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana and Samadhi. Thus, he worshipped god Visnu there and keeping his mind in concentration of god Visnu, be began to offer psalms for the pleasure of god.

verses.commentary: Sense: Having received an introduction of Narada, the Brahmana who was overwhelmly surprised, began to say with a tone in sheer devotion.
verses.science: कणके बराबर “अणु' मानते हैं। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: शृणुष्वावहितो ब्रह्मन् कथयामि तवानघ परमार्थम् इदं गुह्यं घोरसंसारमोचनम्

verses.sanskrit: शृणुष्वावहितं तात कथयामि तवानघ यत् प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वं पृच्छतो मम सुव्रत

verses.translation: Pundarlka said- "I am most lucky among all creatures of this universe and honourable to all gods. My Pitrs have been thankful today. My life has become meaningful now. O great hermit, I am your devotee. Please, have mercy on me. Owing to the deeds in pre-birth, O scholar, I am moving in this world for nothing. Tell me please, what I should do to get-rid-of this state of being. Even if the act be mystic, please, tell me the same. O hermit, you gcnei'ally support all people but you care particularly the Vaisnavas.
verses.hindi: हे अनघ सुव्रत तात, सावधान होकर सुनिए, जो पूर्वकाल में मेरे पूछने पर ब्रह्मा जी ने मुझे बताया था, वही मैं आपसे कहता हूँ।

verses.science: दासोऽहं वासुदेवस्य देवदेवस्य शार्किण: प्रयाति विष्णुसालोक्यं पुरुषो नात्र संशयः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.translation: In the opinion of some people, this entire world is generated from the inexpressible and it gets merged with the same at the phase of a particular point of time. O the greatest scholar, a few other metaphysicians, treat the soul as everlasting, omnipresent and multi-form. Having gone over all these matters, the hermits of different opinions lay down a doctrine as per their savvy and learning. Listen to it carefully. This secret element of supreme meaning is capable to provide emancipation. The mind of a man often receive the topics presently running and it cannot conceives the distant past and the future. O innocent and resolute Pundarika, I am now going to tell you whatever god Brahma told me on my query. Please, listen

verses.translation: All elements are originated from Nara, hence, these are called Nara. Under what these Nara is sheltered is called Narayana. This entire universe gets birth from Narayana and gets merged with him at the time of devastation. Narayana is the Parabrahma, he is the supreme element, the supreme flame and the supreme soul. O hermit, god Narayana is even beyond the para. Nothing is greater or distinct than him here. Whatever is seen or heard here, god Narayana existed by covering it from outside and inside. The gods have repeatedly said to him Sakara when they observed him in the tangible things of this universe and they concentrated their mind exclusively on Narayana with reciting Om Namo Narayanaya. The person who being exclusive in heart, concentrates on Narayana had nothing to bear with the donation, pilgrimage, penance and the offerings. Concentration on Narayana is the supreme knowledge and no Yoga is greater than it. What use to go over the other scriptures that give contradictory meanings. As a number of ways ultimately lead to a city, the knowledge vested in various scriptures finally enter into Narayana.

verses.translation: That god Visnu is omnipresent in an inexpressive form, he is the micro element, he is the immortal Sanatana Purusa, the initial cause of this entire world but there is no beginning and no end of him. He himself is unborn. Hence, he is Svayambhu. However, he originated all living organisms of this world. He is sovereign, unimaginable, everlasting and in the form of cause and effect. He is called Vasudeva as this entire world existed in him. He is Purana, and free from all defects. This entire three-world movable and immovable is in existence because god has protected it. This is the reason, he is called Visnu. As on decay or expiry of the era, all elements including Mahatattva etc., reside in Paramatma, he is therefore, called Vasudeva. Some people call him Purusa (the soul) and some call immortal Tsvara. A

verses.translation: Parabrahma. Some thinkers call him 'Kala' with no beginning and no end and some people call him Sanatana Jlva. Some call Paramatma, some Niramaya element, some Ksetrajna and some others consider the twenty fourth element due to twenty three defects i.e. Prakrti and the distinct element form twenty fifty Purusa as twenty sixth element Purusottama. Some people say the soul in measurement of a thumb, some as small as pollen drain of the lotus flower, a molecule. These and the different names of god Visnu as explained by a number of scholars who throw into confusion the ordinary people by creating discriminatory wit in them. If there is one scripture, all could know the exact knowledge. Here are a number of scriptures and each scripture has its own principles thereby element of knowledge has become difficult to set in mind. When I have gone over all the scriptures, I came to know that it is the essence to concentrate on god Narayana continuously. Hence, leave the study of a number of scriptures and concentrate with vigour on god Narayana. Your continuous concentration will enable definitely to know the exact element of god Narayana shortly and thus, you will attain to the emancipation.

verses.science: यब्द्रितं मम देवेश तदाज्ञापय माधव। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.translation: O Brahmana, I engaged myself exclusively in the service of god Narayana since the day I heard this rare Jnanayoga from Brahma. The people who know the Sanatana Brahma form hymn - Om Namo Narayanaya, attain to the abode of god Vis nu by regular reciting it. Hence, the metaphysicians should always recite this hymn with exclusive devotion. God Narayana is omnipresent Sanatana Paramesvara. He is engaged in the task of creation, maintenance and destruction of this universe. One should therefore, worship him by keeping oneself busy with listening to his names, virtues and deeds and offering hymns. O Brahmana, the person who wants his good, should treat as duty to concentrate on god Narayana. The people who are always satisfied, free from greed, learned, controller of their senses, free from affection, ego, envy and enmity etc., defects, impartial, peaceful mind and afraid from all kinds of resolutions, keep themselves engaged in Dhyanayoga of god and attain to him. The greatmen pray to god Vasudeva by cutting their relations from the three-worlds and receive his grace. 0 Brahmana, keep yourself busy in the worship of god Narayana.

verses.translation: Suta said- The most philanthropic Narada then disappeared. The religious soul Pundarlka then began to recite - "Salute to god Kesava, O great Yogi, be pleased with me." The ascetic Pundarlka lived for many years at that Salagrama alone with god in his heart and continuous concentration. He did not see even in his dreams any other than god Visnu. His sleep too did not hinder in the mission. He achieved the best Vais navi axiom with the grace of god Visnu who is the only witness to all the worlds.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ, सिंह, व्याघ्र तथा अन्य प्राणी-हिंसक वन्य पशु भी अपना स्वाभाविक वैर छोड़कर उनके सान्निध्य में शान्त इन्द्रियवृत्तियों के साथ मिलकर निवास करते थे।

verses.translation: The lion, tiger and many other cruel animals in the forest near him live peacefully without any enemity and protest. O Brahmana Bharadvaja, the tendencies of these barbarous animals always cooled down by virtue of his penance.

verses.translation: Later on, god Narayana appeared before that wise Pundarlka. His eyes were as large as lotus petals. Conch, discus, gada etc., weapons were in his hands. A yellow sheet was on his shoulders. A garland of divine flowers was enhancing his grandeur. At his chest, there was the mark of Srlvatsa and He was decorated with the kaustubha gem. God Visnu, dark as Kajjalagiri and with Pltambara was on Garuda and looked as a black cloud with the glow of lightning at the peak of Meru mountain. A white umbrella with silvery radiance was over his head in which pearls were hanging. That god was getting extra¬ ordinary grandeur through that umbrella
verses.hindi: मोतियों की लड़ी से युक्त श्वेत छत्र और चामर-व्यजन आदि से वे देवेश्वर सुशोभित हो रहे थे।

verses.translation: With an honour mixed with fear, his head bowed. He put his forehead on the ground and did Sastanga Pranama. He began to gaze at god with eyes stretched as if he would sip Narayana. Having seen the god for which he was praying since long, he stared at him and got saturation. Then Pundarlka was addressed by Padmanabha, who had measured the three-worlds with his three steps.
verses.hindi: चिरकाल से दर्शन की प्रार्थना करने वाले उन वीर पुण्डरीक को अपनी ओर ही एकटक देखते हुए पद्मनाभ त्रिविक्रम भगवान बोले।

verses.translation: Suta said- As god said these words, trumpets began to blow from the gods side and they began to shower flowers from the sky. All gods and saints including Indra began to say "well done, well done and thank god." The Siddha, Gandharva and Kinnaras began to appreciate god many ways. God Visnu took Pundarika with him on the back of Garuda and departed to the abode of Vaikuntha. O Bharadvaja, you therefore, should worship god Visnu, concentrate your mind and even the breathing on god and keep always busy with the welfare of the devotees and as per your strength worship god Purusottama. Keep your ears busy to listen to the episodes pertaining to god which have the capacity to

verses.translation: What to say any more, exercise every measure that may please god Visnu, the soul of the universe. The persons not following the deeds that lead to the pleasure of god Visnu, cannot receive the holy position even after executing several hundreds Vajapeya offerings. The manner to pray to god) O god Vis nu, you are free from the pains of old age; you are immortal, unique, adorable to all, beyond the cycle of birth and death; you are intangible and in tangible form; you are formidable, micro and appreciable even if you are beyond praise. The Yogis realise your features through knowledge and you are the teacher and supreme god of this three-world. I, therefore, have come to get shelter under you."

verses.science: चतुरानन! गोदावरी नदी सर्वत्र परमपावन है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीनरसिंहपुराणे आद्ये धर्मार्थमोक्षदायिनि विष्णुवल्लभे पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ नर्प् ६५ ॥ उक्तः पुण्यः स्तवो ब्रह्मन् हरेर् एभिस् च नामभिः पुनर् अन्यानि नामानि यानि तानि निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe ādye dharmārthamokṣadāyini viṣṇuvallabhe pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || narp 65 || uktaḥ puṇyaḥ stavo brahman harer ebhis ca nāmabhiḥ punar anyāni nāmāni yāni tāni nibodha me
verses.translation: All persons and particularly the Vaisnavas should see the above said pilgrimage. Whosoever does this, I render them emancipation from the worldly ties.
verses.hindi: भगवान बोले—हे ब्रह्मन्, इन नामों के साथ श्रीहरि का यह पुण्य स्तव मैंने कहा; अब अन्य तीर्थों के जो नाम हैं, वे मुझसे सुनिए।
verses.commentary: Sense: daily in morning, noon and evening, enjoys all pleasures in my abode by being absolved from all sins. All persons and particularly the Vaisnavas should see the above said pilgrimage. Whosoever does this, I render them emancipation from the worldly ties.
verses.science: कावेरी-ये पुण्य नदियाँ हैं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा तु प्रथमं पुण्या यमुना गोमती पुनः सरयूः सरस्वती च चन्द्रभागा चर्मण्वती
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā tu prathamaṃ puṇyā yamunā gomatī punaḥ sarayūḥ sarasvatī ca candrabhāgā carmaṇvatī
verses.hindi: सर्वप्रथम पुण्या गङ्गा, फिर यमुना, गोमती, सरयू, सरस्वती, चन्द्रभागा और चर्मण्वती,
verses.commentary: Sense: UP=Ttf?T fawiH^dlrM* Xt^n^oll
verses.translation: UP=Ttf?T fawiH^dlrM* Xt^n^oll
verses.science: सूतजी कहते हैं- भरद्वाज ! ब्रह्माजीसे इन तीर्थांका वर्णन करके भगवान् मधुसूदन अपने धामको चले गये और ब्रह्मा भी ब्रह्मलोक सिधारे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं गया चैव पुष्कराणि तथार्बुदम् नर्मदा च महापुण्या तीर्थान्य् एतानि चोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ gayā caiva puṣkarāṇi tathārbudam narmadā ca mahāpuṇyā tīrthāny etāni cottare
verses.translation: Suta said- The person who recites this hymn always and particularly on Ekadasi or by worshipping god Visnu and then stand with clasped hands, attains to the immortal position of god Visnu.
verses.hindi: कुरुक्षेत्र, गया, पुष्कर, अर्बुद और महापुण्या नर्मदा—ये उत्तर दिशा के तीर्थ हैं।
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- The person who recites this hymn always and particularly on Ekadasi or DvadasI by worshipping god Visnu and then stand with clasped hands, attains to the immortal position of god Visnu.
verses.science: भरद्वाजजी बोलेधर्मज्ञ! उस आमलक ग्राममें जो-जो पुण्यतीर्थ हँ, उनका आप विस्तारके साथ यथार्थ- रूपमें वर्णन करें। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तापी पयोष्णी पुण्ये द्वे तत्सङ्गात् तीर्थम् उत्तमम् तथा ब्रह्मगिरेश् चापि मेखलाभिः समन्विताः
verses.transliteration: tāpī payoṣṇī puṇye dve tatsaṅgāt tīrtham uttamam tathā brahmagireś cāpi mekhalābhiḥ samanvitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, here ends the sixty-fifth chapter in Nrsimha Purana
verses.hindi: तापी और पयोष्णी दोनों पुण्य नदियाँ हैं, जिनके सङ्गम से उत्तम तीर्थ बनता है; तथा ब्रह्मगिरि की मेखलाओं से युक्त तीर्थ हैं।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, here ends the sixty-fifth chapter in Nrsimha Purana
verses.science: सूतजी कहते हैं-विप्र! महामुने! सह्मपर्वतपर स्थित ' आमलक' तीर्थके आविर्भाव आदिकी पवित्र एवं पापनाशक कथा मैं आपसे कह रहा हूँ, सुनें। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विरजं च तथा तीर्थं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् गोदावरी महापुण्या सर्वत्र चतुरानन
verses.transliteration: virajaṃ ca tathā tīrthaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram godāvarī mahāpuṇyā sarvatra caturānana
verses.translation: All persons and particularly the Vaisnavas should see the above said pilgrimage. Whosoever does this, I render them emancipation from the worldly ties.
verses.hindi: हे चतुरानन, समस्त पापों का क्षय करने वाला विरज तीर्थ और सर्वत्र महापुण्या गोदावरी है।
verses.commentary: Sense: daily in morning, noon and evening, enjoys all pleasures in my abode by being absolved from all sins. All persons and particularly the Vaisnavas should see the above said pilgrimage. Whosoever does this, I render them emancipation from the worldly ties.
verses.science: ब्रह्मन्! पूर्वकालमें सह्मपर्वतके वनमें एक बहुत बड़ा आँवलेका वृक्ष था। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुङ्गभद्रा महापुण्या यत्राहं कमलोद्भव हरेण सार्धं प्रीत्या तु वसामि मुनिपूजितः
verses.transliteration: tuṅgabhadrā mahāpuṇyā yatrāhaṃ kamalodbhava hareṇa sārdhaṃ prītyā tu vasāmi munipūjitaḥ
verses.hindi: हे कमलोद्भव, महापुण्या तुङ्गभद्रा है, जहाँ मैं मुनियों द्वारा पूजित होकर भगवान शिव के साथ प्रेमपूर्वक निवास करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: Sense: UP=Ttf?T fawiH^dlrM* Xt^n^oll
verses.translation: UP=Ttf?T fawiH^dlrM* Xt^n^oll
verses.science: तस्योपरि तु देवेशं शङ्कचक्रगदाधरम्। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणगङ्गा कृष्णा तु कावेरी च विशेषतः सह्ये त्व् आमलकग्रामे स्थितो ऽहं कमलोद्भव
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇagaṅgā kṛṣṇā tu kāverī ca viśeṣataḥ sahye tv āmalakagrāme sthito 'haṃ kamalodbhava
verses.translation: Suta said- The person who recites this hymn always and particularly on Ekadasi or by worshipping god Visnu and then stand with clasped hands, attains to the immortal position of god Visnu. Thus, here ends the sixty-fifth chapter in Nrsimha Purana
verses.hindi: दक्षिणगङ्गा कृष्णा और विशेषतः कावेरी है। हे कमलोद्भव, मैं सह्य पर्वत पर आमलकग्राम में स्थित हूँ,
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- The person who recites this hymn always and particularly on Ekadasi or DvadasI by worshipping god Visnu and then stand with clasped hands, attains to the immortal position of god Visnu. Thus, here ends the sixty-fifth chapter in Nrsimha Purana
verses.science: तत्पादं भूतले देवः प्रविवेश महातरुः। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवस्य नाम्ना तु त्वया ब्रह्मन् सदार्चितः तत्र तीर्थान्य् अनेकानि सर्वपापहराणि वै येषु स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च पापान् मुच्यति मानवः
verses.transliteration: devadevasya nāmnā tu tvayā brahman sadārcitaḥ tatra tīrthāny anekāni sarvapāpaharāṇi vai yeṣu snātvā ca pītvā ca pāpān mucyati mānavaḥ
verses.translation: Magnificence of other pilgrim places
verses.hindi: जहाँ हे ब्रह्मन्, आप देवदेव के नाम से सदा मेरा पूजन करते हैं। वहाँ समस्त पापों को हरने वाले अनेक तीर्थ हैं, जिनमें स्नान और आचमन करके मनुष्य पाप से मुक्त हो जाता है।
verses.commentary: Sense: Magnificence of other pilgrim places
verses.science: तस्मिन क्षेत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठ माहात्म्यं तस्य को वदेत्। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं कथयित्वा तु तीर्थानि मधुसूदनः ब्रह्मणे गतवान् ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मापि स्वपुरं गतः
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ kathayitvā tu tīrthāni madhusūdanaḥ brahmaṇe gatavān brahman brahmāpi svapuraṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Sahyadri and Amalaka Grama Suta said- God Visnu again said- O Brahmana, a description of holy prayer to god Visnu through the above-said sixty eight names has been already made. Now, listen to the names and holy places otherwise than them.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले—हे ब्रह्मन्, ब्रह्मा जी को इस प्रकार तीर्थों का वर्णन करके भगवान मधुसूदन अपने धाम चले गए और ब्रह्मा जी भी अपने लोक को चले गए।
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahyadri and Amalaka Grama Suta said- God Visnu again said- O Brahmana, a description of holy prayer to god Visnu through the above-said sixty eight names has been already made. Now, listen to the names and holy places otherwise than them.
verses.science: तच्चक्रतीर्थमभवत्पुण्यं पापप्रणाशनम्। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् आमलकग्रामे पुण्यतीर्थानि यानि वै तानि मे वद धर्मज्ञ विस्तरेण यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: tasminn āmalakagrāme puṇyatīrthāni yāni vai tāni me vada dharmajña vistareṇa yathārthataḥ
verses.hindi: भरद्वाज बोले—हे धर्मज्ञ, उस आमलकग्राम में जो पुण्यतीर्थ हैं, उन्हें मुझे विस्तारपूर्वक और यथार्थ रूप से बताइए।

verses.science: पौषे मासे तु पुष्यार्के तद्यात्रादिवसं मुने। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रोत्पत्तिं च माहात्म्यं यात्रापर्वं च यत्र तत् तत्रासौ देवदेवेशः पूज्यते ब्रह्मणा स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kṣetrotpattiṃ ca māhātmyaṃ yātrāparvaṃ ca yatra tat tatrāsau devadeveśaḥ pūjyate brahmaṇā svayam
verses.hindi: उस क्षेत्र की उत्पत्ति, माहात्म्य और यात्रा-पर्व भी बताइए, जहाँ स्वयं ब्रह्मा द्वारा वे देवदेवेश्वर पूजे जाते हैं।

verses.translation: tttwdi sr tK'hijii TjMuddiny ii wn gtcbiifui d«ir|<H,i
verses.science: जाम्ना तत्कुण्डिकातीर्थ शिलागृहसमन्वितम् सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि पुण्यं पापप्रणाशनम् सह्यामलकतीर्थस्य उत्पत्त्यादि महामुने
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam sahyāmalakatīrthasya utpattyādi mahāmune
verses.hindi: सूत बोले—हे महामुने विप्र, मैं सह्यामलक तीर्थ की पुण्यमयी और पापनाशक उत्पत्ति आदि का वर्णन करता हूँ, सुनिए।

verses.translation: Rift h^iojH wr | cthhj ii-dls^gxiMH.i flSTT V Trwrfvr: 'RMpddlrll'ifll
verses.science: समस्त उत्तम ब्राह्मणोंमें उत्कृष्ट श्रीब्रह्माजीने पूर्वकालमें महान् फलोंसे युक्त उस महावृक्षको देखा था। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा सह्यवनोद्देशे तरुर् आमलको महान् आसीद् ब्रह्मन् महोग्रो ऽयं नाम्नायं चोच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: purā sahyavanoddeśe tarur āmalako mahān āsīd brahman mahogro 'yaṃ nāmnāyaṃ cocyate budhaiḥ
verses.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्, प्राचीन काल में सह्य वनप्रदेश में एक विशाल आमलक (आँवले का) वृक्ष था, जिसे विद्वान 'महोग्र' नाम से कहते हैं।

verses.science: आँवलेके वृक्षको देखा और उसके ऊपर शङ्ख, चक्र एवं गदा धारण करनेवाले देवेश्वर भगवान् विष्णुको विराजमान देखा। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: फलानि तस्य वृक्षस्य महान्ति सुरसानि च दर्शनीयानि दिव्यानि दुर्लभानि महामुने
verses.transliteration: phalāni tasya vṛkṣasya mahānti surasāni ca darśanīyāni divyāni durlabhāni mahāmune
verses.translation: The Ganges is the best holy river, then Yamuna, Gomatl, Sarayu, Sarasvatl, and Carmanvatl etc., rivers are holy. Similarly, Kuruksetra, Gaya, three Puskaras, Arbudaksetra and most holy river Narmada are the holy pilgrimages at north. Tapi and are the two holy rivers. A best pilgrim has come into existence with their confluence. There are several other pilgrim places covered with the ridges of Brahmagiri. Viraja-tlrtha too decays all evils and the river Godavari is the supreme holy everywhere. O lotus born, Tungabhadra river also is most purifying and I reside there in company of god Sankara duly worshipped by the hermits and the saints at its bank. Daksina Ganga, Krsna and particularly Kaverl are the holy rivers. Besides these O lotus born, I reside in Amalaka Grama. You worship there my icon known as Devadeva already and as a regular practice. There are several other pilgrim places capable to decay the sins in which a mere dip and acamana makes a man free from the sins attached to the heart
verses.hindi: हे महामुने, उस वृक्ष के फल बड़े, रसीले, दर्शनीय, दिव्य और दुर्लभ थे।

verses.translation: O Brahmana, long long ago, there was a huge Anvala tree in the forest which was spread in the region of the mountain Sahya. The learned persons used to address it as Mahogra. The fruits of that tree were juicy, decent, pleasing to the eye and divine. God Brahma, the supreme Brahmana had very first seen that great tree laden with such divine fruits. Having the curiosity to know what it was actually, god Brahma meditated. In the state of meditation he saw that god Visnu was sitting on that excellent divine tree with conch, discus, gada in his hands. When he came out of the concentration so made, he stood but found no tree there. Instead of it he saw an icon of god Visnu there. That divine tree was then pressed down deep into the womb of the earth and merely an icon was looking there. Looking at this phenomenon, god Brahma began to worship that icon of god Visnu with offering flowers, fragrance etc., exterior means for the pleasure of the god regularly. verses.translation: O the great hermit, who can describe the magnificence of the god residing at that Amalaka-ksetra? God Brahma got twelve more holy places at the Amalaka Grama when he was busy worshipping god Visnu at that particular place seen by him very first. Just below the feet of god Visnu, a holy place appeared at the west direction. It was popular with the name of Cakra-tlrtha. This holy place is capable to kill and efface all sins. A man who takes a dip in the Cakra-tlrtha is absolved immediately from sins and receives a warm reception at the abode of Brahma. Then, there comes Sankha-tirtha. A dip in this tlrtha, provides with the fruits as would avail him by performing Vajapeya offering. O hermit

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रमयी गीता सर्वधर्मो दयापरः एवं ते कथितं विप्र क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaśāstramayī gītā sarvadharmo dayāparaḥ evaṃ te kathitaṃ vipra kṣetramāhātmyam uttamam
verses.translation: The person who regularly visits the mountain Sahyadri and takes a bath there, becomes holy in his heart. O Brahmana, the man who after a bath in the streams flowing from the mountain Sahyadri and offers flowers to god Visnu while worshipping, finally merges with god Visnu and his sins are dissolved. As Ganga contains all holy places, one should take a bath daily or regularly in the Ganga and only one bath on the rivers flowing from the mountain peaks is sufficient for a man. All gods are merged with god Visnu. The Gita is the composite from of all scriptures. To be kind to creatures is the best among all religions.
verses.hindi: गीता सर्वशास्त्रमयी है और दया समस्त धर्मों का सार है। हे विप्र, इस प्रकार मैंने आपसे यह उत्तम क्षेत्रमाहात्म्य कहा,
verses.wordMeaning: in those places absolves the man from all his sins. The person who regularly visits the mountain Sahyadri and takes a bath there, becomes holy in his heart. O Brahmana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: in those places absolves the man from all his sins. The person who regularly visits the mountain Sahyadri and takes a bath there, becomes holy in his heart. O Brahmana,…
verses.science: सूतजी कहते हैं--द्विजश्रेष्ठ इस प्रकार अबतक मैंने भूतलके प्रसिद्ध तीथाँका वर्णन किया; किंतु इन मानसानि हि तीर्थानि फलदानि विशेषतः॥ १ तीथाँकी अपेक्षा मानसतीर्…। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाप्रयागगमनैमिषपुष्कराणि पुण्यायुतानि कुरुजाङ्गलयामुनानि कालेन तीर्थसलिलानि पुनन्ति पापात् पादोदकं भगवतस् तु पुनाति सद्यः

verses.translation: O Brahmana, thus I have described the supreme magnificence of all the holy places that have existed in this region. I have told simultaneously the fruits/consequenccs of taking a bath in the Sahyadri mountain and Amalaka etc. pilgrim places. O Brahmana, that is the best tirtha which is the holiest. This Amalaka pilgrim place has originated
verses.hindi: गङ्गा, प्रयाग, गया, नैमिष, पुष्कर, कुरुजाङ्गल और यमुना आदि लाखों पुण्यतीर्थों के जल कुछ काल में पाप से पवित्र करते हैं, किन्तु भगवान का पादोदक तत्क्षण पवित्र कर देता है।

verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmana, thus I have described the supreme magnificence of all the holy places that have existed in this region. I have told simultaneously the fruits/consequenccs of taking a bath in the Sahyadri mountain and Amalaka etc. pilgrim places. O Brahmana,…
verses.science: तर्पयित्वा पितृन्देवानुषींश्च तिलतन्दुलैः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीनरसिंहपुरणे तीर्थप्रशंसायां षट्सष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ नर्प् ६६ ॥ तीर्थानि कथितान्य् एवं भौमानि द्विजसत्तम मानसानि हि तीर्थानि फलदानि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīnarasiṃhapuraṇe tīrthapraśaṃsāyāṃ ṣaṭsaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || narp 66 || tīrthāni kathitāny evaṃ bhaumāni dvijasattama mānasāni hi tīrthāni phaladāni viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Visnu; hence, it is the best holy place. To take a dip here in the river is equal to the horse sacrifices made as many as for one thousand times. It is called Cakra-tlrtha by the scholars who well know the Vedas. After a dip one should bow his head at the feet of god Visnu there and thus, a man becomes free from the cycle of birth and death. The pilgrim places at the bank of rivers like - the Gaiiga, Prayaga, Naimis aranya, Puskara, Kurujangala Pradesa and the holy places located at the bank of Yamuna are all fruit givers. A dip in these holy places, takes time to make a man holy at heart but this Cakra-tlrtha, as emanated from the feet of god Visnu immediately makes a man holy at heart.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले—हे द्विजसत्तम, इस प्रकार भौम (पार्थिव) तीर्थों का वर्णन कर दिया गया; अब विशेष फल देने वाले मानस तीर्थों को सुनिए।
verses.wordMeaning: from the feet of god Visnu; hence, it is the best holy place. To take a dip here in the river is equal to the horse sacrifices made as many as for one thousand times. It is called Cakra-tlrtha by the scholars who well know the Vedas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: from the feet of god Visnu; hence, it is the best holy place. To take a dip here in the river is equal to the horse sacrifices made as many as for one thousand times. It is called Cakra-tlrtha by the scholars who well know the Vedas.…
verses.science: नरसिंहं समभ्यर्च्य यः करोत्युपवासकम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मनोनिर्मलता तीर्थं रागादिभिर् अनाकुला सत्यं तीर्थं दया तीर्थं तीर्थम् इन्द्रियनिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: manonirmalatā tīrthaṃ rāgādibhir anākulā satyaṃ tīrthaṃ dayā tīrthaṃ tīrtham indriyanigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, here ends the sixty-sixth chapter in Nrsimha Purana
verses.hindi: राग-द्वेष आदि से अव्याकुल मन की निर्मलता तीर्थ है, सत्य तीर्थ है, दया तीर्थ है और इन्द्रियनिग्रह भी तीर्थ है।
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, here ends the sixty-sixth chapter in Nrsimha Purana
verses.science: वास्तवमें राग-द्वेषादिसे रहित मनकी स्वच्छता ही उत्तम तीर्थ है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुशुश्रूषणं तीर्थं मातृशुश्रूषणं तथा स्वधर्माचरणं तीर्थं तीर्थम् अग्नेर् उपासनम्

verses.science: रहनेवाला मनुष्य पावन गतिको प्रास करता है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णमास्याम् अमावास्याम् एकभुक्तं समाचरेत् तत्रैकभुक्तं कुर्वाणः पुण्यां गतिम् अवाप्नुयात्

verses.translation: Suta said- O Brahmana, thus, I have described all the popular pilgrim places existed on this earth but Manasa-tlrtha are the particular ones that provide with extra¬ ordinary fruits. It is all true that the mind free from attachment and envy is the best pilgrim place. The observance of truth
verses.hindi: पूर्णिमा और अमावास्या को एकभुक्त (एक समय भोजन) का आचरण करना चाहिए; उनमें एकभुक्त करने वाला पुण्यगति को प्राप्त करता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Suta said- O Brahmana, thus, I have described all the popular pilgrim places existed on this earth but Manasa-tlrtha are the particular ones that provide with extra¬ ordinary fruits. It is all true that the mind free from attachment and envy is the best pilgrim place.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suta said- O Brahmana, thus, I have described all the popular pilgrim places existed on this earth but Manasa-tlrtha are the particular ones that provide with extra¬ ordinary fruits. It is all true that the mind free from attachment and envy is the best pilgrim place.…
verses.science: रातमें उपवास -करता है, उसे मनोवाञ्छित वस्तुकी प्राप्ति होती है मुनिश्रेष्ठ! एकादशीको दिन-रात उपवास करनेका विधान है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थ्यां तु चतुर्दश्यां सप्तम्यां नक्तम् आचरेत् अष्टम्यां तु त्रयोदश्यां स प्राप्नोत्य् अभिवाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: caturthyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ naktam ācaret aṣṭamyāṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ sa prāpnoty abhivāñchitam
verses.translation: Thus, it is the description of the holy places and now listen to the resolutions (Vratas).
verses.hindi: चतुर्थी, चतुर्दशी, सप्तमी, अष्टमी और त्रयोदशी को नक्तव्रत करने वाला मनुष्य अभीष्ट फल प्राप्त करता है।
verses.commentary: Sense: mercy, control over the senses, obedience to teacher, service to parents, observance of ones own religion and worship of fire are the best pilgrim places. Thus, it is the description of the holy places and now listen to the resolutions (Vratas).
verses.science: करके सौरनक्त-व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपवासो मनुश्रेष्ठ एकादश्यां विधीयते नरसिंहं समभ्यर्च्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनो द्विगुणां छायां यदा संतिष्ठते रविः सौरनक्तं विजानीयान् न नक्तं निशि भोजनम्
verses.transliteration: ātmano dviguṇāṃ chāyāṃ yadā saṃtiṣṭhate raviḥ sauranaktaṃ vijānīyān na naktaṃ niśi bhojanam
verses.translation: O hermit, it is a resolution to live on single time food and that too in the day and particularly giving up the food at night is the fast. One should live on one time food at Purnima and Amavasya. The person who takes one time food on these days receives the supreme position. The person who keeps fast on fourth, fourteenth, seventh, eighth and thirteenth day and abandons food at night, gets the desired thing.

verses.science: इस प्रकार स्नातकोंके साथ इस पुराणको सुन महामति भरद्वाजजीने सूतजीका पूजन-सत्कार किया और स्वयं वहीं रह गये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.translation: O great hermit, Bharadvaja, thus I have told this entire Nrsirnha Purana in the presence of all of you. I have described sarga, pratisarga, vams'a, manvantara and vams'anucarita etc., all. O hermit this Purana was first explained by Brahmaji before Marlci etc. hermits. Out of those hermits, Bhrgu told it to Markandeya and Markandeya told it to the king Sahasranlka from Nagakula. Then the learned Vyasa got it with the grace of god Nrsimha. From him, it is transmitted to me and now I have made you all to listen to this time in the presence of these hermits. May all of you enjoy pleasure and I am now leaving.

verses.science: इति श्रीनरसिंहपुराणे सूतभरद्वाजादिसंवादे सर्वदः खोपहरं श्रीनरसिंहपुराणस्य माहात्म्यं समातम्॥ ६८॥ = इस प्रकार सूत- भरद्वाजादि-संवादरूप श्रीनरसिंहुराणमें इसके…। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।
